[b]The Gift of the Sugarplum Fairies Winter Event is here![/b] Open fairy gift boxes and earn new special cosmetics for the winter season!

[list][*] [b]Earn 11 Limited Time Cosmetics!
[*] Face off against a Rat King Mini-boss and his underlings!
[*] Unwrap Random Fairy Gifts![/b][/list]

A royal foe has returned in time for the holidays in the form of [b]The Rat King! [/b]This over-sized vermin is big, fast, and deadly, [b]but any who defeat him shall have the honor of donning his decapitated head.[/b] It is the season of giving, after all.

[h1]Unlock the Snow Skin![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/5535b90aade3500de54a69c523c1b4c1a30011a1.png[/img]

[h1]Returning Gifts and Foes![/h1]

[b]The Sugarplum Fairies[/b] are back to bring the spirit of the season to the good and naughty crew members of the sea. They'll enter your vessel and leave you wondrous gifts! Unwrap their gifts to reveal one of [b]10 Winter Cosmetics[/b], a bounty of gold, or perhaps a [b]Ravenous Rat[/b] or [b]Rat King[/b] if you weren't so good this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/77e8f3572fafd4e16256d79525f39fde12eb6f21.png[/img]

[b]The Fairies will flutter away on January 5th.[/b]

[h1]Update on Updates[/h1]

We know it's been a while since our last non-event related update, but rest assured new things are still ongoing behind the scenes! We'll have more to reveal in the new year, but we appreciate everyone's support and patience in the meantime. Stay tuned! ːdeeperwrenchː

Since the last announcement, there have been questions about the status of our upcoming update that we teased recently, and some pretty understandable confusion on why we didn't announce anything else the month we said we were going to... announce more stuff. 😅  I want to quickly address that here.

First of all, I apologize to everyone for causing so much confusion with our last announcement post. Originally we were slated to have more to show that month, but development delays caused it to get pushed back repeatedly since, and we're currently still waiting on the go-ahead from third party sources before we can properly announce or reveal anything further.

It's a mess caused by a bit of overly optimistic scheduling and an eagerness to share on my part, so again I do apologize, but rest assured that development is still underway!

Happy Diving,

Nick from Deli Interactive

notes.title: Anniversary Sale and Major Update News!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/e36547929305778e3f1d04a6798c9ce19b6a5270.gif[/img]

This month, we're celebrating We Need To Go Deeper's 4 Year Full Launch Anniversary! We're kicking things off with a whopping [b]69% Off Daily Deal[/b], and throughout the month of August we're hoping to share some exciting developments on We Need To Go Deeper, starting with today's news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/307110/We_Need_To_Go_Deeper/

[h2]WNTGD NEWS #1 - LOCALIZATION IS COMING![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/154e34a28d1a07e3e062304a75bb7d34f735f62e.png[/img]

Over the past year and change, we've teamed up with game publisher [b]Graffiti Games[/b] and development team [b]3OGS[/b] to bring some major changes to We Need To Go Deeper, and one of those has been the major undertaking of [b]localizing the game to a whopping 8 new languages,[/b] including Spanish, French, Latin American Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese!

It's hard to overstate what an incredible undertaking this is taking to achieve, but we're pumped about being able to open up the game to a much wider player-base in the near future as a result!

Stay tuned throughout our anniversary month for more We Need To Go Deeper news!

[h2]MORE FROM DELI INTERACTIVE[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DC0HxZz.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, development also continues as we approach our 1.0 update with our Early Access summer camp sim, [b]Camp Canyonwood![/b] Our upcoming 1.0 update is going to come chock-full of fixes, quality of life improvements, fixes, and more fixes!

If you haven't yet taken a look at our make-your-own-perfectly-safe-summer-camp simulator, there's no better time than now as we put the finishing touches on our newest 4-years-in-the-making project!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374170/Camp_Canyonwood/

notes.title: Our Newest Game, Camp Canyonwood, Has Launched!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ugm_zY6ZQtg;full][/previewyoutube]
The creative team behind [b]We Need To Go Deeper[/b] have been working hard this past couple years on our newest game, taking you out of the wet depths of the ocean and up into the dry forested lands of [b]Camp Canyonwood! [/b]And today, we're proud to finally launch it into Steam Early Access!

[h3]ːwinter2019surprisedyulː NOW AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE - CAMP CANYONWOOD![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374170/Camp_Canyonwood/

Camp Canyonwood is a single player management sim that tasks you with building and managing a struggling summer camp. You'll watch over groups of campers each summer, trying to keep them happy and earning badges while protecting them from whatever lurks in the woods, or the skies...

If you enjoyed WNTGD, we hope you'll find a lot to love in Camp Canyonwood! Our Early Access experience with Deeper showed us how awesome it can be to develop a game alongside an active community, so we hope you'l join us again on this development journey!

[h3]ːwinter2019surprisedyulː A Quick WNTGD News Update[/h3]

Don't worry We Need To Go Deeper fans, our journey with WNTGD isn't over yet either. We've been quietly brewing up a sizable announcement, but we can't say anything just yet. Keep your eyes peeled! More We Need To Go Deeper updates are on the way!

notes.title: The Quantum Update (v1.5)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=wLdbAB_UfVo;full][/previewyoutube]
A new biome has arrived, and it's chaos incarnate.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW Biome: The Micro Depths[/b]- A chaotic new 2nd layer biome filled with microscopic monstrosities that aren't so microscopic any more. Behemoth viruses, bacteria, and protozoa populate these hazy waters, alongside the remnants of an atom-age experiment gone wrong. 
 
[*][b]NEW Enemies[/b] - The enlarged denizens of The Micro Depths are a uniquely erratic threat, with many able to replicate themselves, conglomerate together into self-healing configurations, or extend out sticky substances to drain anything that comes near.

[*][b]NEW Affliction[/b] - The waters here are capable of changing the atomic structure of any who are exposed to it for extended periods, introducing a new affliction known as Atomic Disorder. Should you contract it, Atomic Disorder will rearrange your atoms into smaller or larger configurations at random.

[*][b]NEW Boss[/b] - An enlarged protozoa known only as [b]The Hydra [/b]guards the exit to these depths. If the wild flaying of its facial tendrils don't kill you first, one of its many budding offspring will.

[*][b]NEW Civilization[/b] - The Micronauts' research base is said to still remain in these waters, alongside much of their abandoned equipment.
[/list]

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Two new achievements [/b]have been added - Herculean and Mi-nope-sis.
[*][b]Updated network tools[/b] - should result in possibly improved cross-platform support, as well as overall smoother experience connecting to lobbies.
[*]Awakened Mode fix - Players should no longer be able to join Awakened Mode games in progress once they've started.
[*]Fixed broken reference preventing the "not enough money" message from appearing in the catalog.
[*]Atomique colliders reduced to allow it to fit in tighter spaces.
[*]Backend for universal enemy spawning fixed, should result in more reliable event enemy spawn rates.
[/list]

[h1]Buried Treasure Edition Add-ons[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/db1ebf5e9a584494a7a6b92ee0fb8d98bc360e3c.png[/img]

Those of you who own the Buried Treasure DLC have some new surprises in store! With the new biome comes [b]two new music tracks that we've added to the soundtrack[/b]! In addition, we've also compiled together a [b]Bonus Artbook [/b] PDF that showcases concept art and development history on We Need To Go Deeper's post-launch content! You get all this for FREE if you own the Buried Treasure DLC!

------------------

As always, let us know what you think of the new update! Happy Diving!

notes.title: Deli Interactive's 2021 Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/a8fd4c5fb98c8bef7be4c249f39b6c8f4873c1b4.png[/img]

We'd be lying if we said the chaos that was 2020 didn't set our team back from where we wanted to be, but in the spirit of the new year, we're hitting the ground running and we wanted to let y'all know where we're heading!

While you'll note that there are no dates listed here to keep our development schedule flexible, the general order and placement is more or less what we predict for the coming year for WNTGD and our latest project, Camp Canyonwood!

First thing on the agenda is of course, delivering the new submarine we've been teasing out over the past few months, which now has a name - [b]The Atomique.[/b] You'll be able to pilot this nuclear powerhouse very, very soon, as we'll be entering into the beta phase this month!

Next, we have some serious fixes and improvements coming to WNTGD, focusing first and foremost on connectivity problems stemming from our current toolset's limitations, so migrating over to some new toolsets will be a priority.

Meanwhile we're also preparing for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374170/Camp_Canyonwood/]Camp Canyonwood[/url]'s first steps into its beta phase, and we couldn't be more excited to get it in the hands of real players! Development is picking up pace for our little summer camp simulator, and we've recently started a video devlog series to chronicle its progress! You can see the first episode here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dEklknYTVH0

Later in the year you'll see we then have more content and changes coming to Deeper, which we'll start to talk about in more specifics as we come closer to their arrival.

Thanks again everyone for your continued support, and we hope you'll enjoy what's to come!

notes.title: Future Update News
notes.notes:
Hey!

So if you read our[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/2736452055728245962] last update's announcement [/url]or else if you've ever visited one of our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/deliinteractive]weekly developer streams[/url], you may recall that we announced we were working on releasing a new DLC submarine. 

While that is still in progress, we have recently had to switch gears to focusing on implementing a new set of connection tools since, long story short, the ones we're using now (which we only had to switch to since Unity abandoned theirs) have proven themselves to not be quite up to the task at getting players connected reliably across different operating systems and network types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/c4dafa068d5abc085959ee6b5792c07f8fb744eb.png[/img]

While our network engineer Jordan dives back into the trenches to sort out the new system (thanks Unity), the rest of us will be focusing on a [b]small free content update[/b] for We Need To Go Deeper to help tide folks over while the new submarine is in stasis. It will be focused largely on adding new run-based items that further mix up your future expeditions, including upgrades that should add some interesting new wrinkles to combat!

We appreciate all the reports and logs folks have been sending to help us nail down the specifics of these issues. We deeply apologize to anyone who has been having difficulties getting connected with this most recent system, but we're doing everything we can to ensure the smoothest experience for everyone! Which is why we're pivoting to make this a priority! We're an incredibly small team so these things take more time than we'd like sometimes. Feel free to reach out to our team members directly if you ever want more hands-on assistance or have any pressing questions.

[b]Jordan[/b] (Programmer/Network Engineer) jordan.farr@deliinteractive.com
[b]Nick[/b] (Artist/Programmer) nick.lives@deliinteractive.com
[b]David[/b] (Music/Sound) david.johnsen@deliinteractive.com

Happy Diving!

- Nick

notes.title: QOL Update #1 (v1.2)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/d531b94b863b84280212ac6d2a46db985dc35a04.png[/img]

IT'S ALIVE! We've been hard at work smacking the gears and tweaking bolts behind the scenes when we aren't cowering in our quarantine cave, but now the fruits of our labors are yours! YOURS! It's a Quality of Life Update! ːchemistrykitː Read the full change-log below and stick around for a peek at what's next!

[h1]THE CHANGES. THE CHANGES!![/h1]
[list]
[*] Connections Overhaul - A new connections system has been implemented, and as a result, connecting to other players should be a far more painless and reliable process! This was a nightmare!
[*] Civilization Shop Names - Items available in civilization shops now display the name of the item on sale when examined, to better help new players identify items and make more informed choices.
[*] Paperless Chat Text - A new option is available to remove the paper background from in-game chat, displaying instead crisp light text with a subtle drop shadow. Improves readability and just looks nicer if you prefer dark mode settings!
[*] Obituary Improvements - Some subtle tweaks to obituary graphic elements to make them look a bit nicer, and added "titles" designating each player a personality trait to be remembered by.
[*] New Achievements - 2 new achievements related to Awakened Mode have been added, one for beating the game in Awakened Mode, the other for capturing your first pet.
[*] When in caves, bots asked to heal will now follow whoever needs healing the most.
[*] Added an option to force relay connections for players who still have trouble with direct connection methods
[*] Potential fix for the Diplomat Achievement not unlocking for some players.
[*] Slightly increased the time chat messages remain on screen.
[*] Removed UPNP options as these are no longer an issue
[*] Fixed LAN lobbies not showing which vessel is in use
[*] Reduced the number of online services our online play relies on from 3 to 2. Hooray for fewer points of failure!
[/list]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

Now for a little peek at what we're working on next for WNTGD - our very first DLC Submarine! It doesn't have a name just yet, but it's shaping up to be quite the interesting (and hazardous) metal beast. Here's a look at its design concept!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/e712ef5fe720a1b6bd112af8faaa7708ffdafdb7.gif[/img]

Strange, no? We're excited to show more of our work as it develops, which you can peep early during our developer streams every Saturday, 12:00PM MST on our official [url=www.twitch.tv/deliinteractive]Twitch Channel[/url]. Let us know what you think!

Happy Diving!

notes.title: The Awakened Update (v1.1) | New Game Mode, Pets, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/ad9f9532d5d530668982f78bcf9fdf7c3c995490.png[/img]

Awaken your senses in The Awakened Update! A brand new unlockable game mode, complete with new enemies, unlockable pets, and rules for those hungry for a fresh challenge. Full info below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/d64412304ddcdf6c5b4dc8a2a8b93034bc315fb8.png[/img]

ːdeeperskullː [b]New Game Mode: "Awakened Mode"[/b]

After discovering the bottom, seasoned adventurers will find a peculiar "Wake Lantern" appearing in their catalog. This is your ticket into [b]a brand new hardcore game mode[/b] with its own set of quirks and rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/2da03183b3f32162468cb69623b11c2962c79fcd.png[/img]

ːdeeperskullː [b]Perma-Perma Death:[/b]

In Awakened Mode, you reveal the true nature of The Living Infinite through your wake lantern, but it comes at the cost of your mortal souls.[b] Revival is no longer an option[/b], once a crew member dies, they die for good. [i]This also means players can't join an Awakened Mode game mid-way through, so make sure you have a full crew prepared before your voyage![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/5fb34342180dcf30d155d37a263048dad262b67d.png[/img]

ːdeeperskullː [b]New Foes:[/b]

The truth of the lantern reveals [b]new dangerous entities in each biome[/b], and attracts attention from a terrifying presence - The Shambler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/4b5c98798ba00d652bd293fa243809f225ec56a2.png[/img]

ːdeeperskullː [b]The Shambler:[/b]

The Shambler will pursue your crew relentlessly throughout your journey. Though what it wants is uncertain, it certainly seems interested in taking your crew members to strange, alien dimensions, each with different properties. [b]It can't be killed, so it's best to just stay out of its grasp.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/a3366b36ca8e5f937b413b9f75b93f1d47e5131f.png[/img]

ːdeeperskullː [b]Pets:[/b]

The lantern reveals more than just new dangers however, it also seems to cause a strange collision of realities, resulting in the creation of a wide variety of friendly critters. [b]Find these reality collisions and break them open to reveal new unlockable friends[/b] - just know some accidents of nature are cuter than others...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25605478/0b3f883a4c03b94fbb2ddb12d4448c81e88d3fc1.png[/img]

ːdeeperskullː [b]New Rank - Acolyte:[/b]

Finally, for those who have dedicated themselves to the abyss long enough,[b] a new rank awaits, along with two new horrifying rewards[/b] to honor their newfound dedication to the things that lie in the deep.

-------------

Thanks again to all of the brave crews that tested the waters in the beta version, so that we can bring you the final version of We Need To Go Deeper's first free content update! Happy diving as always, and let us know what you think of the new content!

notes.title: v1.0.0f1 Patch
notes.notes:
Our first post 1.0 release patch is here, and should hopefully address some of the newer issues you've reported from the 1.0 update, as well as a few sticklers! Full change log below.

[h1]Change Log[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added extra safeguards to prevent "zombie lobbies" (lobbies that stay up after the game has ended) from popping up. This caused a larger fail rate when joining games since many had already ended but failed to close.
[*] Added a fix for the DSR feature in some video cards causing crashes.
[*] Fixed an issue causing machines to display an improper 640x480 resolution, related to our previous fix.
[*] Fixed bots not always reviving correctly.
[*] Fixed Med Bots only healing clients to 10 rather than full health.
[*] Fixed cases where Stargazer enemy would fail to show up for clients.
[*] Fixed certain resolution options setting incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a few rare cases where "double joining" was possible.
[*] First test case fix for the host/client revive bug. Let us know if this one stuck around or if it appears to be gone now!
[/list]

Thar be monsters ‘ere, sailor. Arr, legend foretells of vessels getting lost in these seas. Crews abandoning all hope. Great, magnificent ships leaving port with a belly full of gold, never to be heard for again. Take it from an ol’ sea dog, kid, there be perils aplenty on the early access waters. A welcome sight indeed, says I, when a ship returns with a haul and a hope to make it out to launch.

Sailor talk aside, jolly old submarine-with-your-friends adventure We Need To Go Deeper set sail for a full release this week.

notes.title: Version 1.0 has LAUNCHED!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CBM-pYmccHE][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7bc5617d612e9f0bcf12bae8247871e05e13da07.png[/img][/url]
[i]Check out our new Launch Trailer, lovingly crafted by Joshua Cauller![/i]

2.5 years and [b]112 updates[/b] later, we have finally surfaced from the murky depths of Early Access! It's been quite the voyage these past 6 years going from college dorks messing around with a weird game idea in our mothers' basements (thanks mom!), to regular adult dorks actually bringing said idea to life alongside a dedicated community! 

And I mean it when I say this community has been crazy helpful, and a genuine partner in the collaborative process that is game development. Even the number of updates I mentioned above I only know offhand thanks to the constantly updated, fan-maintained [url=https://weneedtogodeeper.gamepedia.com/We_Need_To_Go_Deeper_Wiki]Official Wiki[/url]. Not to mention the numerous Discord Bots, [url=https://github.com/NateKomodo/WeNeedToModDeeper-Engine/]Modding Tools[/url], and countless forum threads that all helped shape the game or its community growth in some way. 

As a matter of fact, here's a sample of some of the features that literally wouldn't exist without the community's suggestions and feedback. [b]None of these were planned [/b]when we started out in Early Access, but the game is far better for them.
[list]
[*] Lairs/Lair Guardian
[*] The Trash Hermit
[*] Fuel/Boosting
[*] Torpedo Mods
[*] The EMP
[*] Bots/Recruitable NPCs
[*] The Time Devourer
[/list]
All in all, we couldn't be happier with how the Early Access program let us shape a better game together, and going forward we're still very interested in what the community would like to see in WNTGD's future! [b]There's still more to come[/b], and not knowing what could be is half the fun!

[h1]Buried Treasure Edition[/h1]

You may have also noticed that there's a new special version of the game out now that comes with a bunch of cool bonus materials. I furnished a [b]197 page Art Book[/b] that covers the game's 6 year journey, and it includes the [b]full soundtrack[/b] along with [b]13 bonus tracks[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2c2ca22959070861b7305e251c6a19620ef30b4d.png[/img]

Oh, and if you bought the game during Early Access, you get all of that for free as a thanks for your support! :messagebottle: You can find the bonus content in your regular WNTGD install location, in a folder entitled "Buried Treasure Bonus Materials"

[h1]Change Log (v1.0)[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new Ancient Abyss track to its biome.
[*] Fixed a bot regression in which they would frequently stop reviving players mid-revive.
[*] Implemented global block list to combat persistent trolls.
[*] Added intro cutscene.
[*] Removed POTM banner.
[*] Removed empty loadout slots.
[*] Fixed Eldritch Staff relic not showing up in relics room.
[*] Added two new message bottle relics.
[*] Updated dynamite sound.
[*] Fixed typo in dynamite description.
[/list]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Am I forgetting anything? Well, I hope you enjoy the finished product! Happy diving. :deeperwrench:

notes.title: Version 1.0 Launches August 1st!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b802004832e1c43b53221b96d7b3a2400d5d4dac.png[/img]

As some of you may already know, our graduation from Early Access is soon upon us, scheduled for [b]August 1st,[/b] less than a month from now! I'm not shaking, you're shaking.

For those of you just arriving or who haven't heard, [b]here's what to expect for 1.0 launch and beyond:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]The base price will increase to $15.99! [/b]'Cause we're worth it, baby.
[*] [b]New updates will still be coming! [/b]Just not on the monthly/weekly basis you Early Access folks are used to. But rest assured, there's more coming!
[*] We'll be offering a super special, real cool, more expensive version of the game because isn't that what always happens.[b] The Buried Treasure Edition [/b]will come with a PDF art book of all our miserable failed creations throughout development, and an expanded soundtrack with unused tracks.
[*] Since it gets asked a lot, YES we will be considering paid DLC [i]on top of[/i] the free post-launch updates, as these can help continue to support the game's ongoing life.
[*][b]Leaderboards will be reset for full launch[/b], so say a tearful goodbye to your current scores.
[/list]

Whoo! Okay, I think that's the big stuff. What you can expect from us through the course of this next month is a steady stream of fixes and a few quality-of-life stuff, like the much-requested [b]block[/b] feature for those persistent trolls, along with finishing-touches stuff like an intro cutscene! We're down in the nitty gritty now y'all. Get hype.

On that note, we just pushed a few fixes for some broken achievements today, here are the ones that should be fixed now:

[list]
[*] Put Your Little Hand In Mine
[*] Deep Sea Diplomats
[*] Resourceful
[/list]

Happy diving as always, let us know what you want to see in WNTGD's future!

notes.title: The Bottom Update (0.9.7) | Final Encounter
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7ots7zR.gif[/img]

This month, we have finally made it. The end game, the final encounter, what lurks at the bottom of The Living Infinite. We're very excited for you all to discover it. This is [b]The Bottom Update.[/b] :deeperskull:


[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/5577dd0f3a435efb635bb012d9672afb274b8e88.png[/img]

[b]The Final Encounter[/b] -  An end-game encounter, complete with bizarre [b]boss fights [/b](yes, plural), [b]cryptic messages[/b], two [b]new original tracks[/b], and [b]multiple endings[/b], awaits your crew at the bottom of the trench. We want you all to discover it for yourselves, so we'll try not to spoil much here. But we will say that if you still wish to loop instead of ending your run upon reaching the bottom, that The Time Traveler will still await you so long as you don't.... well, we'll let you see for yourself.

Without being able to show much [i]about [/i]the final encounter, this may seem like a smaller update, but we spent the whole month just working on this and some preparatory work for Achievements. All so we can try wrapping up a very satisfying end-game, so we hope it was well worth it. 

With that said, the final encounter is definitely going to be in need of some fine-tuning and polish, [b]so let us know what you think and keep sending feedback our way![/b]

notes.title: The Eldritch Update (0.9.5) | The Final Biome
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/17fb5259a4326aa443e00392ff839397b5953dc1.png[/img]

[i]My dear colleagues, what I have witnessed cannot be described in our finite language. What lurks beyond [b]the deepest threshold[/b] are sights that should remain unseen. Writhing horrors, extra-dimensional geometry, and blasphemous designs no benevolent ruler would ever see fit for existence. [b]Turn back while you can.[/b][/i]

[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0ByZs7eOh-DBpM0piQ2RTX3BmTFk?usp=sharing]Full Image Download Available Here[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7822b38bc5ab225f2dd1b36b3bec6f912f05b298.png[/img]

[h1]The Final Biome[/h1]

The 10th and final biome has arrived, and we couldn't be more excited to start getting your feedback. Full disclosure, [b]the biome is only partially finished[/b], but we hope to add the rest of the intended content in by the end of the month. We don't want to spoil too much, as a big part of this biome is discovering things for yourself, but here's a few things you'll likely need to know:

[list]
[*] [b]There are no safe spots to park in this biome.[/b] That means no caves, no lairs, no civilizations, zip. This is intended to be a sort of final gauntlet/challenge for your crew, so be sure you have everything you need by the end of the 4th biome.

[*] [b]The biome has no boss yet[/b], only a placeholder while we work on the more involved encounter which will serve as the game's final boss.

[*] [b]Communication is vital.[/b] We are designing this biome to really test communication among players, so be vocal and be vigilant. This will of course mean that we may have extra problems with [b]Bot AI[/b] in this biome, so bear with us as we bring them up to date with new mechanics.
[/list]

With that, good luck and have fun, and be sure to leave us plenty of feedback on the new content!

[h1]The End is Nigh[/h1]

The end of our Early Access road is scheduled to come to an end this Summer, with our full release headed for June! On that note, I figured it might be a good time to recap a few things you can expect for full release and onward:

[list]
[*] [b]The base price WILL increase for full launch.[/b] As we've stated since the beginning, the base price of We Need To Go Deeper will indeed increase once we're fully launched. So now is the time if you still want to take advantage of the game at its current price.

[*] [b]The game will still be updated![/b] We do indeed want to keep adding content to the game post-launch for as long as is viable, and we're very serious about clamping down on any bugs/issues that happen to persist past launch. You can definitely expect at minimum a few sizable content updates in the full release's future in addition to patches and support! So keep letting us know what you'd most like to see!

[*] [b]The full soundtrack will be available FREE![/b] While we already offer the soundtrack via our SoundCloud, many of you have been asking for a full, easily downloadable version of the soundtrack, and you will get just that on launch day! 
[/list]

[h1]Fixes + Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added fail-safe to avoid saving corrupted rank data.
[*] Multiple injection behavior fixed (Narwhals, etc can now again inject their noses more than just once) 
[*] Reduced meat boulder damage 60%
[*] Reduced meat boulder falling speed 25%
[*] Increased spawn wait interval for nematodes from 2 seconds to 6 seconds
[*] Reduced nematode sight radius 33%
[*] Added a bunch of new dialog to every civilization!
[/list]

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

This month's Player of the Month has been with the WNTGD community for nearly two full years, and while they've been POTM once before in the past, we felt with their recent and frequent contributions, feedback, and extreme dedication to maintaining the We Need To Go Deeper Wiki and Forums, on top of their generally fun and playful attitude, that they truly earned the spot again. Congrats again [b]ADcrafter[/b], we're grateful to have you in the community!

[b]::: Community Highlights :::[/b]

First off, a big shoutout to [b]Wrzlprnft[/b] for his work on the new [url=www.discord.gg/wntgd]Discord[/url] bot, which now sorts active players when they are in-game, and allows you to flag yourself as looking for fellow crew members! It's super convenient and displays live players in the Discord right in the roles section, so you can jump right into a crew! Thank you Wrzlprnft! 

Be sure to join our Discord community if you haven't already!

www.discord.gg/wntgd

Now, we appear to have missed a few awesome art pieces last time we did one of these, so please enjoy the belated showcase of fan art!

These hand-drawn pieces by [b]The Frog Archer[/b] capture the hidden beauty of our limb-deficient cephalopods.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1EYKIbB.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XeEci3N.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, these animations from [b]Sakke[/b] take a trip into Eldritch horrors.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9kWoy8I.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A6tBaiM.gif[/img]

-----------------------------------------------------------------

That's all she wrote! Be sure and let us know what y'all think of the new update, and happy diving!

notes.title: The Leftovers Update (0.9.1) | Fixes, Tweaks, Polish!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dc0eb2f7818f159217fe424f2787508cc2e0e00f.png[/img]

This month is all about forgotten leftovers, and boy do we have a bundle of them for ya in this month's content update! Asset replacements, camera tweaks, back-end number crunching. Many things we shoulda done but haven't yet!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/5f4fb13bac13bfdb9dbe8b090ffd16f4841e4cdc.png[/img]

[b]New Flee Critters![/b]- 3 New fleeing critter types for the Dark Depths, Ancient Abyss and Volcanic Depths have appeared, known as the Macrourus, Glisten Fish, and Skin Fish respectively. What they lack in bite they make up for in cowardice, adding a little extra life to their respective biomes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0ec4acc2505c0b0630cb94fa32a96e80f13f3fef.png[/img]

[b]Explosion Countdown![/b]- No longer will your submersibles instantly explode when their hull integrity reaches zero, but instead an alarm will sound when the hull is critical, alerting the crew of their imminent destruction, with a 5 second countdown to annihilation once the hull reaches zero. Should you manage to fully repair a leak within that time, however, you may very well avoid death's icy grasp!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0845fc8b3ecdd0215015b2319acb9bc9bf44d86c.png[/img]

[b]2 New Secret Hats![/b]- Two new secret Youtube-inspired hats have been added! This time around, based on two bickering friends who are intimately familiar with nearly all of We Need To Go Deeper's updates... Try their names in the Extras Menu to unlock their respective hats!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e31b47b909a8f5deb8314a3bef34a6b5e61cf4a2.png[/img]

[b]Big List of Fixes/Changes![/b] - The bulk of this update went towards more catchup/cleanup of many different elements! Here's the list in its full glory:

[list][*]Barnacle Hive legs added, can knock the submarine around if they get too close.
[*]Barnacle Hive now shielded everywhere but it's spawner boils and spine.
[*]Ragdoll negative scaling fixed, hopefully should stop weird disconnected ragdolls.
[*]Contrast boosted in caves/expedition zones to make up for some of the lost contrast/color caused by underwater overlay.
[*]Anti-aliasing added to interior camera to be consistent with exterior.
[*]Caves given extra hand-composed decor clusters for variety.
[*]Camera now centers properly during Dinner Sequence.
[*]Dinner Sequence now repairs the ship, heals all players, and cleans up interior enemies for a fresh start.
[*]Nematode given attack animation, no longer does touch damage.
[*]Ephyra red damage projectile no longer shorts consoles.
[*]Jelly Temple given a new more temple-y exterior asset.
[*]Disabled Ultrawide monitor resolutions to avoid confusion until we can officially support it.
[*]Added refresh rate to monitor resolution dropdown info.
[*]Ephyra boss has a new rotate-y attack pattern and increased projectile size, but now only spawns projectiles from specific spots.
[*]New "faux random" function to clamp down on the limits of bad luck for certain items. Now instead of pure RNG this faux random will only make so many bad rolls before it defaults to the desired outcome, after which it switches back to RNG. Items with faux random: Butcher Knife, Pickaxe, Eldritch Staff.
[*]Player-based "knockback" feedback added for incoming damage. Now you'll really feel the oomph of a crab's claw swipes!
[/list]

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

This month's Player of the Month is [b]Lock![/b]

Though he's a "lock" of many names, Lock is a frequent and friendly voice among our Discord and Livestreams, always stopping by to liven things up with his variety of topics and banter. Similarly, he's been spotted on the Discord answering questions for new players, and has been known to frequently stream We Need To Go Deeper on his own Twitch channel as well! Thanks for keeping our community lively, Lock!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks to everyone who's been sticking around to keep giving feedback as we are on our sprint to the finish line! We hope Deeper is slowly but surely shaping up for its 1.0 release!

notes.title: The Beastly Update (0.9) | New Bosses!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8d070381081b86e36dd71dd357e66928c331b1f6.png[/img]

Get snarly for February's content update, and We Need To Go Deeper's [b]two year anniversary[/b] month! This month, we have no less than 3 new beastly bosses, enemy improvements, fixes, and more!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/218486506ac90bce9df847443ad51dd9da5c241c.png[/img]

[b]NEW Boss: The Leviathan! - [/b]The beast of legends, [b]The Leviathan[/b] has revealed itself within the Cursed Waters, lurking in a boney graveyard. Not only is this a fearsome beast with its hull-shattering beak and claws, but she's clever too, known to dash away only to ambush its prey from new angles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/bc15eab88c8a7b8bdac649c84062e127971b4570.png[/img]

[b]NEW Boss: The Sightless! - [/b] These slithering twin eels lurk in the shadowy Dark Depths, each blind in their own way. Luckily for them, a scent and sound is all they need to track down and surprise their prey by bursting out of the very soil they reside within.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/897c3a8bd8ae7b3e51d3df7219a4b6bc72bba3ba.png[/img]

[b]NEW Boss: The Erupting Shell! - [/b] Smoldering no more, this gargantuan tortoise in the Volcanic Depths has developed none other than an entire erupting volcano on its rocky exterior! Boiling with rage inside and out, the Erupting Shell will protect its vent-heated domain at any cost.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/39894a7ff278af7e018a2c0760c656922deb8dd1.png[/img]

[b]Smarter Swimmers! - [/b] The AI of your average swimming foe has been improved! Swimming enemies can now better target their prey to aim their attacks where it really counts! Additionally, swimmers now know when they've been outmatched, and will temporarily flee the scene if things are looking bad for them. This will also allow for a new variety of swimmer types in future, as fleeing behavior can be tweaked on a per-enemy basis!

[h1]Fixes and Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Barnacle mines can no longer be spawned infinitely during sub-biomes.
[*]Lair Guardian ragdoll can no longer be farmed indefinitely.
[*]Butcher knife now only creates meat from dead bodies/ragdolls.
[*]Several colliders fixed to prevent ground-based enemies from floating.
[*]Enemy sound effects given random pitch variance.
[*]Mud Giant's sucking ability tweaked to prevent cheesing.
[*]Rare Mud Giant "disappearing" bug fixed with cave console timeout.
[*]Fixed a bug causing slow enemy turning.
[*]Improved charging behavior math.
[*] fixed a visual glitch causing bubbles to appear in between layers of the Pale Whale.
[/list]

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

February's Player of the Month is [b]Fish Fish[/b]! Fish Fish has been a frequent friendly community member for nearly two years, and for those years, has been a great easy-going but persistent mod for the community Discord, friendly to talk to, and often hops into games with other community goers. Fish Fish is a great example of the kind of person you want in any healthy game community, and for that, they are February's Player of the Month!

------------------------------------------------------------------

With this update, we've now cleansed WNTGD of all placeholder bosses, so now is the time to ensure all bosses are up to snuff with a final product! Hit us up with all your cheesing strats, bugs, etc. as we ramp up for the full release out of early access this year! Happy two years everyone!

notes.title: Content Drop: Fixer Upper #4
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b05394057895c9d7d92980b7eb5c638ddfdf5f7a.png[/img]

The last fix drop of the month, but certainly not the last round of fixes we'll need before release. This time up, we're tackling saves again! Namely addressing saving/loading between multiple steam accounts and cloud save issues. The specific fixes are below:

[list][*]Added sub-folders to keep track of which steam account a save was made in to address multi-account save overwrite errors. [b]This will not be able to "rescue" saves that were previously affected unfortunately, but is meant to prevent future occurrences.[/b] 

[*]Added backup saving system to create automatic backups of save files in your Steam ID subfolder when creating new saves.
[/list]

[b]ATTENTION: For ensuring your saves during this transition phase, please make a backup copy of your .data files located at [i]C:\Users\(you)\AppData\LocalLow\Deli Interactive\We Need to Go Deeper[/i] and keep them handy for this initial process. Since we didn't track Steam IDs before this patch, the issue could still occur in saves created prior to the patch, so ensure your saves if you have a machine with multiple users. After the update, this should no longer occur, however. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/47028c3639dfd3f94bb87821006873ea0d2b8bf0.png[/img]

notes.title: The Nuts & Bolts Update (0.8.8) | Fixes Galore!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dy8B3O5.gif[/img]

Over the past year, we've added a lot of new features! But with those features, comes new bugs, and new problems. This month, we decided to crack down on as many bugs and fine-tune as much we could muster! Check out the full list below!

[h1]Fixes and Tweaks[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1e4fb81c20fc9653579cc79ebac6c8e99ba81d08.png[/img]

[list][*] Loadout UI is now way less fickle.
[*] Brig camera should no longer go out of bounds.
[*] Fixed safe dynamite/backpack custom settings exploit.
[*] Fixed harpoons not damaging Mechanical Eyes.
[*] Level Up UI now has accompanying sound effects.
[*] Fixed certain interior explosions not dealing damage.
[*] Fixed certain exterior explosions not dealing damage.
[*] Fixed recruit bots not displaying proper corpses to clients.
[*] Aurelian and Mechanical rubble pile visuals updated.
[*] Fixed battery duping exploit.
[*] Fixed harpoons getting stuck in Espadon's nose.
[*] Optimized harpoon effect lifespan.
[*] Gold and Chat UI should no longer "peek" out on higher res monitors.
[/list]

[h1]New Website![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b6c0ae6044f8b533e5b65232ff303ff4f75f3a1a.png[/img]

We also spent some time this month putting together a proper company website better fit for 2019, and with an actual domain. Look ma, we're a real company now! 

[b]WWW.DELIINTERACTIVE.COM[/b]

If you like our work, you should [b]sign on to our Newsletter[/b] to stay up to date on our current and future projects! C'mon, you know you [i]want[/i] to. *Instigates peer pressure gaze*

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Community Highlights :::[/b]

This month, we've seen an awful lot of cool WNTGD-inspired artwork coming out of user [b]Sakke[/b] in our Discord community! Some of it is even animated in Unity, giving it that authentic WNTGD feel! Here are just a few embeddable highlights:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c3381761ab1f460b667f95e0a5a309593601dc19.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/5fcd52b2dad7ec41f4d0cad0420924fce7592917.png[/img]

Click to see some animated ones here:

https://i.gyazo.com/bbe8157460bf3109f3778f04ab57aacd.mp4

https://gyazo.com/a17f227d80b5692b921041986d7921ec

In other news, user [b]NateKomodo[/b] is at it again with building out even more modding capability into his custom mod engine, even going so far as bringing some of [b]Goober[/b]'s creations to life in-game recently!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a003e48b1eef5732665c1fa522d80f2922d97a20.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d47bbdc607cbbdbc529299731e81d65d65252765.png[/img]

Finally, we have also been seeing some good old fashioned pen-and-pencil pieces on the Discord! Here are just a couple highlights:

From user [b]bin[/b]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2e330020467961eab486ce21aabd6e575448fb51.png[/img]

From user [b]The 🅱oly 🅱eanut[/b]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a90529da64a38f7949fc599599c6a730eab39f96.jpg[/img]

Thanks everyone for sharing your passion with us! This is seriously always so  amazing to see all these works you guys make. :D

Incidentally, one last quick shoutout to [b]ADcrafter[/b] who has, to this day, been updating and maintaining our official Wiki [i]constantly[/i] to keep it up to date, consistently sending us error logs, and has just been an all around helpful dude in the community. You rock, man.

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

This month's player of the month is [b]alpinobanshee[/b]! 

Ever-frequenting the forums, alpinobanshee has been vigilant in letting their voice be heard about many topics, and has provided a wealth of interesting suggestions and ideas, while giving feedback and contributing to others' threads as well! All of this while still remaining civil in the forums and with others, which can be a rare trait for opinionated folks! For that, we want to recognize alpinobanshee as January's player of the month. Congrats!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Let us know what y'all think of the new update as always, and we'll try our best to continue cracking down on bugs as we come closer to a full release! 

We're nearly at the two year mark now, which is totally insane to think about. But the finale is on the horizon we swear!

notes.title: The Bond Update (0.8.7) | New Boss, Items, Enemies + More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/ce0b961da08065815038321f1abf0340c7f3a9f8.png[/img]

Share a loving bond for December's official content update! This month is all about bonding, so that means a new boss, items, and enemies! It fits the theme I swear, bear with me here.

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6779d04f1e4797ba7e1fa90e48417a6f230a3081.png[/img]

[b]NEW Boss - The Pale Whale! -[/b] There's no greater bond than the bond of obsession, and what greater obsession is there than the legendary [strike]White[/strike] Pale Whale himself! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/97huniT.gif[/img]

Still bearing the harpoons from his previous stalkers, this mighty [b]Frozen Waters boss[/b] lies waiting in a tomb of icebergs for his next victim. Don't let his size fool you, he's as fast and aggressive as they come, and armed with a blowhole known to project [b]ensaring bubbles[/b] and the occasional [b]clingy starfish![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b7a2afaa5434a7840dc983a6b2688ffac96b7654.png[/img]

[b]NEW Item - The Wedding Ring! -[/b] There is no bond more meaningful, however, than the bond of marriage. And with the new [b]Wedding Ring[/b] item, you can [i]finally[/i] marry* other players! Simply propose to a fellow crewmate by lightly tapping them with the ring, and if they accept, your very life essence will be BONDED, till death do you part!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gu13BHu.gif[/img]

[b]*3 of the 4 developers are Legally Ordained Ministers. Does this make all in-game marriages legally binding? We'll let [i]you[/i] be the judge.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/de1662bc7b6d02cefb3d854dcedaf0d66721dafa.png[/img]

[b]NEW Item - The Tesla Crank! -[/b] The item every dedicated engineer has been waiting for has arrived! There's no bond like an electric bond, and that's just what you create with the Tesla Crank!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F9UPjIe.gif[/img]

Simply walk up to a console and hold the action button to build up a charge. The longer you crank, the bigger the charge buildup, and the more you can boost the energy of any given console! These boosts don't last long, however, so crank wisely!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d84e45d32187cdea11e9d92f1b96ad8f48fb7bce.png[/img]

[b]NEW Enemy - The Mechanical Hunters! -[/b] A new enemy has arrived in the Mechanical Abyss in the form of the Mechanical Hunters! These horrid creatures were made to sail around in their strange vessel searching for biological life to BOND their vessel with. There are four hunters per vessel, so keep a close eye out for these things, unless meeting these cyclopian intruders is on your bucket list.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e5cbb9c2c6ab5f06cff7efd4a069197efe2585b1.png[/img]

[b]NEW Lobby & In-Game Host Options! -[/b] New frequently requested host options have been introduced to lobbies and the in-game tab menu! You can now, at any time:
[list]
[*][b]LOCK and UNLOCK[/b] a game listing, even in the middle of a session! For when all your friends have already joined, but you could stand to meet new people.

[*][b]KICK players[/b] in a lobby or in-game. This one wasn't added lightly, but you guys were pretty loud about your desire for its inclusion. We better not hear about you guys kicking new players just for being new! *Shakes Fist*
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2a7ec0373ea69f2b5dbaffe749aed8a167a583d9.png[/img]

[b]Nematode Spawners! -[/b] These newfound fleshy eggsacs ensure the Sleepy Giant's stomach is always chock full of fresh Nematodes, making this boss fight that much harder.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Lobby UI reworked to accomodate new features. THIN sleek player listings just like momma used to make.
[*] Online lobby listings now also display the submarine being used and whether or not a game is a Custom Game.
[*] Fixed angler fish not showing up on radar.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[h1]Community Highlights[/h1]

This month, user [b]NateKomodo[/b] has created what has to be one of the biggest community creations yet - [b]A We Need To Go Deeper Mod Engine![/b] It serves mainly as an installer and framework for creating your own plugins for WNTGD, and while there aren't many plugins yet, NateKomodo already has a few in the works himself, among them a "Time Traveler's Inter-spatial Store" mod, an "Essentials" mod adding a variety of commands and tools, and others!

[b]These mods will disable leaderboards when used[/b], but can be uninstalled at will. Keeping that in mind, have fun, and thanks NateKomodo for your impressive addition to the community!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a6ce24eb8352436c9867a881e27f68340e63cf4f.png[/img]

Find out more about NateKomo's OPEN SOURCE mod engine and how it works here:

https://github.com/NateKomodo/WeNeedToModDeeper-installer/blob/master/README.md

---------------------------------------------------------------------

Next, we had some more fun and inspired fan art come in through our Steam Community Artwork section! Give these guys some love and leave some likes and comments on their stuff!

[b]La Baleine[/b] - A whale-shaped sub design by [b]Danchigai[/b] and [b]Mammal_man![/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1563286459

[b]Basking Shark[/b] - A wonderfully large-mouthed monster/enemy design concept by [b]rocketguy[/b]!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1562824852

[b]Tetom[/b] - A totem-pole flavored boss concept for the Volcanic Depths by [b]alpinobanshee[/b]!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1579092382

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

December's Player of the Month is [b]NateKomodo[/b]!

Besides their major undertaking with their mod engine, NateKomodo has also proven to be a friendly, communicative, helpful member of the We Need To Go Deeper community. Whether helping fellow players with bugs and issues, or just being a good sport, NateKomodo has proven to be an overall nice dude in addition to his [b]haxxor skilz[/b] and for that we thank you! 

------------------------------------------------------------------

Let us know what y'all think of the new update as always! Happy Bonding!

<3 Pastor Nick

notes.title: The Chow Down Update (0.8.6) | New Boss, Partial Controller Support + More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c7d721a4dae4a67a0a71671a1d416b14b54db9be.png[/img]

Open wide for November's official content update! Big-mouthed giants, in-game gamepad support and other boss improvements await! Dive in if you dare!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/48ae08c404b2ff1c6a1b8064099baf90fc7a0afc.png[/img]

[b]NEW Boss: The Sleepy Giant -[/b] Something large, green, and sleepy awaits now at the bottom of The Prehistoric Depths. Something that is known to swallow whole ships in a single gulp! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5gCRXKb.gif[/img]

This time around, you'll have to fight your way out from the inside. Fend off the nasty flesh-eating Nematodes that infest the giant's innards, destroy the beast's heart, and escape before you are buried in flesh!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZLHxQLV.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/166b6975e2939e76de9df0f4adc55ea8fa2e9a59.png[/img]

[b]Partial Controller Support![/b] - While we are still working on getting menus working with controllers, all [b]in-game activities[/b] can now be enjoyed from the comfort of your couch! Just hop in a game, plug in a Gamepad, and play away! [b]NOTE: You may need to reset your bindings to default for the new controller bindings to take effect.[/b]

Here are the Default bindings, which can be changed anytime from the main menu:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e92381ea1edf239b2cb577923f5fa80d92d1a034.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b5fa170ee6ee353ee72bdfb1b46f3d9ed511ddce.png[/img]

[b]NEW Boss Arenas + Hazards![/b] -  Boss fights are getting a little more developed with new arenas and hazards customized for each boss encounter. Whether you are entering the Quadken's egg nest or the high-security protection of the Ambassador, you are sure to find (nonplaceholder) boss fights a little more challenging!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IQKJqm1.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6419b21eee8ef01f90d3f6c809340941c6f72264.png[/img]

[b]Megalodon Migration[/b] - The Megalodon has since been pushed out of its home by the Sleepy Giant, leaving it no choice but to look for new hunting grounds among the Prehistoric Depths... Let's just hope you don't disturb it on its travels.

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Poubelle now starts with 40 health rather than 30.
[*]The Espadon now starts with 30 health rather than 40. See the switcheroo there?
[*]The EMP can now only be upgraded once, and the Perle starts with its EMP upgrade already applied.
[*]The medkit now has a 10% chance on hit to cure afflictions in the recipient.
[*]Fixed time traveler portal not appearing in Mechanical Waters.
[*]Odobenians no longer swap gender when attacking
[*]Fixed an exploit which enabled over-healing when curing the curse affliction.
[*]Fixed a bug which caused the backpack pickup to still be visible for 3 seconds on anyone's screen who *didn't* pick it up
[*]Improved game-to-game particle cleanup, which should reduce memory footprint when the application has been run a long time.
[*]Fixed the purple potion also doing healing.
[*]Fixed a problem in exterior enemy memory cleanup which was prone to occur near boss fights
[*]Removed Halloween event-specific spawns.
[/list]

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

This month we want to give special thanks to [b]Qansy[/b]! The combination of her screenshots, descriptions, and log files have helped us find some tricky game issues! Thanks for all the help Qansy!

[b]::: Community Highlights :::[/b]

We once again have new fan-made content to show off from the community! As our game grows, so does the community's creativity, thank you all so much for showing your love for WNTGD!

First up, just like last year, the amazing [b]Eve Moran[/b] whipped up another WNTGD themed Halloween costume, this time tackling The Quadken! Hats off to you Eve, you made our day once again with this fantastic creation. <3

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d921fc6a503041e303e378df6e9f90ad5da7d4fe.jpg[/img]

We've also started getting new inspired submarine designs from the community! Let us know if any of these have qualities you'd like to see incorporated in future vessels!

The Baleine by [b]Pietras[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e94cdfdf2cfbdf93e9f5ef77796815b2e44e6b6e.png[/img]

The Vernard and Nuclear Sub by [b]FamiliarBreakfast[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s3SpUJC.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iRHiqpf.png[/img]

And finally, this fan-made creature from [b]Goober[/b]! <3

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/463097531585527818/493116508881420300/Shank.png?width=1202&height=467[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patch 1 notes:
-Fixed duopus eggs not cleaning up on client end between level changes
-Fixed rock-attached hazard angles on client end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks again y'all, and let us know as always what you think of the new update! Happy chomping!

notes.title: Fall Event is Live + New Content Drop!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3514cf2ae3c0b0aa1cfc137b991fc6ad44d096e0.png[/img]

[b]The Heads of the Horseman Fall Event[/b] is back, along with some spooky new content! Fend off horrific produce and legendary ghosts, and earn new special cosmetics for the month of October!
[list]
[*]8 Special Cosmetics!
[*]Horrific Pumpkin foes!
[*]Face The Horseman himself![/list][i]
As the leaves descend from the trees, so too does the vengeful Headless Horseman rise from his resting place, donning atop his head twisted mutations of the season's harvest! Legends say The Horseman's accursed Produce began spreading their own evil seed among the populace, spawning devilish plantlife throughout the world - including the very depths themselves! The Living Infinite is the latest to be infested with this bountiful harvest of hallowed fruit - and The Horseman will hunt down anyone who dares get in his way of reclaiming these lost heads![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a8ac71ef32be271235ce8419df501287c49746bb.png[/img]

[b]The Horseman will return to his grave on November 8th.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dcc5b363b16d086894c74355d34cbf1769556646.png[/img]

Along with the fall event, we have also added some spooky new content in the form of [b]Visual Afflictions[/b] and a brand [b]NEW Affliction[/b] to go with it!

Now, when you become afflicted with one of the Living Infinite's many horrid diseases, your face will reflect your newfound blight for all to see! Now your crewmates will know to avoid you should they not wish to catch your bug!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/ae15cce09a761cdd8802478874300fb7d4130a9f.png[/img]

...and last but not least, a brand NEW Affliction has been introduced, a horrible life-sapping blight known as [b]Blood Sickness![/b] Courtesy of our own community's brainstorming among the forums!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a9de70ca7170749d7c416871ad41483af118254a.png[/img]

Blood Sickness will take its toll on your max health, sapping away 25% of its total until it can be cured. It's a disease contracted by venomous sources such as the bite of a lamprey, the sting of a bee, or poison syringes.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Finally, we've also taken the opportunity to add a few workarounds and fixes to some small things:

[list][*]Mechanical relics have been added to mechanical waters, and now properly display in the relic museum once unlocked.
[*]Added ESC button workaround to main menu, allowing users to bring up the Options panel by pushing ESC should they be stuck in an unusable resolution.
[/list]

And that's all she wrote! Let us know as always what you think of the new content, and happy harvesting!

notes.title: The Oily Update 1/2: (0.8.3) | AI, Damage Overhaul, Optimizations & More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9a09ee3fed687fe5aa479f60a9b9d1301c5eef69.png[/img]

Grease your motor for this month's two-part content update! For Part 1, we have a wide variety of game-wide improvements and changes, along with a taste of this month's new biome coming in full for Part 2! Here's the full details:

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6eedf39d8eabb6fcf89f8dedf542ff46fe6bf737.png[/img]

[b]Improved AI![/b] - Friendly NPCs and Civilizations alike are all getting an intelligence boost! Here are some of their newfound capabilities:
[list]
[*]Door-busters: All Civilizations now have the ability to break down your vessel's doors during their attack when you try to steal from them. Thieves beware! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/ee43a7f51c3cd490ea54e317f020dcd2fb76ec93.gif[/img]

[*]NPCs don't swing in Civilization hubs unless you're being attacked or if you've upset the Civilization.
[*]NPCs are more responsive to commands.
[*]NPCs can attack enemies while reviving.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0fb0f29890a72e2dccd289d7223b72864425f344.png[/img]

[b]Damage Overhaul![/b] - Introducing variable sized breaks and a new shielding system for our big Damage Overhaul! 
[list]
[*]Variable Sized Leaks: Leaks now scale with damage dealt, meaning big biters can chomp big, fast-flooding holes into your ship, and a little bump may only cause smaller breaches.
[*]Shield Damage Absorbtion: Shields now absorb variable damage rather than an all-or-nothing solution, meaning you can tank damage more effectivly, with only the difference in damage affecting your ship when it does cut through! 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/55d9a4142c8c2220056d8cd45f18d85f36f2c2da.png[/img]

[b]New Relics![/b] - Three new mysterious but telling relics have appeared in the Prehistoric Waters - they seem to be from a different timeline, however, from a yet unseen biome... 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7e56a163ad43cb1da948fba65d80e5c4f42d808d.png[/img]

[b]New Enemy: Trash Compactor![/b] - Another taste of the new upcoming biome. Brought by The Time Traveler, this strange machine cares little about your presence, but get in its way and you'll be sorry.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3d0126f9f2be9109d93021e16d329eaa3394affe.png[/img]

[b]Optimizations and Improvements![/b] - Last but not least, this update is packed to the brim with a host of new fixes, optimizations, and improvements in just about every area! Every machine needs to be well-oiled, after all!

[list]
[*]Greatly optimized bandwidth usage across the board.
[*]Flooding/Water system optimized to be less processor-intensive.
[*]Lairs now receive item drops.
[*]Fixed hosting and lobby issues for Mac OSX users.
[*]Caught and fixed many, many, game-slowing null reference bugs.
[*]Ceiling walkers' orientation is now networked.
[*]Revolver fixed to deal the correct amount of damage when shooting rapidly.
[*]Bots no longer shoot at barnacle mines or puffers.
[*]Fixed the lock cursor toggle when pressing caps lock.
[*]Aggroed Tiki Civ stops spawning boulders when dead.
[/list]

[h1]Specific balance changes and fixes[/h1]

Balance:
-Bots will continue to swing at enemies even when reviving a dead player
-Bots spend more time repairing if it is a directly commanded task
-Water flooding rate is now proportional to the size of the hull breach
-All enemies increase their health and damage upon looping the game. 
-Batteries now provide 5 minutes of charge rather than their previous 3.
-The Tiki civilization no longer spawns boulders after all the Tikis are dead.
-Submarine shields now charge linearly rather than step-wise, and change color/scale to signify charge.
-Reduced wall flower projectile hull damage ~25%
-Increased lion-mane jellyfish hull damage ~250%
-Reduced hull damage from individual maggots 60%
-Decreased hull damage from lamprey invaders 60%
-Decreased hull damage from Aurelian worm 40%
-Increased angler fish hull damage 20%
-Reduced angler fish and sick angler fish biting rate
-Increased angler fish swim speed 5%
-Time devourer children do less damage based on their size
-Per-breach damage from ghost pirate invaders reduced 40%
-Per-breach damage from barnacle grabbers decreased 20%
-Increased hull damage from Dunkleosteus bites 300%
-Reduced Dunkleosteus health 25% and reduced bite rate 50%
-Reduced damage from cursed oyster clusters 20-66% depending on size
-Increased volcanic turtle and shark damage 25%
-Reduced volcanic vent eruption rate 50%
-Zoomed in lair guardian fight camera slightly.
-Doubled the XP value of killing exterior enemies.
-Hull damage due to crashinig the submarine increased

Fixes:
-All enemies, pickups, cave decorations, projectiles, ragdolls, hazards, and treasure now use a distance-based method to dynamically spawn and unspawn over the network only when in near-sight radius. This drastically reduces the amount of information sent to mid-game joining players and reduced moment-to-moment traffic on the client side 50-75%.
-Bots have improved response to commands when in an expedition segment
-Baby crabs are back! Where did they even go?
-Interior enemies now correctly respond to multiple sources of damage simultaneously or in short succession by using per-damage-source invincibility times, rather than per-damage invincibility times. This means that a full crew can attack cave/civ enemies and have each hit registered successfully. Very handy!
-Exterior enemies send 50% less traffic when mildly distant from the sub, and send no traffic to clients at all when far out of range (as part of the distance-based networking overhaul)
-Fixed bot loadout items sometimes appearing incorrectly for players joining mid-game
-Exterior hazards are now generated only once per level chunk, fixing the problems where waiting a while could cause the next level chunk to be packed full of barnacle mines or volcanic vents. Also fixes hazards popping into view.
-Quadrupled the size of the acknowledgement packet buffer (reduces packet loss)
-Increased the max sent message queue size from 128 to 150, allowing slightly more messages to be buffered and thus reducing packet loss due to network backup.
-Increased the max reliable message fragment size and max small reliable message count per-packet to help condense traffic and reduce bandwidth usage due to repeated packet headers.
-Decreased the ping timeout for disconnection from 8 seconds to 5 seconds, thus reducing ~35% of the packet backup caused by trying to resend reliable messages to an unresponsive client
-Fixed a bug in the broken container behavior causing networking backup.
-Wrote a failsafe to help prevent players from getting duplicate XP from a run quickly leaving and re-joining a game.
-Fixed a problem where the revolver could not deal damage for each shot if used at its max shooting speed - now each shot registers and deals damage
-Bots operating weapons will actively try to avoid barnacle mines and gaseous fish
-Nearly all objects related to the water flooding system no longer perform per-frame physics overlap casting, and instead do a single raycast at their start or highly stagged physics overlap casting. This dramatically improves flood performance.
-Fixed a bug in the cursor locking logic when pressing caps lock
-Built a series of workarounds for hosting online games on OSX when Unity fails to get any information about network adapters on the local machine
-Fixed the stage II barnacle crab not being properly hooked up to the network manager, causing networking backups
-Interior enemies now correctly sync their scale, miniboss status, and ceiling walker status for mid-game joining players
-Fixed pirate ship debris particles not properly being destroyed, causing slowdowns over time
-Fixed Discord Rich Presence showing incorrect biome names for players in-game
-Fixed an issue in the position syncing configuration of barnacle mines and gaseous fish, causing position information to come in out of order. 
-Fixed a few typos in Atlantean, Egyptian, and Lamprey dialogue.
-Added a sound effect for grounded dodge rolls.
-Fixed a null reference in the appearance setting code for bots and civilization recruits.
-Fixed an animator rigging problem in the time devourer/children
-Ghost clams and eldritch spawnlings are now properly cleaned up after exiting a cave
-Fixed the lair guardian sounds ignoring SFX volume settings
-Fixed a bug where weapons power always displayed as zero in the tactical view

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

The Player of the Month for September is..... GiantButtFace!
GiantButtFace, despite their name, has been a giant HELPFUL face in helping us find some important Mac OSX Networking bugs that we were able to solve in this very update! Through some good old fashioned back and forth emailing, questioning, and prompt info gathering. Thanks GiantButtFace!

[b]::: Community Highlights :::[/b]

Person Personmans just sent us our first fan-made music piece this month, and we had to listen to it right away, and share it with y'all as well! Evoking the feeling when you are filled to the brim with leaks, this is "Breach" -

https://onlinesequencer.net/918623

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Let us know what you think of Part 1, and we'll see you soon when Part 2 comes around!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 1 notes:
-Fixed a null reference causing caves to be non-exitable if preceded by certain cave types.
-Fixed a networking error in broken doors.
-Fixed ranged weapons being able to damage submarine doors

notes.title: Community Challenge: Starting with the rose!
notes.notes:
It's time for our community challenge! This one is for all of you skilled players out there. If at least ONE team can get through all four layers with each player only starting with the rose, the rose will do as much damage as the Tesla gun for one week! Each team that can do this successfully, will additionally be awarded official bragging rights.

Contest Rules:
1. You may not use any bots however, civilization recruits are fair game.
2. Record the entire run, so that we may verify that the goal was achieved.
3. You may swap items in caves or shops.
4. As always, we expect everyone to be respectful and kind to one another, so no offensive player names, name calling, or mistreatment of others. 

You may email your entry to interactivedeli@gmail.com, send us a link through Messenger or Steam. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to The Dev Wife, who is available via Steam or Discord. Happy diving!
