notes.title: The Filthy Update (0.8.2) | Trash Hermits, New Upgrades & More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7abb8d67bcbaa81cc9ec33dee66a57baa0e92a4b.png[/img]

It's time to feel dirty for August's official content update! This month we're bringing a filthy new cave type, new upgrades, full course dinners, and more!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8f3083dbb424cbd8a3e3d62eb7178370c61f8b0d.png[/img]

[b]New Expedition Type: Hermit Hovels![/b] - These filth-coated gargantuan Sea Shells have started appearing all across The Living Infinite's depths, housing within them large but friendly creatures known as...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/780d57e7c914c44265f5827ac4d234779a8c8dde.png[/img]

[b]Trash Hermits![/b] - These oversized decapods have but one passion in life, and that's collecting trash. They love trash so much in fact, that they opt to live in it! Approaching these docile behemoths, you may be able to convince them to part with some of their excess filth, and discover that sometimes, one crab's trash is another man's treasure (or upgrade)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c8a0cc2deb08186adf3ab0030838d3e8315d0a36.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/96feb26f4cf08d645fe84e10fc7b7d9ebf5ef81d.png[/img]

[b]Trash Items![/b] - Not all trash is created equal, and while sometimes you'll score upgrades or valuable goods from your local Trash Hermit, other times you'll be... less lucky. These new items are all of minimum use to your team but hey! Who knows, maybe you'll find a use for that... banana peel?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/ccdfc8b42e79bf40c5e48070c5e79928ead30a65.png[/img]

[b]New Upgrades: Hazardous Fuel and The Duplicator![/b] - Two new upgrades have been added to bolster your offensive capabilities in the form of [b]Hazardous Fuel[/b] and [b]The Duplicator Ammo Mod![/b]

[b]Hazardous Fuel[/b] turns your fuel into a deadly corrossive substance that will trail behind your ship whenever you utilize fuel!

[b]The Duplicator Ammo Mod[/b] is an advanced piece of tech that will, like its namesake, duplicate your torpedoes upon firing them, doubling your firepower! [i]Warning: Duplication process may cause torpedoes to spread in different directions.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8c632a9aae22f404e954efb622f037e2c9b16d22.png[/img]

[b]Backpacks![/b] - When starting out in WNTGD, many of you have wondered why you can only pick one item to start with, when in-game you can carry two. This has been an unintuitive and unexplained mechanic from the beginning, but a decision we made to make mid-game choices and player progression more unpredictable and interesting, but the game hasn't done a great job justifying an explanation for this until now. We're finally addressing it along with a balance shift for the early game, with The Backpack!

The Backpack is a new player upgrade that, when equipped, allows your character to carry one extra item! This means that at the start, you can only carry the one you brought until you find a backpack! We hope this will make the early-game more challenging and team-focused, while allowing for a better feeling of player progression once the team begins finding and equipping backpacks, opening up their strategic possibilities in the process. 

We know this one might feel strange at first, but if you still aren't convinced after playing around with it, we are including a new Custom Game Option that equips you with them from the start. Though we hope y'all trust where we're going with this, especially when it comes to people playing the game for the first time!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/413993f31504c4dfe2ef12568fe91e1f887d07b2.png[/img]

[b]Dinner Time![/b] - After a hard day of adventuring, your crew will now get the opportunity to end their nights sitting down together to enjoy a nice candle-lit dinner.

At the end of of every biome, once traveling downwards your team will find themselves taking a moment to breathe and rest with these new Dinner Sequences that take place in the time between biomes. We hope these brief sequences will give you an opportunity to better bond with your crew as you [b]heal and drink elixirs[/b] together, and impress upon you the days-long journey your characters take as they voyage deeper into the trench.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

- Torpedo explosions deal 5 damage and a direct hit deals 5 more damage. This should be much more fair and realistic torpedo behavior. The torpedo explosion can only damage any given damageable once, but both the direct hit and the explosion override canHIt so that two torpedoes can do their full amount of damage without needing to worry about the enemy being invulnerable for a period.
- New custom behavior biases Upgrade Crate's drops based on water layer, and currently equipped upgrades. (It's now far less likely to get another weapon swap upgrade after you've equipped one)
- New Pickup behavior ensures Civs no longer have duplicate items on sale.
- Upgrades all have a "maximum" limit, and will inform the player upon picking up if they have reached their capacity (mainly to prevent players from wondering if certain ammo mods stack when picking them up).
- Reduced gold multiplier increase per water layer to 0.25, with a max gold multiplier of 2. (layer 1 = 1x, layer 2 = 1.25x, so forth).
- We now sync the host stopwatch roughly every second.


[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Battery duping exploit has been fixed.
- Fixed mid-game joiners being unable to see carried batteries.
- Civ NPCs are now counted as crew members
- Removed old useless code which was scaling the EMP damage on bosses based on crew member count. It now just deals 50% of its normal damage against bosses, per hit (which was the original intent)
-  Fixed mid-game joiners sometimes not seeing the right skins on NPC Recruits/Bots.
-  Fixed steam lobby exploit to ensure that a player cannot join a game which has ended over and over for XP. 
- Introduced new measures to combat cheaters.
- Fixed Safari Suit not unlocking properly once bought.
-  Fixed a regression in Astar pathfinding in the exterior caused by flipping chunks.
- Fixed null references in chemistry clouds and nearly all item-based RPCs that were causing network backup.
- Fish meat should stop turning gray when dropped.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

The Player of the Month for June is..... [b]Far For Fun[/b]!

Far For Fun has sent us an enormous amount of helpful logs and crash reports over the past month, and has been great about going back and forth with us when needing more information to help resolve various issues. With their help, we come ever closer to having a more stable game! Thanks for all your frequent help Far For Fun!

[b]::: Community Highlights :::[/b]

These past few months some fun content from the community has been trickling in, mostly coming from the [url=https://discord.gg/wntgd ]Official Discord[/url] - starting with a ton of memery. Here are some of our favorites!

[b]The "Meme Man" Tinke(L)rer:[/b]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/463097531585527818/467018397260054548/2dvx9b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/463097531585527818/467013825728872448/2dvvrv.jpg[/img]

[b]S.S. TheYellowBullet:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgflip.com/2e6o50.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgflip.com/2e6n3d.jpg[/img]

Between the memery, we have gotten some new art pieces as well like this one from [b]Wrzlprnft:[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9ea0ea642135fb3f4e417a09e49f3a084aab56f8.png[/img]

Additionally, The Lore & Stories Sub Forum has gotten some love again with some new wonderfully written Deeper-inspired fan fiction by [b]ADcrafter[/b] and [b]Thuzar[/b] respectively:

[b]Darkness Falls[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1733207382031978474/

[b]Abyss Chronicles[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1728701877510838293/

And finally, in case you needed more memes, cap out your day with this developer-centric retelling of Steamed Hams by [b]Cleanworld[/b]:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1728701877476820979/

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Go get filthy!

notes.title: Content Drop: Gaseous Fish & Update Preview!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dcc5b363b16d086894c74355d34cbf1769556646.png[/img]

Hey y'all! This week we're dropping a new puffed up enemy for the Prehistoric Waters biome - The Gas Fish! This fella doesn't actually mean you any harm, as they feed by relaxing and breathing plankton in through their pore-filled bodies, but should you knock into them or fire at them, they'll explode! Sometimes releasing toxins with them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fb4a402852cc71184690ad5dfde6a8fb8118f086.png[/img]

notes.title: The Sturdy Update (0.8.1) | Player Ranks and Big Fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/34bf22e6ff83c11ee232db609ad89c0d42f462c8.png[/img]

Anchors away for July's official content update! This month is all about hardiness, sturdiness, and long-term stability. A new ranking system, menu, and a long list of 50+ overdue fixes awaits below! Drop your anchor and check it out!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0f75790c2e61cb134cce6d1cafcd11c6fb36c664.png[/img]

[b]New Player Rank System![/b] - Introducing [b]Player Ranks[/b] to We Need To Go Deeper! As part of our efforts towards making meta-progression feel more satisfying, you now earn XP on your future runs that build towards earning new Ranks for your character! 

Ranks show off your Deeper prowess and are shown next to your character's name in online games. As of now, there are a total of 11 Ranks to earn, with 5 sub-ranks to earn in between each, totaling at 55 potential rankings! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/972df2dca05b3139a8ba68dac3f8dab35b260285.png[/img]

Ranks don't simply come with a new fancy badge, however, as we've revamped the method for unlocking items and cosmetics to now be tied to our new XP system as well, so you'll be regularly unlocking cool stuff each time you level! 

[i]Note: If you've already unlocked everything you still get to keep the things you've unlocked.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a0790b90262cccfc841feafe3c34710348fdc9f3.png[/img]

Also, [b]DON'T PANIC.[/b] We know what you're thinking when you look at this new Gift Box on our XP screen, and to clarify - these are NOT the loot boxes your grandpa warned you about. 

While the rest of the game industry may have ruined the joy of opening a digital gift, we opted for this context because it's fundamentally FUN to unlock things in gift box form, but we promise this will never be tied with any kind of micro-transaction, purchasable currency, nada. The in-game XP or Gold will not be monetized in any way, shape or form, rest assured. Everything is to be earned in-game, exclusively.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d749e2b3708f05185a69abe50419858f9b3aec33.png[/img]

[b]New Main Menu![/b] - The main menu has finally recieved a much-needed facelift after getting increasingly cluttered for so long, and in doing so we got to include a lot of cool new stuff to help the community grow! 

Latest News is now more prominently featured with a new rotating set of links that will direct folks to info about new Updates, Events, Merch, or Community hubs! There is also a new space for other useful links in the bottom right, and an ever-enticing reminder of your current XP progress and ranking in the upper right. 

Your character also gets a moment to shine the moment you open the game now, just to remind you of your handsome self.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/205fcd2658ffe74914d9d800314881c4308974e6.png[/img]

[b]Sturdy Fixes Galore![/b] - You asked, and you asked, and sometimes things slide by. This month, we decided enough is enough, and went hard at work fixing as many long-standing issues as we could. It may not be as sexy as more content, but sometimes what's underneath is just as important.

[b]THE BIG FIX & CHANGE LIST:[/b]

- Internal Restarting is FIXED! No more program restarts between playthroughs!
-Fixed "the infinite void" bug. You can no longer find yourself in a black abyss of truly desolate nothingness - even if you want to.
-Fixed costumes getting shifted around every time we add a new cosmetic. Ryan is a hero.
-Fixed players getting their heads stuck on low spaces even when crouching
-Players now only lose one max health on death rather than two!
-Civilization shops now offer handheld weapons in addition to their usual repertoire!
-You can no longer pick up a non-stackable upgrade. You can buy it, sure, but uh, I mean you do you buddy.
-You can no longer revive someone after walking away from their dead body. Goodbye, beloved hack.
-The sniper mod finally deals the monstrous damage it's supposed to! Check that baby out!
-Fixed shotgun and sniper mod text not appearing after picking up the upgrades
-Fixed shop cases still showing their item for sale even after being bought or broken
-The time devourer can no longer show up to ruin your day before the game loops.
-Oh, and the time devourer is no longer armored.
-Oh, and the time devourer is very much so mortal now. Kill him. See what happens. See if another just shows up immediately. Be my guest.
-Fixed relics turning gray like ragdolls.
-Fixed players being able to see beyond the loaded level space in the tactical view.
-Fixed the bug where the lair guardian could permanently disarm players
-On that note, disarming has been completely rewritten to make permanent disarms virtually impossible.
-In the same manner, locking your player in place was rewritten too. You should find yourself to be less...sticky?
-You can no longer pick up two items simultaneously. 
-Fixed multiple sources of gold and items failing to properly save, and even being outright rewritten with nothing.
-Fixed missing networking on ice chunks, abomination spawners, and barnacle mines which were potentially causing packet buildup
-Networking channel settings have been changed to allow fragmented data in the channel responsible for spawning objects. This is useful for players joining mid-game who need a whole lotta data at once. 
-Manowar enemy now properly appears in front of a player's face when attached their head.
-Fixed oddly laid out catalog menu items by runtime rescaling
-Fixed a bug where a player grabbed out of the submarine by a lair guardian would trigger the submarine hatch sound and do a fade to black over and over and OVER.
-Remember those weird artifacts on the health UI? How about other UI? Nick is your man and he has delivered the fix. 
-Bots now only flash yellow when they've actually healed. It's a miracle, people.
-Fixed ceiling-walking enemies not falling when they're supposed to
-Fixed ceiling walker y-scaling problems
-All enemies attached to your head now scale correctly. *Phew*. Didn't want my head having any weird upside-down stuff on it.
-Removed all item and cosmetic unlocks caused by  raw depth, item use, or weird weird poorly explained external stuff. Gotta use that XP baby!
-Fixed players being able to move, swing their arms, and shoot while in the loadout menu
-Players no longer fire off a packet every frame when holding the interact button next to a door. Hallelujah.
-Fixed a bug where players who had super fast hard disks would find themselves stuck in the ceiling of the Espadon. Classy.
-Fixed a bug where players would be unable to use the periscope after being brigged while on a console or in bed.
-Exterior level chunks now have double the variety at no extra cost! How? Embarrassingly simple math magic.
-As mentioned in the last content drop, all bosses now have 50% less health, and their health no longer scales with the number of crew members. 
-Periscope view size reduced 10%
-Fixed the Espadon background to no longer have a teeeeeeny sliver of exterior world that you could see.
-The darkness (or lighting surface) and exterior parallax water are now big enough to accommodate the largest boss camera size without showing beyond them
-Removed a needless additional check for internet connection and confirmed that you have internet if you are able to get your public IP. This fixes the problem where players can get this "not able to connect to steampowered.com" error even after disabling UPNP usage.
-Fixed a memory cleanup bug when removing bots before starting a game
-Fixed mummy ragdoll not showing up after being killed on client machines
-Players can no longer revive multiple skeletons at once
-Fixed several visual glitches in civilizations which allowed players to see beyond boundaries or see blank background
-Grabbing multiple upgrades no longer shows the wrong text
-Increased the shot distance on the sniper modded exterior gun
-Fixed players still getting hit by higher-aimed projectiles even when they're ducking
-RESOLUTION OPTIONS EVERYBODY HALLELUJAH!
-Fixed several cases where players get stuck on sharp corners in caves.
-Particle system setup has been made much more efficient.
-Fixed a typo in the Bobby Suit description.
-Players using Discord or Steam to join a game with a different version will no longer succeed. This fixes incompatible versions with totally different networking from trying to mash together like malformed puzzle pieces until they both break.
-Fixed a particle factory error in the main power console switch
-No longer will you be shackled to the play menu if you have a public IPv4 but are still trying to get a public IPv6! This fixes a case of permanent "Waiting for public IP source"!
-Fixed a serious bug where players were never leaving their Steam lobbies in the first place. This was causing lobbies to appear full and de-list from the lobby browser even when space was available.
-Fixed a bug where players disagreed on which submarine they had actually traveled in when it came time to upload their scores to the leaderboard. Oh boy. How embarrassing.
-The cheat checker should no longer flag odd rapid changes in values that it tracks. Instead, it will now look for absurd values, which is a safer marker for cheating.
-Fixed being able to enter/leave the submarine while chatting after reaching a cave
-Fuel barrels now refill 50% of the sub's fuel meter!
-The X on the relics UI should be working again. How it fell into disrepair is a matter of scholarly debate to this day.
-Players should now have afflictions removed in the bed when at full health. We had forgotten to account for the effect of health potions when doing the math on that.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

The Player of the Month for July is..... Thor Odenson!

Not only has Thor Odenson been an active player since release, he's also been a moderator on our Discord for quite some time! Thor Odenson is quick to help others on our channel, as well as join them in online games. If you've ever taken a dive with him, you'd know that he is a skilled player and has a lot of useful insight and tactics to share. Thank you, Thor Odenson! I don't know how we'd do it without you!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Happy ranking!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 1 fixes:
-Fixed the loading/saving problems brought on by trying to fit rank data into an old holder class. This should fix another large swath of cases where gold and depth are completely lost! Unfortunately, any save files which were damaged before this fix will not be repaired by it. This only prevents future damage from occurring to gold, depth, and rank save data.
-Fixed rank-based catalog items not showing up properly.
-Players can no longer go over the rank of captain.
-The internal restart system is drastically more tolerant to errors, including any possible from saving/loading really old versions of game files.
-Shop cases can no longer be infinitely mined for gold.
-Fixed a bug that caused the screen to go dark forever if a lair guardian destroyed the submarine.
-Switched to a much safer style of serializing game save data which does not cause the file to remain open even if an error is thrown.
-Each new game resets the seed for the random number generator to fix cases where the same first biome was seen generating over and over until application quit.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 2 fixes:
-Your resolution now defaults to the max one available on your monitor.
-Fixed the game resolution getting reset when entering the play menu.
-Fixed a problem where a bug in the first time loading resolution settings could cause them to never save.
-Removed event-specific items from the catalog.
-Removed eldritch staff from the catalog.
-Fixed incorrect rank requirements on the water pump.
-Added a hotkey (default caps-lock) to turn off hard mouse cursor boundaries.
-Mouse cursor boundaries are only enforced in windowed mode.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 3 fixes:
-Found and fixed a missing networked object which wasn't spawning on the server end and causing networking backup (this time it was the skeleton for recruited civilization crew members).
-Fixed an error preventing deletion of particle emitters when the scene changed.
-Fixed a null reference exception when using the water pump over the network.
-Fixed the bug where the tactical view could be turned on and off when chatting while using the periscope.
-Fixed a casting error when trying to access old player stats files.
-Fixed a regression allowing a fifth invisible player into a lobby.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 4 fixes:
-Fixed the sunhat appearing in the catalog even after purchase
-Made even more failsafes for getting the submarine positioned correctly after a biome change (see fix for "endless void" bug)
-Fixed a missing networked object - today it was the ghost explosion for ghost hammerheads!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 5 fixes:
-Fixed still getting gold and XP even in a custom game
-Fixed a logic error in XP progress calculations. After you finish a game for your first time in patch 5, the level up bar animation may be slightly incorrect, but this is likely getting extra experience added back to you caused by times you previously saw yourself level up but went back to the menu and found yourself at the same rank. Each game after the first should have the level up bar at the end of the game correctly reflecting the XP added.
-Fixed an exploit where players could join and leave a game over and over and get expeirence each time they leave. XP is now only given and saved at the end of a run. If you disconect during a run, your gold and depth are still saved so long as it is not a custom game. Reconnecting before the game ends will ensure you still get the full amount of XP for the entire run. It is simply awarded only once.

notes.title: Version 0.8.1 BETA is Live! (UPDATED)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! The BETA for our latest content update is now live for you to test! We say Beta because one of the biggest fixes this update brings is a real doozy, and we won't feel comfortable pushing the update out until we know it's stable.

SO - if you would like to help test the new update, simply right click WNTGD in your Steam Library and go to Properties > Betas and select the "beta" branch from the dropdown list and wait for the content to download.

[b]WHAT WE'RE LOOKING TO TEST (UPDATED):[/b]

- Our new "internal restart" system, AKA our solution for not having to force the program to quit and reboot at the end of each session to function properly. How do we test this? Simple, play many games in a row without restarting the game, and report anything strange that happens from the second game onwards.

[b]vvv UPDATED! vvv[/b]

- LAN should be fixed, so if it's broken, or some combination of it and Online games are broken, let us know!

- Ranks and XP should be pretty much working now. There's one known bug where new ranks don't display properly on clients that we're looking into, but start earning XP and see what happens!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks everyone! With your help, hopefully we'll be able to test/fix the update and release it in full in no time!

notes.title: The Heavy Load Update (0.8) | Boss Lairs, Branching Paths and More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e3035fceccc611afbba33658d5b61c2ba748d79b.png[/img]

Things are getting heavy with June's official content update! This update we're overhauling expedition zones with revamped drop rates, a new boss encounter, an all new expedition type, and more! Read on to find out what we have in store!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/583f61682bef298d33b26a9fda56b9f8a034ed9e.png[/img]

[b]New Expedition Type: Lairs![/b] - These mysterious new expedition types have begun to appear in the trench; abandoned undersea workshops filled with abandoned tech, including a precious [b]Upgrade Crate![/b] But be warned, for these valuable Upgrades are guarded by....

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2088ccef80ecfb4b1d054650a6ca8e02870ddd6c.png[/img]

[b]New Boss: Lair Guardians![/b] - These hulking masses of abandoned copper and iron are set to crush any and all intruders who dare try and take their precious cargo. But don't be fooled by their size, Lair Guardians also come equipped with all kinds of dangerous gadgetry to put a stop to your crew. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1c282ef7b32e5b25abde617aec03f90b7f8644e7.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/637fc0207b2c63cb8d8342a7d87c2c48db1090a6.png[/img]

[b]Branching Paths![/b] - Take careful notice of your Radar, because on your travels you may notice that occasionally you'll come across [b]branching paths[/b] that will determine what kind of Expedition you come across. Will you explore a Cave for resources and treasure? Or will you enter a Lair and fight for a new Upgrade? Choose wisely, for once you pick a path, quick-moving water currents will ensure you won't be able to return.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/31c0a89b8a5f7e544416320e4d4b5ffc8c9b999f.png[/img]

[b]Ruby Chests![/b] - With Lairs holding the key to ship Upgrades, Caves just got a lot more wealthy! These huge golden treasure troves are stashed away at the end of caves, holding within them a large stash of valuable Rubies, ensuring your future cave expeditions will be lucrative ones.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

- Caves no longer contain Upgrade Crates.
- Caves have a much lower chance of producing long or second floor caves, with the probability increasing the deeper you go.
- Crate Hermit crabs have been replaced with Barrel Hermit Crabs in caves.
- Dodge rolling now has proper Dark Souls style invincibility frames!
- Volcanic boulders now fall a little slower to give more time to react.
- Zoomed out the tactical view 40% more.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

The Player of the Month for June is..... Natedog251!

Natedog251 was recently promoted to Moderator in our Community Discord, and for good reason! Always helpful among the Discord helping other users with their problems, and even better - hosting open invite games in the Discord quite regularly! Helping keep our multiplayer community thriving is an oft-overlooked contribution, but all the more important for little indie games like ours! So thank you, Natedog251 for everything you do!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Introducing the first official We Need To Go Deeper merch: [b]The "Diver" Fold Figure! [/b]

notes.title: The Jimmy-It Update (0.7.9) | New Weapons, Ammo Mods & More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c448508ba4332450d42dbe2a695681278e558434.png[/img]

Mix, match and shake it up for The Jimmy-It Update! This update is all about Weapons and Weapon Modifications, along with a whole host of fixes, options, and more! Read on for details!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b64ecae2fff6eff81ae0d5e8450d5653659f71e4.png[/img]

[b]Ammo Mods! -[/b] Spruce up your firepower with Ammo Mods! These 5 new weapon-altering upgrades will take your Torpedoes to the next level! And best of all- they can be mixed and matched together for synergizing results!
[i]
[b]Rocket Booster -[/b] Blasts your torpedoes at terrible speeds, and gives direct hits an extra explosive damage boost! 

[b]Acid Tank -[/b] Explosions leave an acidic cloud that will continously harm any enemy that dares come into contact.

[b]Homing Dish -[/b] Directs your torpedoes to curve at will towards the nearest foe!
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f6aaf26466d9c8f4740477b32afecb33715b10de.gif[/img]
[i]
[b]Liquid Nitrogen Tank -[/b] Explosions leave an icy cloud that will slow any enemy in its wake!

[b]Guidance Laser -[/b] A bright red laser lets you aim with precision!
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/de17292ab81c117c6708a212617e0418019fd0eb.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/987c1933d64830604516bc4420a8c8b9eeadb59e.png[/img]

[b]2 New Swappable Submarine Weapons! -[/b] Mini-Gun firing ain't your style? Fear not, for the secondary infinite Sub Weapon slot just got tactical! When found, you can swap out your Mini-Gun for one of these two new weapon types!
[i]
[b]Spread-Shot -[/b] The Spread-Shot will spray out several bullets at a time, allowing you to deal 4 times as much damage to any enemy that comes close enough to its short range.

[b]Long-Shot -[/b] The Long-Shot lets you fire deadly precision shots from afar, though it takes greater skill to utilize.
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/082dab84b2b12ae411167a2010a884b049b3dd26.png[/img]

[b]New Community Requested Options! -[/b] You asked for them, so here they are! Two new options that let you better customize your game experience!
[i]
[b]"Safe" Dynamite -[/b] Tired of trolls blowing up your Submarine? In "Safe" Dynamite mode, dynamite deals zero damage to fellow players, bots, and vessels! This new option can be found in the Custom Game Options sub-menu in any Lobby!

[b]Legacy UI -[/b] If our new Console UI isn't your style, you can now enable the classic borderless and console-less UI under Options in the Main Menu!
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/83ef856fb6ab2c6cc610251fa79fde9d4ed53557.png[/img]

[b]Boss Cam -[/b] Boss Battles just got more grandeur with our new smarter Boss cam! The Boss cam gives you a better view of your gargantuan foe, and even tracks them so your team can better focus on destroying them instead of trying to see them.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed "permanant curtains" loading bug.
- Fixed several main menu toggles not showing their saved value correctly as the default.
- Improved Cheat Detection, changed punishment from closing the Application to disabling saving of Leaderboards, Gold and Unlocks.
- Fixed player loadout info sometimes displaying incorrectly.
- Bots no longer fire at volcanic vents.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

- Reduced price of all items in Civilization shops by 25%
- Fuel pickup rate dropped 50%
- Fuel amount per pickup dropped ~ 40%
- Reduced ammo amount received from drops by 33%
- Translation Book now reduces Civilization shop prices by 50%
- Reset the leaderboards to reflect all the new balance changes

[h1]Other[/h1]

- Added "bullet trails" to projectile weapons.
- Added "kickback" to projectile weapons.
- Enemy Corpses turn gray to distinguish them from living enemies.
- Bumped up default zoom on exterior camera ~6%
- Scaled up the exterior torpedo so that we can see some more of those sweet details.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[h1]Player of the Month[/h1]

The Player of the Month for May is..... [b]Cleanworld![/b]

Cleanworld has been an ever-present voice among the WNTGD community for quite some time now, providing regular feedback, commentary and engagement with others in the community, and to the point keeping our forums lively throughout some of the more quiet months. Thank you, Cleanworld, and congratulations!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Jimmy away!

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dcc5b363b16d086894c74355d34cbf1769556646.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Welcome to Content Drop! This is a new thing we're trying, where every Monday we'll drop a new small cosmetic/relic/whatever into We Need To Go Deeper to add small doses of content regularly!

So why are we doing this now? Well, as we're heading towards the goal of full release this year, our regular monthly content updates are going to steadily take up more of our time, and we're considering abandoning the mid-month "Crate Updates" so we can better keep on schedule and dedicate more time to the more substantial monthly updates. 

We feel bad leaving everyone high and dry between months though, so we came up with these weekly Content Drops to help keep things lively. They aren't ever going to be substantial by design, but hopefully y'all will get a kick out of getting some small new stuff EVERY week!

So, here's this week's drop: [b]The Ninja Outfit![/b] - Now Available in The Catalog.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fb22b5a1323affffb8cd04ae1ee6af39faa808e2.png[/img]

Let us know what y'all think of this new format! And to reiterate, [b]this does NOT affect our monthly updates in any way. Y'all will still get substantial content updates every month on the 8th[/b], and in fact they should be a lot better given the extra time this format affords us between updates! Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: The Wham Bam Update (0.7.8) | Dodge Rolls, Charge Attacks & More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/02740211212fd95b15f55dd1c45adb1f9e366ab1.png[/img]

Bring the pain for April's content update! This month is all about improving the act of dishing it out and taking it! Dodge rolls, Charge Attacks and more! Read on for details:

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4ca38697d43a6b3fb12fed15c296ca84095f47db.gif[/img]

[b]Dodge Rolls! -[/b] Keep yourself away from danger with the brand new Dodge Roll ability! At any time during combat, or just for fun, you can perform a quick roll by pressing the direction you want to roll towards, and hitting [b]SPACE BAR[/b]! 

[i]Warning: May cause back problems later in life.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0100a47c89ec9245294f048d7ad8e292b8dbc1b1.png[/img]

[b]New Enemy - Baby Crabs! -[/b] These new tiny critters can be found just about anywhere, but not to worry - as they're almost useless! To satisfy your newfound bloodlust, we've included these new cannon-fodder enemies whose sole purpose in life is to be killed by the dozens.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d26f473815a4c8a2689ae0fbaea0577216ec9d13.png[/img]

[b]Permanent Corpses! -[/b] Enemy corpses will no longer disappear! So what does this mean? Well for starters, it means you'll be able to tell where you have and haven't been in caves by the trails of bodies you leave behind, but more importantly, it means you're going to have to SWAB THE DECK if you want to keep a tidy Submersible! 

What's the saying, again? Cleaniness, by smacking corpses until they explode, is close to godliness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/81d0eb1dc3b646d022a1318dd4e895517c5bc626.gif[/img]

[b]Charge Attacks! -[/b] It's time to bring down the hammer with CHARGE ATTACKS, now available in every Melee Item! Now, when you HOLD the attack button, you'll rear back your weapon, charging it for a stronger blow!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d6c2c2605e2615503064ae98b732f8ae47fb24fc.png[/img]

[b]Feedback Frenzy! -[/b] Along with the new mechanical changes to combat, we've also included a bevvy of smaller, but still important, changes to how basic combat FEELS:

- Added a visual "Swipe" animation to all melee attacks to add some oomph.

- Enemy corpses now get pushed back in the direction they were killed for more satisfying deaths.

- Enemies now get pushed back even more when taking damage to give some extra weight to attacks.

- MORE blood particles!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed loads of enemy ragdolls which were setup to be networked but had no networked creation or destruction.
- Disabled old fuel UI (oops).
- Fixed an animation bug causing players to get stuck in tight spaces.
- Fixed a bug where cave jellyfish could make light objects without deletion if left for extremely long durations.
- Fixed crouch animation disrupting head collider's ability to fit under small spaces.

[h1]Other[/h1]

- Added a setting to disable automatic port forwarding (used in rare cases where network administration drops your internet connection when UPNP is detected).
- Changed gear sounds to be more metallic in weapons console UI.
- Radar now has a pinging sound.
- Jumping now has a kickoff sound.
- New civilization music from Jacob Lives!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[h1]Player of the Month[/h1]

The Player of the Month for April is..... [b]Bee![/b]

Throughout March, one person has been sending us regular and incredibly detailed bug/log reporting that has helped us immensely in tracking down some sticklers, and that person is [b]Bee![/b] Thanks to your reports, we have a much clearer understanding of some of the behind-the-scenes troubles! On top of helping us track down bugs, Bee has also created one of our favorite pieces of fan art in the form of their Espadon plushie, for those who haven't seen it yet:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1280611992
Thanks again, Bee, and congratulations!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Happy smashing!

notes.title: Crate Update #8: The Touch Crate & Spring Event (0.7.7)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/84449d0b3c618d54587015d17a06922903fe245f.png[/img]

Reach out and touch this month's new Crate Update - filled to the brim with a brand new UI. the Spring Event, and a special suprise! Details below.

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f8effbb455a7fbefa2ab1265be83fb6fff14f69b.png[/img]

[b]"Tangible" Console UI![/b] - To better sell the fantasy of working together to run your big, bulky vessel, and in order to better teach new and returning players many of Deeper's quirks and mechanics, we've introduced new custom interfaces for every console! 

Now, when using your Periscope, your Navigation Console, or a Weapons console, you'll be greeted with a custom-made panel to represent your character's console controls! We're confident this will lead to better immersion and clarity overall, and looks nifty to boot!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/19881e4b583930af4bf3d0f379c990c3d28cee2d.png[/img]

notes.title: The Sensations Update (0.7.6) | Tactical View, Linux Support & More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8d62b70cf625f00d4340bbe423fa74287b152328.png[/img]

Clean out yer ears and rinse your goggles for the Sensations Update! This month is all about displays and useful info for your future voyages, including an all-new Tactics View for Periscope users, and all-new Linux OS support! Read on for the sweet deets.

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4cb970fb3bcc724d55ef70f226278234c4480ddd.png[/img]

[b]Tactical Periscope View![/b]

This all-new Radar-like view can now be accessed from the Periscope at the press of a button! (Spacebar by default) 

The Tactical View will allow you to see further ahead than your Navigator or Weapons Specialist, giving you the insight your crew needs to make better decisions about where to go next, where the next expedition may lie, and where danger is lurking.

Furthermore, the tactical view displays a bevy of info regarding your vessel. From hull integrity, to fuel, to ammunition and power levels.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3bc2342bbc6b30b4f51b57a589303069ee2e9162.png[/img]

[b]Linux OS Support![/b]

Penguins rejoice, for Linux and Steam OS Support is here! Spread the word to your command-console-using friends, and tell them to come join the party!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0c795df33c91b2d56cba46ce8ae0a058f148572a.png[/img]

 [b]In-Game Resolution Options![/b]

This one's long overdue, but hey - maybe we'll get partial credit for turning in late. Say goodbye to the days where holding Alt before beginning the game is necessary for changing your resolution! No longer will you have to harness the secrets of the game just to change your picture size. Hi Ma! I'm a real game now!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/5542bd52ed25958f4571a1fdb16f903bdb91cbc9.png[/img]

[b]Lonesome Secret[/b]

Finally, a new secret hat has been added to the game. For those with a keen eye and especially for those who frequent our streams, this image is the only clue you'll need to unlock it.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed in-game UI not scaling properly on different aspect ratios. No more squishing!

- Fixed menus not scaling properly on dif. aspect ratios as well! Consistency all around!

-  Moved our Discord DLLs to the plugins folder, hopefully ensuring that we see fewer missing DLL exceptions being thrown.

- Added better exception handling for the Discord integration.

- Fixed some cases of pop-in spawning on environmental hazards and enemies.

- Fixed game starting at the wrong resolution. It should be a lot better at detecting your native resolution from the start now.

- Added camera effects for exterior view to bring back some of the original assets' saturation and color.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

Our Player of the Month this time around is [b]MrMountainMan![/b]

[b]MrMountainMan[/b] has consistently been friendly, funny, and helpful no matter where he's found. In the Forums he's often found participating in other discussions, offering feedback, or offering help to new users.  In our inbox he's been helpful in solving bugs, frequently sending output logs to the Deli Interactive email, which is never not going to be notable given how useful it can be for us! In our streams, he's consistently present and helping keep our chat lively and active, and sometimes helping keep us on track when we start going off the rails! Thank you for everything you've been doing [b]MrMountainMan[/b], and congratulations!

notes.title: Crate Update #7: The Bug Crate (0.7.3)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1f2c17e72487a0f3c98b3fbdebf274d7817735cf.png[/img]

This update is chock-full of bug fixes and balance features, all reported and requested by you guys! Figured a bit of cleanup work was to be done, so Jordan and Ryan went ahead and squashed as many problems as they could find these past few weeks!

[h1]Fixes/Improvements:[/h1]

-AI crew members' pathfinding process is now multithreaded, which is a heck of a lot quicker.

-Every remote procedure call in our code base has been carefully modified to ensure exceptions are handled with every reference and error reporting is dramatically improved (log files are now even more useful for networking bugs!)

-Kicking players mid-game! The third time a player is brigged they are kicked out of the game completely! *Please* use only on abusive players rather than newbies - we reserve the right to remove this feature if it is making the game impossible to play for newer players.

-Fixed a bug in AI crew member task allocation causing them to only want to revive the host, but not clients, while in expeditions.

-Fixed periscopes remaining after entering a cave.

-Fixed players being able to move and use items when in the bed during expeditions.

-Fixed a bug where mid-game joining players would never see wall barnacles as hatched if they had hatched before joining (the barnacles kept growing too - hoo boy).

-Made a failsafe to ensure that mid-game joining players' sea backgrounds and rock sprites all match up with the current biome.

-Fixed a bug where a player could use their weapons and a battery after leaving the brig.

-Fixed a bug in AI crew member pathfinding causing them to take straight-up comical paths, flip around erratically, etc.

-Fixed a bug where two matches coming from the same public IP could cause the wrong one to be joined.

-Fixed several default cosmetics not being unlocked (Steward Standard anyone?)

-Optimized netcode to use ~95% fewer "Find" functions, which are notoriously slow in Unity.

-Gold now displays upon entering civilizations.

-The gold meter is much more fast and responsive.

-Upgraded Unity version to 2017.3 to get the latest Unity Multiplayer fixes (including an enticing set of fixes related to double-sending and double-receiving remote procedure calls).

-Upgraded NAT punchthrough tool and provided it with better reference/exception handling.

-Upgraded Steam API to latest available version.

-Clam hitboxes are much more fair now.

-Fixed a bug where hull breaches in certain areas of the Requin were inaccessible by AI crew members.

-Fixed AI crew members falling through the floor on revival.

-Fixed a bug where mid-game joining players could have 100% opaque green overlays over the exterior view.

-Fixed lampreys not hitting players and reduced their distance before attacking.

-Fixed a bug where ManOWar sounds bypassed the SFX volume settings.

-Fixed shop cases only being able to be paid out by the host.

-Made access to Discord Rich Presence DLLs safer and improved exception handling.

notes.title: The Civilized Update (0.7.2) - Civilizations are here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e909fc11e50e03ba98f58fb3c857f848084be5b6.png[/img]

Get your handshaking grip ready for the Civilized Update! This update marks our first full year on early access, so we’ve been working our butts off to deliver you one of our biggest features yet!

[h1]Civilizations ![/h1]

The living infinite just got a lot more populated, with every biome now featuring its own fully fleshed-out civilizations!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d2588633f75ce216494b7d9214657c1789629ce0.png[/img]

You can find the home of these many societies on your journeys and park there like you would a cave. Explore, talk to the many citizens, spend your hard-earned gold on supplies, upgrades, or even a new crew member to join you on your adventure.

But, on your journey into the lands of these various undersea cultures, you may notice that that the language these undersea denizens use is quite unfamiliar…

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/162cb4a3fe27d1a4c787270287f6aba313b02119.png[/img]

[h1]New Item: The Translation Book![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/94383b0999c67fd660080f598a8356cd5ac0fd40.png[/img]

This handy new guide to all of the new undersea languages you’ll be discovering will be your key to understanding your friendly neighborhood fish friends. Meant for adventurers with a taste for curiosity and uncovering the stories the living infinite has the offer, the Translation Book will make a diplomat out of you yet!

Bonus feature: this bad boy makes you look like a genius - even if you read it upside-down.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/06fd3674df4e906d3358b498ea380793a5a85d56.png[/img]

[h1]Recruitable Creatures![/h1]

Found only at participating civilization locations, these eight unique NPCs can be recruited to help you on your travels! With each creature being unique to that civilization, you now have a wider variety of options to even the odds for the dangers that lie ahead.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9e06e1e425920a9a6b6198975d4cd3e6c19e29f5.png[/img]

[h1]Merchants![/h1]

Depend no more purely on lady luck to net you the upgrades you need! Track down the local merchant of any civilization to browse their wares and pool together your uncovered gold to buy the items you need fair and square! Of course you COULD Just take what you want instead with the five finger discount, but be warned that the locals don’t take kindly to thieves…

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4c9a0d574b8e8fc9820101a31c14fb4a3f6e48c1.png[/img]

In fact, the citizens of these undersea cities are more than capable of chasing players into their own submersible to make them pay for their transgressions...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dce0c1b531f05e83b3f0346d4402180ec53e4910.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
-Leaderboards have been reset to give players a fair shake with all the new features
-Parallax fish no longer swim above the water line
-Bots no longer attack enemies unless they are aggroed
-Bots no longer fire at gore
-Bots continue aiming when the host is typing a message
-Bots are less likely to become stuck after leaving a cave due to a null reference
-Fixed medic bots not healing players in caves
-Reduced main scene load times, increasing rate of success for joining a server

[b]Balance[/b]
-Barnacle Maw health has been reduced
-Pirate invaders have less health on average

[b]Community Highlights[/b]
-[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672393571646202909] http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672393571646202909 [/url]
-[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672392937614154340] http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672392937614154340[/url]
-[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/3270044456093598498] http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/3270044456093598498[/url]
-[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1600332806240922610] https://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1600332806240922610[/url]

[b]Player of the Month[/b]
This update's Player of the Month is [b]Freemankiller[/b]! Freemankiller has provided us with valuable feedback almost since launch a year ago. His ability to find exploits and present them to us has been a huge tool for improvement. But his choice for this month comes from his ever-present bombastic participation in the community contests held in January! As with all Player of the Month winners, he'll receive four extra copies of Deeper to give to friends!

As a fair warning, given the sheer size of this update, we almost certainly have some new bugs hiding, waiting to strike, that will need help tracking down as they come up. But we’re very optimistic and very excited to bring you guys this update after a whole year on early access! As always keep sending us your feedback and your reports as they come up, and we'll continue to try and make We Need To Go Deeper the best it can be! Happy handshaking!

Found only at participating civilization locations, these eight unique NPCs can be recruited to help you on your travels! With each creature being unique to that civilization, you now have a wider variety of options to even the odds for the dangers that lie ahead.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9e06e1e425920a9a6b6198975d4cd3e6c19e29f5.png[/img]

[h1]Merchants![/h1]

Depend no more purely on lady luck to net you the upgrades you need! Track down the local merchant of any civilization to browse their wares and pool together your uncovered gold to buy the items you need fair and square! Of course you COULD Just take what you want instead with the five finger discount, but be warned that the locals don’t take kindly to thieves…

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4c9a0d574b8e8fc9820101a31c14fb4a3f6e48c1.png[/img]

In fact, the citizens of these undersea cities are more than capable of chasing players into their own submersible to make them pay for their transgressions...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dce0c1b531f05e83b3f0346d4402180ec53e4910.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
-Leaderboards have been reset to give players a fair shake with all the new features
-Parallax fish no longer swim above the water line
-Bots no longer attack enemies unless they are aggroed
-Bots no longer fire at gore
-Bots continue aiming when the host is typing a message
-Bots are less likely to become stuck after leaving a cave due to a null reference
-Fixed medic bots not healing players in caves
-Reduced main scene load times, increasing rate of success for joining a server

[b]Balance[/b]
-Barnacle Maw health has been reduced
-Pirate invaders have less health on average

[b]Community Highlights[/b]
-[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672393571646202909] http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672393571646202909 [/url]
-[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672392937614154340] http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672392937614154340[/url]
-[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/3270044456093598498] http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/3270044456093598498[/url]
-[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1600332806240922610] https://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1600332806240922610[/url]

[b]Player of the Month[/b]
This update's Player of the Month is [b]Freemankiller[/b]! Freemankiller has provided us with valuable feedback almost since launch a year ago. His ability to find exploits and present them to us has been a huge tool for improvement. But his choice for this month comes from his ever-present bombastic participation in the community contests held in January! As with all Player of the Month winners, he'll receive four extra copies of Deeper to give to friends!

As a fair warning, given the sheer size of this update, we almost certainly have some new bugs hiding, waiting to strike, that will need help tracking down as they come up. But we’re very optimistic and very excited to bring you guys this update after a whole year on early access! As always keep sending us your feedback and your reports as they come up, and we'll continue to try and make We Need To Go Deeper the best it can be! Happy handshaking!

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/96952f840ec074d6068eb2bd6262b9948150cb31.png[/img]

Welcome to the final results of The New Years' Games! For our final contest, we had you guys sending us your Deeper-related art and fiction, and while there was only a few of you who entered (and some of you who seemed to create entries but never formally entered the contest as per our Contest Rules), we at least got some great art out of it!

[h1][b]Winners[/b][/h1]

[b]1st Place in Visual Art[/b] goes to the amazing [b]Bee[/b] with their hand-sewn entry in the form of an adorable plush-ified Espadon vessel! Seriously, the whole team was so enchanted by this cute-as-nails entry, thank you so much for making it, Bee. ːsteamhappyː You'll be sent your gift copy shortly!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1280611992
[b]1st Place in Fiction[/b] was a lot tougher to decide on. The team deliberated for a long time but since we couldn't come to an agreement, this award is officially tied between [b]ADcrafter[/b]'s short but sweet comedy piece and [b]Freemankiller's[/b] elaborate self-made-biome piece - congratulations, guys! You both get copies because we're indecisive!

You can find both of their winning entries here:

[b]ADcrafter: [/b]http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1692659769947091905/

[b]Freemankiller:[/b]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=974802563/

[h1][b]Honorable Mentions[/b][/h1]

There were two additional entries the team were big fans of over the course of this competition, that unfortunately did not qualify for judging given neither of them were officially entered via the comments of last week's announcement, as per entry rules. Nonetheless, we wanted to highlight them anyway for being solid works in and of themselves:

[b]Crimson's[/b]  simple but elegant little piece describes an intruiging futuristic post-apocalyptic version of Deeper's world, with some clever use of the game's own title: http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1692659769959486616/http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1692659769959486616/

[b]Do We Really Need To Go Deeper?'s[/b] aptly named, "Mastapiece" managed to make me squirt my morning coffee out my nose when I saw it in all its glory, and really, isn't that the purpose of all art?

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1282478845

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks again for all of you who entered! Buckle up, because next week is We Need To Go Deeper's 1 Year Anniversary on Early Access, and the update we have been cooking up is going to be a doozy!

notes.title: The New Years' Games - Week 3
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/96952f840ec074d6068eb2bd6262b9948150cb31.png[/img]

Welcome back to the The New Years' Games! Last week we had you speed diving, and while we didn't get many entrants, those brave enough to venture forward (and patient enough to deal with our many balance/bug problems which your videos helped us identify, thank you guys so much!) did pull through with some pretty awesome run-times. But only one team was the fastest....

Congratulations to [b]Mr. Great White The III[/b] and [b]Crimson[/b] for their incredible [b]18 minute, 34 second[/b] race to the bottom! Ya'll will each be sent your winning game key shortly! You can check out their speedy adventure here:
[b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DnRhm08tkAg 
[/b]
Thanks once again to all of the entrants for participating, and for detailing their troubles in their many failed attempts. Speed-running is one of the most sure-fire ways to catch new bugs and balance problems, so we thank you all for supplying us with valuable information going forward! (And we managed to patch one of the more extreme bugs recently, so let us know if y'all end up in a blank ocean void again.)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2bdb05ba8d9e18af18284d1bfe8bc4d487841175.png[/img]

[h1][b]Week 3: Artsy Fartsy![/b][/h1]

This week's contest is all about stretching those creative muscles once more to craft some fabulous works of We Need To Go Deeper inspired art, of both the visual and wordy variety.

The theme is rather open this time, as to allow for a wide variety of submissions. All we ask is that you showcase your love (or frustration) with your We Need To Go Deeper experiences through the lens of a creator. You can draw, paint, pixel-art, or write your work of art however you like! There are no rules in art, man. EXCEPT THESE ONES.

[h1]Rules[/h1]

[b]ATTENTION: YOU MUST FOLLOW ALL OF THESE RULES TO QUALIFY.[/b]

1. Draw or Write a We Need To Go Deeper inspired piece of art or fiction. (or do both!)

2. Upload your art to the WNTGD Steam Community Hub: (Click the big "Upload Your Art" button in the upper right corner and select a file.)

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/images/

If you have a fiction piece, instead create a post with your fiction piece included in our Lore & Stories subforum here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/

or if you'd rather, create your fiction piece in an appropriately categorized/labeled Steam Guide:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/guides/

3. Link to your art submission or fiction post in the COMMENTS section below.

4. Your work must be your own. That means no plagiarism, lifting/photoshopping other pieces of art, infringing on other people's copywritten works, etc.

5. You may only have ONE entry for each category (visual art and fiction).

[h1]Winners and Prizes[/h1]

[b]1st Place in Visual Art:[/b] The creator of our favorite art piece, whether it be the most dazzling or simply the most entertaining (so no, you don't need to be the most amazing artist to compete if you have a good sense of humor), will be awarded an extra copy of We Need To Go Deeper!


[b]1st Place in Fiction:[/b] The creator of our favorite work of fiction based on overall entertainment value will also be awarded an extra copy of We Need To Go Deeper!


[b]All entries are due no later than January 28, 8:00pm MST.[/b]

Good luck, and happy diving!

notes.title: The New Years' Games - Week 1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/96952f840ec074d6068eb2bd6262b9948150cb31.png[/img]

Come one, come all to the We Need To Go Deeper community New Years' Games! As mentioned in our last update, there will be no content updates this month as we prepare for a large-scale anniversary update in February. Instead, this month will be filled with weekly community-driven contests where you fine folks will have a chance to win free copies of We Need To Go Deeper to give to friends and family to kick off the new year!

[h1][b]Week 1: The Name Game![/b][/h1]

This first contest is going to be our simplest and accessible for just about anybody with a knack for goofy names. Your goal this week is to come up with new names for some of WNTGD's inhabitants. You may have noticed that WNTGD's mini-bosses, bots, and in future, NPCs, are named in-game using a pool of random goofy names.To make games fresh, we want these name pools to be as varied but as fitting as possible! 

Specifically, here are the characters you'll be coming up with names for:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/37b112b04faf38e55c406fac05f4a246342cbdf1.png[/img]
[b]Bots[/b] - Find a way to incorporate the word "Bot" or "Robot" into a humorous first and last name combo (Male or Female, preferably both). 

[i]Examples: Bot Smith, Lucille Bot, Jerry Botfield, etc.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b1f112c445871ccc476cfb5245421addf1120404.png[/img]
[b]Mini-Boss: Crystal Bug[/b] - Combine a first name that would suit this crystally bug fella from the new Aurelian biome with 3 titles for each possible mini-boss variant: a giant slower variant with increased damage and health, a regular speed large variant with increased damage, and a speedy shrunken variant.

[i] Examples: Crys the Hardened, Krkkle the Quick, etc.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/94279e23a6dc072e75688d666f93aa71f4520b39.png[/img]
[b]Atlanteans[/b] - Last but not least, come up with names for the denizens of one of our next update's civilizations, The Atlanteans! No pre-determined naming schemes other than how well it seems to fit their fishy appearance, so go wild on these guys!

[h1]Rules[/h1]

1. To qualify, you must submit your full list of suggested names, preferably labeled so we know what characters you are suggesting names for, in the COMMENTS of this very update post. (We'd rather not have a bajillion redundant forum threads about these contests, so let's keep the entries all in one place, yeah?)

2. You may submit a maximum of 15 names TOTAL. Any additional names from the same user past the first 15 will be discounted, so make em count!


[h1]Judging Criteria[/h1]

We'll be judging names on two simple criteria:

1. Appropriateness - Both in terms of how fitting a name is for a certain character or else how appropriate it is to put in a professional product. That means no slurs, swears, or otherwise anything future-you would be ashamed of.

2. Cleverness - This one's purely going to be based on the devs' sense of humor and opinions, but cleverness is just, ya know, how clever the name is thought out. I dunno how to explain cleverness, y'all. Just come up with names that are interesting or amusing and I'm sure you'll do just fine.

[h1]Winners and Prizes[/h1]

[b]1st Place:[/b] 1 entrant with our favorite name/names (again, quality over quantity but if you can manage a lot of top quality, all the better obviously) will have their best names featured in-game by the next update, AND they will be awarded 2 copies of We Need To Go Deeper! 

[b]Runner Ups:[/b] Anyone else who posts a name the team likes enough will have their best names featured in-game starting next update and be recognized as a runner up in next week's contest post! There's plenty of room for runner ups, so post away!

[b]All entries are due no later than January 14, 8:00pm MST.[/b]

Good luck, and happy naming!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]A Very Special Side Note:[/h1]

notes.title: The New Years' Games - Week 1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/96952f840ec074d6068eb2bd6262b9948150cb31.png[/img]

Come one, come all to the We Need To Go Deeper community New Years' Games! As mentioned in our last update, there will be no content updates this month as we prepare for a large-scale anniversary update in February. Instead, this month will be filled with weekly community-driven contests where you fine folks will have a chance to win free copies of We Need To Go Deeper to give to friends and family to kick off the new year!

[h1][b]Week 1: The Name Game![/b][/h1]

This first contest is going to be our simplest and accessible for just about anybody with a knack for goofy names. Your goal this week is to come up with new names for some of WNTGD's inhabitants. You may have noticed that WNTGD's mini-bosses, bots, and in future, NPCs, are named in-game using a pool of random goofy names.To make games fresh, we want these name pools to be as varied but as fitting as possible! 

Specifically, here are the characters you'll be coming up with names for:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/37b112b04faf38e55c406fac05f4a246342cbdf1.png[/img]
[b]Bots[/b] - Find a way to incorporate the word "Bot" or "Robot" into a humorous first and last name combo (Male or Female, preferably both). 

[i]Examples: Bot Smith, Lucille Bot, Jerry Botfield, etc.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b1f112c445871ccc476cfb5245421addf1120404.png[/img]
[b]Mini-Boss: Crystal Bug[/b] - Combine a first name that would suit this crystally bug fella from the new Aurelian biome with 3 titles for each possible mini-boss variant: a giant slower variant with increased damage and health, a regular speed large variant with increased damage, and a speedy shrunken variant.

[i] Examples: Crys the Hardened, Krkkle the Quick, etc.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/94279e23a6dc072e75688d666f93aa71f4520b39.png[/img]
[b]Atlanteans[/b] - Last but not least, come up with names for the denizens of one of our next update's civilizations, The Atlanteans! No pre-determined naming schemes other than how well it seems to fit their fishy appearance, so go wild on these guys!

[h1]Rules[/h1]

1. To qualify, you must submit your full list of suggested names, preferably labeled so we know what characters you are suggesting names for, in the COMMENTS of this very update post. (We'd rather not have a bajillion redundant forum threads about these contests, so let's keep the entries all in one place, yeah?)

2. You may submit a maximum of 15 names TOTAL. Any additional names from the same user past the first 15 will be discounted, so make em count!


[h1]Judging Criteria[/h1]

We'll be judging names on two simple criteria:

1. Appropriateness - Both in terms of how fitting a name is for a certain character or else how appropriate it is to put in a professional product. That means no slurs, swears, or otherwise anything future-you would be ashamed of.

2. Cleverness - This one's purely going to be based on the devs' sense of humor and opinions, but cleverness is just, ya know, how clever the name is thought out. I dunno how to explain cleverness, y'all. Just come up with names that are interesting or amusing and I'm sure you'll do just fine.

[h1]Winners and Prizes[/h1]

[b]1st Place:[/b] 1 entrant with our favorite name/names (again, quality over quantity but if you can manage a lot of top quality, all the better obviously) will have their best names featured in-game by the next update, AND they will be awarded 2 copies of We Need To Go Deeper! 

[b]Runner Ups:[/b] Anyone else who posts a name the team likes enough will have their best names featured in-game starting next update and be recognized as a runner up in next week's contest post! There's plenty of room for runner ups, so post away!

[b]All entries are due no later than January 14, 8:00pm MST.[/b]

Good luck, and happy naming!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]A Very Special Side Note:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/212e9efe7c2b0b3f539c8cbac6bc94733d4b8f86.png[/img]
