notes.title: The Squishy Update (0.7.0) - New Biome & Winter Event!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dfb6228651bf2c4b42e4fdc06d9038f7ea8d1fd1.png[/img]

Get malleable with The Squishy Update! Introducing a brand new biome to explore, the start of our Winter Event, and more! 

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2bdb05ba8d9e18af18284d1bfe8bc4d487841175.png[/img]

[b]New Biome: The Aurelian Depths![/b] - Introducing the Aurelian Depths; a bioluminescent third-layer biome where strange crystal minerals grow  in every crevice, and where jellyfish of all kinds bloom in the viscous pink waters.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/01f27a0deea8d183d52b53d0718450c8624c5bed.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]9 NEW Enemy Types![/b] - From power-disrupting jellyfish to rock-burrowing worms, the Aurelian Depths is host to a wide variety of strange and dangerous new wildlife to discover.
[*] [b]NEW Boss - The Ephyra![/b] - A massive new boss awaits your crew at the bottom of the Aurelian Depths, filled to the brim with electric power...
[*][b]NEW Mysterious Water Effects[/b] - There's something strange about the water down here. Some say a person could breathe it as if it were air.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0ba5615bb363a685992174a39d8afe50bc63ffb7.png[/img]

[b]Bot Replacement Crates![/b] - No longer will your team have to fret when a crew member drops out early, for they will be swiftly replaced via our Bot Crate Delivery system! A crate containing a handy Bot will appear in their place, awaiting to be broken open and freed with a good smack.

[h1]Winter Event[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/45bfa6bba0db21c7c241d22939f0486cb1473520.png[/img]

[b]The Winter Event is Live![/b]
[list][*]5 Special Cosmetics!
[*] Gifting Sugarplum Fairies!
[*] Rabid Rat Foes![/list]
[i]Tis the season for giving, and no one likes giving more than the mysterious and most-likely-a-figment-of-your-imagination [b]Sugarplum Fairies[/b], who have taken it upon themselves to visit people around the world bearing [b]Gifts![/b][/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/19f64a0a3d027f6e11626726042c25d966f90e36.png[/img]

[i]Be wary before opening these Gifts, however. While some Gifts contain great wealth or even one of the legendary [b]Nutcracker Heads[/b], some contain filthy, ravenous [b]Rats[/b] to punish the naughty.[/i]

[b][i]The Sugarplum Fairies will vanish back into humans' collective imagination January 4th.[/i][/b]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-Fixed a bug causing bots to get stuck in caves after being revived
-Fixed a bug where the main power console could "zap" indefinitely after an EMP
-Fixed null references in alert arrow following behavior causing mild slowdowns
-Fixed a bug causing midgame joining players to have invisible walls inside their caves
-Fixed bugs which could cause midgame joining to function poorly on repeat tries

[h1]Balance[/h1]
-Barnacle grabber now has 20% less health
-Players holding a battery will drop it on death
-Players can now click to throw the battery they're holding
-Alerts for help from other players now only appear for 10 seconds

[h1]Community[/h1]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/927044661864141545/4556B287B560B183D664B801A58A6D9AF7B6E395/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A*[/img] Coming to us from amechami, a reminder of the danger posed by throwing insults.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month ::::[/b]

December's Player of the Month is none other than our friendly neighborhood mod, [b]ChildishRambino![/b]

ChildishRambino has been around since the early days, going as far back as the April Update, and has been an avid supporter and community leader ever since. Between his countless efforts to spread the game to everyone and anyone, by talking about it with various streamers and content creators, and his great sense of humor and always-friendly demeanor, ChildishRambino has done more than enough to earn his title as Player of the Month, and we're only sorry it took this long to give him the recognition he deserves.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Update Announcement: January[/h1]

Now would be a good time to go ahead and explain our plans to everyone regarding January's Update. Namely, that [b]there will be no official Update in January[/b], but instead, several [b]Community Competitions[/b] to kick off the new year!

We're doing this for a few reasons:

1. Having no update in January will give us the extra time we need/desire to help make our Anniversary Update (Feb. 8th will mark a year since launch) the best it can possibly be! We have big plans for February's update, and we would love for it to go as smoothly as possible.

2. We've been on a roughly 2-week update schedule (counting events, crate updates, etc.) for almost a year now, and while the experience has been amazing, our small dev team could use some time to relax with family for the holidays before jumping back into a full schedule.

[i]On that note, if you guys have any ideas for what kinds of community-driven competitions, challenges, or contests you'd like to see, let us know in the comments or forums![/i]

notes.title: December Update Sneaky Peaky
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! Nick from Deli Interactive here, and as you may have noticed, this month's update got delayed... With good reason, however! This next update is introducing a brand new BIOME, and will be accompanied by our Winter Event! While we don't have a beta ready yet, in the interest of not keeping y'all in the dark, here's a few previews of some of the new content we're working on:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3f6d3b347b048c459d5f0c3b38f8b4cd3df293c5.png[/img]

This early photoshop mockup of the new biome, [b]The Aurelian Depths[/b], showcases the vivid, otherworldy atmosphere we are aiming for in this jellyfish-centric biome. Hard crystals and rock-burrowing Sea Worms contrast the maternal vibes the rest of the area will be conveying. The biome has changed a lot since this mockup, but it still conveys the overall sense of what you'll be seeing in this biome.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/93bcdaa97f551375b74e383764030cf0915d7781.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1210f3dee9e15be9ab46e897dffc31ed59b54427.gif[/img]

These two are a few of the new enemies you will encounter in the new jellyfish-laden biome. One of these fellas will be able to regenerate limbs once detached from the sub, and the other packs a powerful electric blast that can knock your power right out!

[url=https://soundcloud.com/deli-interactive/jelly-waters][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/04f0d6b3b968c06203c8a7485b0c57f56543914f.png[/img][/url]

Last but not least, you can get a taste of the otherworldy atmosphere for the Aurelian Depths via its completed music track, composed by Jake Lives!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sorry once again for the delay, but we're very excited for the new mechanics and gameplay possibilities this biome will bring to Deeper, so we appreciate your patience with us in the interest of making sure it's the best it can be! As always, continue leaving your feedback and reports, so we can keep trying to improve We Need To Go Deeper!

notes.title: Crate Update #6 - The Grease Crate (0.6.7)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/40fcd19f35ab10f02e76c91e7aeda84e2fccdeca.png[/img]

Get greasy with this month's Crate Update! New Bots and improvements, along with a sprinkling of other fixes are all wrapped up in this nuts and bolts package!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/432dc14f496bc34c84fcdd765280ce090977b2e4.png[/img]

[b]New Bot Types![/b] - You asked for it, so we added a new Bot Selection feature to let you pick Bots with different specialties to bring on your adventures! Introducing the rough-and-ready [b]Fight Bots[/b] and the hippocratic oath-ing [b]Med Bots![/b]

[i]To choose a bot type, select the Bot portrait after adding a Bot in a lobby to bring up the Bot Selection Menu, and diversify away![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7637df022812faeee04f8705df79f5360450fdc8.png[/img]

[b]64 Bit Performance Boost![/b] - Those with 64 bit operating systems are in for a treat, because they just got a big ol' performance boost with this update thanks to some good old fashioned compiling nonsense. It's hard to explain, but trust us, the game is a little faster now for y'all living in the 64 bit future world.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/22032ecbad925b4851e1c070f12b1bde208b9e94.png[/img]

[b]Steam Friend Invites![/b] Last but not least, you can now invite your Steam friends into games directly using our high-tec "Invite" button in the game lobby! Ping your friends like it's the 90's and everyone has a pager. I never had one, but I hear they worked exactly like Steam Invites.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed auto-disconnects caused by sub deletion.
- Fixed removal of spaces in Steam Lobby data causing long lobby creation times.
- Possibly fixed players disconnecting while on cannon causing it to be unusable or locking in other players.

---------------------------------------------------

Let us know what y'all think of the new update as always! And stay tuned these next few months, because we're finally starting to break free of the mandatory technical updates and can dive back into that sweet, sweet content we all like so much.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7637df022812faeee04f8705df79f5360450fdc8.png[/img]

[b]64 Bit Performance Boost![/b] - Those with 64 bit operating systems are in for a treat, because they just got a big ol' performance boost with this update thanks to some good old fashioned compiling nonsense. It's hard to explain, but trust us, the game is a little faster now for y'all living in the 64 bit future world.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/22032ecbad925b4851e1c070f12b1bde208b9e94.png[/img]

[b]Steam Friend Invites![/b] Last but not least, you can now invite your Steam friends into games directly using our high-tec "Invite" button in the game lobby! Ping your friends like it's the 90's and everyone has a pager. I never had one, but I hear they worked exactly like Steam Invites.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed auto-disconnects caused by sub deletion.
- Fixed removal of spaces in Steam Lobby data causing long lobby creation times.
- Possibly fixed players disconnecting while on cannon causing it to be unusable or locking in other players.

---------------------------------------------------

Let us know what y'all think of the new update as always! And stay tuned these next few months, because we're finally starting to break free of the mandatory technical updates and can dive back into that sweet, sweet content we all like so much.

notes.title: The Sudden Arrival Update (0.6.6) | Mid-Game Joining, Discord Integration & More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/34602cacecd2e94fd7e71159e894422e89ed4374.png[/img]

Prepare yourself, because November's Official Content Update is comin' in hot! Mid-Game Joining, new state-of-the-art Discord integration and more has arrived!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a07bd7215c5e699e67a140aa5d556c38db242978.png[/img]

[b]Mid-Game Joining![/b] - Thanks to the power of Time Travel (and countless coffee fueled network code nights for Jordan), players can finally join adventures in progress! Now you can [b]warp[/b] into games guns-blazing, and rescue crews from their demise, or else host a public game yourself filled with a skeleton crew of Bots, to have them replaced by real players over the course of your adventure! Who needs to wait around in lobbies when you have swashbuckling Mid-Game Join action!?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/09adbb1cbcb80bc0b62699ea12b4940da7a354d7.png[/img]

[b]Note: If you'd rather not have players warping into your session, or else if you want Bots to be irreplaceable by mere mortal flesh, you can toggle both of these via Game Options in the Lobby. [/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/bac9c8deda35375dce854c7dd31b1cc9cc6e8fdc.png[/img]

[b]Discord "Rich Presence" Integration![/b] - The top secret labs over at Discord Head Quarters have been brewing up a brand new way to join games with friends, and we've been along for the ride! 

Discord's newest feature is called "Rich Presence" - and We Need To Go Deeper is on board!

https://discordapp.com/rich-presence

With Rich Presence, your Discord friends can see what you are up to in-game, displaying everything from what Biome you are currently traversing, to what submarine you are driving! More importantly, they can see how big your crew is, so they'll know the perfect time to warp into your game! We Need To Go Deeper is among the first group of games to integrate with Discord in such a way, so now you too can feel like you're getting in on some real ground-floor gaming science.

Also - The We Need To Go Deeper Discord is now [b]Verified![/b] So if you haven't already, join the [url=http://discord.gg/wntgd]Official WNTGD Discord [/url]community and get in on the sweet, sweet, science action.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fa22cba575c45bda859a10604e11e529fb0b78e3.png[/img]

[b]New Relics![/b] - The Living Infinite spills its secrets once more with brand new Relics to uncover in every biome. Each one is chock full of juicy hints regarding The Living Infinite's mysterious history and cultures, so bust out your shovels and start digging... for knowledge.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c40f8ed8b23916db0d8360cdc716c4c849f2823c.png[/img]

[b]Tips![/b] - You'll notice when diving into another adventure that some helpful new in-game tips will occasionally pop up to remind you how to engage with the world! These tips are here to help new and returning players learn how to get into the swing of things! Veteran swashbucklers who would rather not see these tips can also turn them off at will via the Options Menu.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7b250b8e954dad6ae7c1e34e7d7c1e5c3c1c79aa.png[/img]

[b]Command Wheel as Quick Chat![/b] - The Command Wheel (Middle Mouse by Default) has been equipped with brand new functionality! Now not only can you use the command wheel to order around loyal Bots, but you can order around your human crew as well! At the touch of a button, send snap messages to your team about your need to heal, assistance with torpedoes (which Bots are also now capable of), or just tell them they're doing a [strike]great[/strike] terrible job! 

[b]Additionally, the Command Wheel is no longer exclusive to the Host! Joining players can shout at their team and bots as well as anyone.[/b]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed Bots not being able to navigate past frozen/vined up doors. Bots will now destroy door obstacles when needed.
- Fixed Bots occasionally getting stuck in submarine hatches.
- Fixed player count displaying incorrectly on LAN games.
- Online games should (hopefully) no longer be able to exceed max player limits.
- Fixed custom game option player health not being applied to clients correctly.
- Fixed loadout confirmation being dependent on other players.

[h1]Community Highlights[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

November's Player of the Month award goes to... [b]därSeebär![/b]

This one has been a long time coming, because while Steam user därSeebär has only recently jumped back into the community proper after a period of absence (a friendly reminder that real life should always take priority over games of course), it's hard to overstate just how helpful this dude is whenever he has been present. därSeebär has taken an incredibly professional and leader-like approach to everything he's done in the WNTGD community, from creating helpful templates and guides to smooth the process of editing the [url=https://weneedtogodeeper.gamepedia.com/We_Need_To_Go_Deeper_Wiki]WNTGD Wiki[/url], to jump-starting the creation of an [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/WNTGDWikiEditors]official group for diligent Wiki editors[/url], and on top of that taking on Mod duties within the [url=https://discord.gg/wntgd]WNTGD Discord[/url] and Steam Forums. This guy's been ever-helpful and supportive since day one, and showcases an admirable sense of professionalism in everything he does. Thank you, därSeebär!

As always, the Player of the Month will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD to send to friends and family as a reward for their efforts.

[b]::: Community Showcase :::[/b]

First up on the showcase is this incredible Halloween costume of Pale Jaw, sent to us by fan Eve Moran. We were blown away by this creation, and the attention to detail (Pale Jaw seen here munching on a small model of The Crevette) really puts the [strike]cherry[/strike] candy corn on top. Thanks Eve!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ce5ce480d0f70734057f383ec619edc673997da.jpg[/img]

Speaking of costumes, we also received via email these great hand-made costume suggestions for WNTG characters by fans OnkelTino and bubuassnibba! The french artist is by far my favorite of the bunch here. We may yet see some of these become a reality yet.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d520273e78a00ec92c51d38daede631abcce5833.png[/img]

Meanwhile, resident goat enthusiast Gote The Capricorn Trickster has been brewing up these cute and fun fan designs for a "Land Shark" pet, this one being my favorite:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1146830392

In  less cute news, Wrzlprnft seems to be performing some kind of black magic ritual with the Dev team lately. Here's hoping we'll survive whatever hexes he's got planned.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1163802814

For those looking for a laugh, ZeroScotty brewed up a new video recently detailing their crew's first experience with some particularly rude Bots, fashioned and edited into a few choice highlights from their adventure:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1175610956

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what you guys think of the new update, and be sure and leave your thoughts in the forums! Happy diving, y'all!

notes.title: Mid-Game Joining 0.6.6 Beta is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! We're once again releasing some of the new update's features out to Beta early so we can stress-test if before the official release! This time around, [b]Mid-game joining[/b] (Joining a game in-progress) is the new feature we want you guys to test out! It's one of the biggest changes thus far and can have a TON of ramifications on the rest of the game and its stability, so this is definitely a feature that needs to be put through the ringer.

[b]NOTE: Bots being replaced by joining players (and vice versa) is not part of this feature just yet.[/b] Ensure you have some slots open when starting a game to test this new feature.

[h1][b]How To Join The Beta:[/b][/h1]

1. Right click We Need To Go Deeper in your Steam Library.

2. Click "Properties"

3. Click the "Betas" tab.

4. Opt into the "beta" branch.

5. Wait for the download to finish, and play!

---------------------------------------------------------------

Let us know in the forums what you find in the Beta! Thanks again, and happy mid-game diving!

notes.title: The "I Need To Go Deeper" Update (0.6.5) | Crew Bots & Fall Event live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/51766fbae93255dc2d2b3096e05999c487e6bc18.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/yuWfGz4w3wQ
Grease those joints up for the official October content update! The Incredible Gear-Driven Gentlemen and Wind-Up Women are here, along with the New Fall Event!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7ba47ab317754170021c02d7242202925daf6aba.png[/img]

[b]Crew Bots![/b] The most handy and helpful Crew Bots are here! Fresh off the Assembly Line, these approximations of human crew members can help fix, defend, and help you on your feet during future expeditions! They've even been programmed to have unique personalities, so it's like you never left home! (Disclaimer: Not a cure for homesickness.)

[b]Here is a full list of the amazing things your brand new Crew Bots can do: [/b]
[list]
[*] Repair Vessels!
[*] Defend Against Invading Foes!
[*] Man the Weapons!
[*] Change Power on Command!
[*] Revive Fallen Comrades!
[*] Explore Caverns!
[*] Future Functions Pending!
[/list]
While Crew Bots are able to make their own decisions (most of the time), you can command your bots to do any of these tasks yourself by utilizing the amazing [b]Command Wheel! (Middle Mouse by Default)[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/462b2238e09b8240a6c9538e5baa8a7e5d767c0f.png[/img]

To add Bots to your next adventure, either Online or Offline, just fill a player slot with these handy Bot-Buttons!™

[h1]Fall Event[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3514cf2ae3c0b0aa1cfc137b991fc6ad44d096e0.png[/img]

[B]The Heads of the Horseman Fall Event is Live![/b]
[list]
[*] 5 New Unlockable Cosmetics!
[*] 2 New Spooky Enemy Types!
[*] 1 New Mini-Boss!
[/list]
[i]As the leaves descend from the trees, so too does the vengeful [b]Headless Horseman [/b]rise from his resting place, donning atop his head twisted mutations of the season's harvest! Only problem is - The Horseman's Heads have disappeared! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0848eddad4b76b0a2844bc25e7df72663e3b37b7.png[/img]

Legends say The Horseman's accursed Produce began spreading their own evil seed among the populace, spawning devilish plantlife throughout the world - including the very depths themselves! The Living Infinite is the latest to be infested with this bountiful harvest of hallowed fruit - and The Horseman will hunt down anyone who dares get in his way of reclaiming these lost heads![/i]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9882ffb3cbacb74de221a1ae3f22973b9e98ab9a.png[/img]
[i][b]Of course, there's always the possibility that someone will discover the lost Heads of the Horseman first[/b], should they manage to overcome a plump pumpkiny fate. Even rarer are those that may come across and overcome The Horseman himself, and [b]lay claim to his very own wardrobe[/b]![/i]

Act quick, mortal adventurers, for [b]The Horseman will return to his grave on November 10th.[/b]

[h1]Balance & Fixes[/h1]

-Time Traveler will not appear after game over.
-Time Traveler slightly less likely to rescue crew from dire situations.
-Fixed a bug causing grabber and stabber type enemies to collide with the sub from inexplicable distances

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A huge thanks to all of the community members who helped us test out this update so we could iron out the kinks! There are surely still more kinks to iron out, but we couldn't have released this without y'all! Thanks again, and happy diving!

-Fixed a bug causing grabber and stabber type enemies to collide with the sub from inexplicable distances

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A huge thanks to all of the community members who helped us test out this update so we could iron out the kinks! There are surely still more kinks to iron out, but we couldn't have released this without y'all! Thanks again, and happy diving!

notes.title: 0.6.5 Beta is LIVE! (With Rewards!) | Player of the Month Announced!
notes.notes:
After a few sleepless nights, The Crew Bots are finally ready to be Beta Tested! And given the importance of this update's new main feature to our playerbase, we're bringing back Beta Testing Rewards in the form of the Duopus Hat! 

[b]Read on to see instructions on how to qualify.[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3ae146896f6fa915e734efc73c663622f00dfef5.png[/img]
[h1] [b]How To Earn the Duopus Hat:[/b][/h1]
[b]
1. Play the new 0.6.5 Beta Branch (see below for instructions).

2. Test out the new Crew Bots feature (see below for instructions).

3. Make a new post in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/2/]We Need To Go Deeper Steam Discussions[/url] with "BETA" included in the title of the post, outlining your feedback on the new Beta within.
[/b]

Friend requests will then be sent out to [b]those who qualify[/b] at the end of the Beta phase, and be given their Duopus Hat code.

[h1] [b]How To Join The Beta:[/b][/h1]

1. Right click We Need To Go Deeper in your Steam Library.

2. Click "Properties"

3. Click the "Betas" tab.

4. Opt into the "beta" branch.

5. Wait for the download to finish, and play!

[h1] [b]How To Use Bots:[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/462b2238e09b8240a6c9538e5baa8a7e5d767c0f.png[/img]

Crew Bots are now available to activate or deactivate at will in any Online or LAN Lobby via these fancy little metallic buttons. Simply click the button to fill the slot with a Crew Bot in place of a human! Single player games are now possible with this, and Bots will happily fill in to help out smaller crews!

The plan from here is to use your feedback to get these Crew Bots whipped into shape, balance-wise and polish-wise! We'll keep patching until we think it's ready for an official release!  Enjoy, and let us know what you think of the new Crew Bots!

----------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[h1] [b]Player of The Month[/b][/h1]

While this month was slower than most, our most passionate community members kept the discussion alive throughout, and most importantly, kept up their sense of fun and humor despite the recent lull! 

One player in particular has kept up his sense of humor throughout all of Early Access, more often than not causing many team-members to spill their coffee over his dry, often unexpected wit. That's why [b]Bread Scientist[/b] is October's Player of the Month!

While Bread Scientist may not be posting regularly, when he does you can be sure it'll deaden your spirits in the best way possible. With his Bill Murray-esque dry humor sensibilities, Bread Scientist manages to keep up a very consistent record of making developers and fans alike burst into laughter. Thanks Bread Scientist for all the laughs, and keep up the good work!

notes.title: Update 0.6.5 Has Been Delayed :(
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/94813596e34dec4a89a424adbb1564b4d2001a73.png[/img]

Sorry for the lateness of this announcement, as I'm sure many of you are wondering why today's scheduled Content Update did not go live. 

[b]In short - we have a few more major kinks to work out of this new update, as it features some pretty crazy complicated new things - AI Helper Bots mainly - that as it turns out, could not be churned out with sufficient polish in a mere month's time. [/b]

We'd rather delay than release something we know isn't ready to be played with yet, so unfortunately we're gonna have to take a little longer to kick these Bots into high gear, so to speak.

We had planned on releasing a Beta version of the build by the end of the day if it was functional enough, but here we are and that's not the case. Hopefully this week should see a release of a Beta version of this new update for y'all to test with so we can get these Bots into tip-top shape for the official release! 

As always, thank you all for your patience and continuous feedback! We try not to delay an update unless absolutely necessary, but we think you guys will appreciate the end result!

notes.title: Crate Update #5 - The Squishy Crate (0.6.3)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/594c0c9054094f4296be79aa70def10f9c426394.png[/img]

Unpack a whole lot of squishy, slimy monstrosity and good old fashioned balance changes in this month's Crate Update!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/459790383f54fa3e4d7f30e37aa28e4a9dc0b921.png[/img]

[b]New Boss: The Quadken![/b] - A new four-tentacled behemoth has arrived in the depths of The Atlantic Waters in the form of the squishy and monstrous Quadken! The Mother of all Duopi, The Quadken will do anything to protect her young from surface invaders, and with four powerful tentacles to shield her, daring adventurers will have to outmaneuver and outsmart this angry mother if they wish to venture past her sticky domain.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/47dfcd4a9e12a981e75aba1369f06a00f261a34d.gif[/img]

[b]Swap-At-Will Sub Weapons![/b] - After our many attempts to balance our previous iteration of the two-gun ammo system for the Weapon Station, we have once again altered the functionality of the Weapons Station as you know it! Now those at the Weapons Console will be able to [b]swap shooting styles at will at the press of a button![/b] By default, [b]A[/b] and [b]D[/b] will now swap the current gun being used by the Submarine, with Weapons Power being used instead to determine how much firing power you have available to you at any given time! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/39c62c1c478baf50df48cd1f146bc1d083f6f50c.png[/img]

[b]Time Traveler Rescue![/b] - When put into dire situations, The Time Traveler now has a chance to come to your rescue! Whether it be through dumping a load of Health Elixirs into the ship, warping your vessel out of a messy situation entirely, or restoring your vessel to its original unbroken state of being, The Time Traveler is here to help! Sometimes. More often now, anyway. 

[i]Special Tip: The Time Traveler is even more likely to help now with some encouragement.[/i]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/70c7d6af9e13403fd4a109ee619286b875410e82.png[/img]

[b]Balance-palooza![/b] Balancing out some of our new features and long-standing issues has been a major priority of this update! In fact, the last two features listed above are in themselves also features of this balance shift. Now for the rest of the Balance-palooza:

-The EMP no longer uses fuel! Instead, it recharges over the course of a minute, and has helpful light indicators to show it recharging! Use unlimited times!
-The base EMP damage has been increased
-The machine gun now fires slower at one power and faster at two power than the previous update's values.
-The time traveler is now especially fond of the phonograph. Perhaps keeping one around will encourage him to bring in nice things?
-The cheat checker should now actually shut down cheated games.
-The dynamic difficulty system is now willing to give much longer rests to crews who turn the engines off
-Rests caused by extended combat time are now longer on average

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
-Solid rocks using polygon colliders! Tired of the sub flying into the rocks and getting stuck forever? Tired of enemies doing the same thing? We were too. 
-Fixed several cave chunks which had impossible ladders or would yield a path that couldn't be traversed by players
-Fixed a bug that was causing "custom game" parameter to be sticky and incorrectly flag a game as custom (preventing saving of newly found items)
-Fixed some bad logic on doors causing them too close early or not stay open for players

[h1]Other[/h1]
-The exterior camera is now more zoomed out during boss fights so you can see those sweet sweet Quadken animations.

notes.title: The Timely Update (0.6.2) - Time Traveler, Trading Cards and More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/cb2e9570c775258be5090e1c3388e9a127e0a194.png[/img]

Get [i]warped[/i] in September's official content update! This month we have a feast for your eyes and ears, and a very special visitor will be making his presence known in the world of We Need To Go Deeper - The unknowable Time Traveler!

[h1]Content[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f8c84236dec93c8c798afcd408dcc2e9fb50e713.png[/img]

[b]Time Traveler Events![/b] - The enigmatic, inscrutable Time Traveler has started warping inside the vessels of ongoing expeditions, and may cause all kinds of michief and mayhem, including:

[b]Time Travel "Souvenirs!"[/b] - The Traveler often brings with him "souvenirs" from his travels to leave behind in your vessel, of both the dangerous and helpful variety. Will The Traveler leave behind one of [b]14 New Unique Enemies[/b] from all reaches of time and space? Or will he leave your crew a helpful upgrade, item, or elixir? Only TIME will tell!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fb98a1c3282de49851f54aaa2ac40d56136e9a9f.gif[/img]

[b]Alternate Timelines![/b] Sometimes, The Traveler may deem it necessary to warp your crew to a different timeline altogether! Timelines can be unstable, so be on your toes when you find yourself in unexpected places!

[b]Mysterious Messages![/b] Finally, keep an ear out for what The Traveler has to say when he passes by, because sometimes he'll have special messages to share that may hint at The Living Infinite's deepest secrets...

[i]The Time Traveler may yet have more tricks up his sleeve in the future, so keep your eyes peeled![/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/773f0ca64a58dd8a994467ff235d1587dcb67621.png[/img]

[b]Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons and Backgrounds![/b] - By popular demand, The Steam Trading Card system has now come to We Need To Go Deeper! Featuring original, hand-drawn 19th century style card art to represent all of the classic WNTGD player roles, 9 different possible WNTGD-themed emoticons to unlock, 3 uniqe Steam backgrounds based off WNTGD's darkest biomes, and of course, shiny port-hole badges to show off your Deeper dedication!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4b96a99cd120654b938d41b8887f097084c8da0a.png[/img]

[b]Official Soundtrack Now Available for FREE![/b] - Even though the game is still in development, many of you have been asking us time and time again when we'd be able to make available all of the tracks we have thus far. Starting today, we've released and will continue to release all of the game's tracks for FREE on Soundcloud! Kick back and relax to the sweet sounds of [b][url=https://soundcloud.com/deli-interactive/sets/the-marvelous-music-of-we-need]"The Marvelous Music of We Need To Go Deeper."[/url][/b]

 [i] Additionally, be sure to check out our Bonus Album, [b][url=https://soundcloud.com/deli-interactive/sets/the-buried-treasure-of-we-need]"Buried Treasure"[/url][/b] - full of all of our unused/demo tracks![/i]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-Found and fixed a problem in identifying weapons in hand over the network which was causing packet buildup and desync
-Fixed a potential off-by-one network identity numbering bug caused by a prefab with two network identities
-Optimized interior enemy collision/trigger checking
-Fixed two more sources of move speed bugs
-Fixed a scaling problem on puke piles (seriously, how do these guys keep coming up with problems?)
-Dynamite can no longer repair breaks - yes, even if you aim it really well. 
-Fixed a problem getting fish school sprites after changing water layer
-Fixed the bug causing permanent disarming if a player is thrown in the brig while carrying a torpedo or battery
-Fixed a problem where networked position syncing failed to account for gravity scale
-Made one more failsafe for a rare bug where an exterior enemy spawns directly after entering a cave, which cannot be killed

[h1]Balance[/h1]
-Fuel drop chance in caves increased 10%
-Battery drop chance in caves increased 13%
-Increased time between spawns on all hatcher type enemies

[h1]Other[/h1]
-The Espadon now costs 5000 less gold in the catalog
-Chat messages now stay onscreen twice as long

[h1]Community[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

August's Player of the Month is... [b]Pigeon Man![/b]

Pigeon Man has been a huge help in the community, particularly on the forums. They've taken the time not only to give feedback and suggestions but can also often be found troubleshooting and helping others through bugs and problems. He's constantly offering to test with us and has sent many log files that have helped us identify some tough bugs! Pigeon Man approaches everyone with kindness and a great sense of humor; it's always clear that they're dedicated simply to helping us out, for which we are very grateful.

As usual, our Player of the Month Pigeon Man will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for their efforts. 

[b]::: Community Content :::[/b]

This month Steam user ADcrafter started spinning a new tale of a Living Infinite expedition in the newfound Lore & Stories subforum! You can read the first two parts of his new sea tale here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1473096694438404786/

-----------------------------------------------------------

Thank you to everyone for supporting us as always, and let us know what you think of the update! Happy TRAVELS, y'all!

notes.title: Crate Update #4 - The Ramming Crate (0.6.0)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/713445d0319578319a1fd1cd3a0cbaadfb061264.png[/img]

This month's Crate Update is all about quality over quantity. There's not much packed in this crate, but what is here sure does fill a whole lotta space! A new Submarine, Network fixes and more await those who dare unpack The Ramming Crate!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f51547bcc5656ccf9d98e93f53bb70c5a7c34d95.png[/img]
[b]New purchasable submarine with a RAAAAAAAMMMMMMM! IT GO BAAAAAAMMMMM![/b]

That's right, a new Submarine has entered the mix, but this time, you better save up your bottom dollar for it! Introducing [b]The Espadon[/b] a brand-new vessel equipped with a large sharp nose, made for piercing foes, and charging through obstacles like nobody's business! It's the fastest sub in the game so far, though speed comes at a price, for there are no shields equipped on this bad boy, so you better make good use of your offensive capabilities.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
-FINALLY fixed permanent movement impairing effects. 
-Entirely new low-bandwidth smooth position syncing for players, interior enemies, and some exterior hazards
-Excess spawn points in caves now spawn more decorations - caves should look ever so slightly more lively
-Fixed a problem with connection logging that was giving us weird impossible data when we looked at connection success rates
-Fixed bubbles and other particle emitters which were throwing errors after scenes had changed
-Fixed yet another problem that was causing the Blobfish not to leave puke all over the sub. Now he will. You're welcome.
-Fixed a problem where the barnacle swiper could damage the sub multiple times in a row

[h1]Balance[/h1]
-The amount of gold per pile has been reduced to accommodate the higher treasure drop rate from the last update
-Fuel drop rate similarly decreased in caves to accommodate the higher treasure drop rate


[h1]Community[/h1]

Some really awesome Community Content was brought to light to us this week thanks to Youtuber Draegast's coverage of some Deeper-flavored fan-made creations in Besiege! 

Both of these Besiege creations by Censored Studios are beautifully designed recreations of certain aspects of WNTGD! One is a fully-fleshed out Crevette Vessel, complete with all its interior bits and bobs, and the other is a fully-featured mini-game complete with submarine piloting, exploring, shooting swimming enemies and fighting a boss at the end of a trench! If you're a Besiege owner you can download the mods below, and gameplay can be seen in the Draegast video linked below that!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1081946252

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1110464522

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JTierlohU9U&feature=youtu.be&t=5m41sid=1110464522&searchtext=deeper

----------------------------------------------------------------

Let us know what you think of the update as always! Happy diving!

----------------------------------------------------------------

Stealth fixes (post-update patched items):
-Fixed a move speed bug which was causing players to speed off in negative directions
-Torpedoes no longer explode on contact with the Espadon ram
-Ram damage is much more proportional to the speed of the crash
-Ram now damages ice chunks properly, and deals more damage to ice chunks on average than enemies
-Updated Unity to 5.6.3, which alleges more networking stability fixes, especially with the specialized connection types and channels we use for Deeper (see all fixes marked "Multiplayer" in https://unity3d.com/unity/whats-new/unity-5.6.3)
-Torpedo damage has been redistributed. A direct hit yields 6 damage, whereas area of effect damage yields 5 damage (adjusted from the previous 10 for direct hit and 1 for area of effect)
-Increased Perle submarine speed 10% for all power levels
-Reduced max cave enemy count by 17%
-Reduced "hatcher" enemy type frequency by ~15%, depending on biome
-Fixed a couple of obvious graphical mishaps in the Espadon interior

notes.title: The Milking-It Update (0.5.9)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/77b46b357faaa5b73735f232389c7590a61e9a2b.png[/img]

Get your lactose on for August's official content update! After the feedback we got from last month's update, we've been doubling down this month on milking the most out of the game's features to increase replayability, moment-to-moment thrills, and addressing the community's most pressing desires and concerns from our recent balance changes! Grab a carton, and let's dive right in!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a6b749567ed0baab637c0a87fa14bbf54ba66fcb.gif[/img]
[i]Above: Our Cave Generator at Work[/i]

[b]Revamped Procedural Generation![/b] - By far this month's biggest focus was giving our procedural generation systems a much-needed kick in the udder! Both of our exterior Trench and interior Cave algorithms got a well-deserved revamping - changes including but not limited to:[i]

[b]- Diversified Levels:[/b] Each level generator has had a sizable new sampling of level styles and layouts added to generate from, ensuring more diversity and unpredictability for future playthroughs! This includes new claustrophobic areas that require players to crouch through, and open platforming areas to leap through!

[b]- Multi-layered Caves:[/b] Caves can now be generated in a variety of different sizes and layers, ranging from small crab hovels to sprawling multi-floored caverns with branching paths!

[b]- Sub-biomes:[/b] While exploring the Trench, you may occasionally come across smaller colored sub-biomes, restricted to generating certain kinds of wildlife and obstacles, to further diversify your moment-to-moment explorations.

[b]- Spawn grouping:[/b] Individual cave chunks are now able to better control their spawning habits, creating more interesting clusters of rewards and danger at a whim. No longer will everything always be spread out thinly like butter, but in clusters! Come across a horde of crabs one moment, and a treasure trove the next!

[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/54e1148c59b8c4762abaaea890299bbc81303bf3.png[/img]

[b]Custom Game Options![/b] - By far one of the most commonly requested features, Custom Game Options are finally here! No longer will your games be at the developers' mercy, for these first four option sliders (more to come) will allow you to customize just how challenging you want your adventure to be! Play your way!

The Custom Game Options are available to be enabled by the Host when in a game Lobby. [b]WARNING: For balance reasons, Leaderboards and item unlocking are disabled when Custom Game Options are enabled.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/75bf3b62901f483903f05396612944b640ac079c.png[/img]

[b]Back-End Data Gathering![/b] - While it may not be flashy, our newest build now has the ability to send the developers relevant in-game data so we can better track in-game events for important information! This data includes things like Connection Success Rates, Disconnects, Game Length, and so on! 

With this juicy new information, we'll be able to better track and prioritize network stability and game balance across our whole userbase, and not just the vocal minority. As much as we appreciate having such an active community, this is the best way we figure we can ensure the game is still in a good place for our less-vocal players. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/41b47e9f9687f17e6cc3913f5aefb07415f18738.png[/img]

[b]New Spawner Enemy Type![/b] - A new class of enemies has started to appear in select biomes of The Living Infinite - the relentless Spawners! From hatching Egg piles in the Arctic, to miniature crawling Hives in the Infected Depths, Spawners will ensure that those who dare venture alone will have their work cut out for them...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/567d4ac5488f9e92fbfedc3a7d7943c7531ee684.png[/img]

[b]New Relics to Discover![/b] - Just what it says on the tin! A heaping helping of lore-filled relics have been added to The Living Infinite to be discovered, some of which will even help illuminate some of our future content...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c0d37e15631f8f76ec0e88b844d8f9f574312978.png[/img]

[b]Revamped Fuel Mechanics![/b] - Last month's Fuel mechanic was quite the divisive one among our players; with some folks appreciating the new challenge that came with managing a new resource, while others felt like it was more of an annoyance. After reading a ton of your guys' feedback and deliberating, we think we may have hit the sweet spot with the mechanic!

Now no longer does Fuel automatically get spent when the engines are turned up, but instead, only gets used when the Driver wants to put the pedal to the metal, so to speak. (Or when firing an EMP)

[b]When driving, you can BOOST using Fuel by holding down the Fire Button (Spacebar by default).[/b] 

We think this new implementation makes the use of fuel much more deliberate, and honestly all-around more fun! We hope y'all will agree when you start using it yourselves!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/71cc3a2d41f83b8c562b53b4b8aba11e8f5d8961.png[/img]

[b]Milky Cosmetics![/b] - Last but not least, a few new cosmetics were added in honor of this month's update! Get your farmer tan on with the new Farmer Attire and Farm Hat, or Graze and Dive with the Bessie Mask!

[h1]Bug Fixes/Improvements[/h1]
-A serious relay connection issue was found and fixed. The relays should now be correctly picking up the slack when other connection types fail (read: better connection success rates)
-Unity updated to 5.6, giving us the far improved new network transport system. This should dramatically reduce disconnects caused by packet buffering (read: more stable in-game connections).
-Updated our connection tool to get the latest fixes in Open NAT/UPNP functionality (read: better connection success rates)
-Updated our punchthrough facilitator to match the new connection tool update, which should increase punchthrough rates (read: better connection success rates)
-Cave enemies' target detection code has been greatly optimized and now does much fewer raycasts and no longer uses search functions to find players
-Fixed a bug where barrels were spawning their loot into the ground
-Updated Steamworks .NET plugin, which should reduce "Steam integration not initialized" errors
-Cheat checker should no longer be incorrectly flagging players as cheating (as always, if it does incorrectly flag you, please let us know on the forums so we can track down any edge cases)
-Fixed the loud time traveler sounds when the game is about to loop

[h1]Balance[/h1]
-All base submarine speeds without fuel use have been increased
-Fuel consumption rate is now higher to accommodate for higher base speeds and boosting being optional
-Level length per water layer decreased by 20%
-Maximum caves per water layer decreased by 33% to match the lower level length and huge cave possiblities
-The camera following the sub now zooms in when the sub moves faster to help more careful shooting at low speeds and more hilarious crashes at high speeds.
-Cave enemy count now scales with player count

[h1]Other[/h1]
-You can now rebind the driving and cannon rotation controls in the options menu (useful if you want to un-invert them!)
-All voice/text chat can be enabled or disabled in the options menu
-Removed the old IPv6 warning from the Play menu
-Added a new warning in the Play menu to tell players if they have a VPN network adapter turned on (this causes joining online to fail most of the time)

[h1]Community Highlights[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

July's Player of the Month is... [b]ADcrafter![/b]

ADcrafter has been one of our most active community members since they first jumped into the game, and have been a great help in keeping the spirit alive during this busy month for us, where we were unable to deliver either an in-game event or a Crate Update to help with the mid-month lulls. ADcrafter has, in the meantime, been collaborating with other users on fan works, giving constant feedback/suggestions in the forums, and has been helping others troubleshoot their problems, including walking folks through on how to send us output logs (a great deal of the logs we have gotten this month came through thanks to ADcrafter's help, and have helped illuminate some new issues some of our newer players are experiencing!) Between ADcrafter's persistence, kindness, and creativity, ADcrafter has done more than enough to deserve this month's Player of the Month award.

As usual, our Player of the Month ADcrafter will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for their efforts. 

[b]::: Community Content Highlight :::[/b]

There's been a lot of cool Deeper-related fan content this month, that I'm not even sure where to begin! 

First up is this freakin' awesome 3D model of WNTGD's Tesla Gun, posted in the Official Discord by Discord user Silver0034. Its accuracy is top-notch and I want a printed model of this thing for my desk like, yesterday.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/319482214222004234/336904435194134539/unknown.png

Next up, "Lazy Robo" - a fan art piece by Steam user Legend of Jordy, depicting a We Need To Go Deeper styled automoton resting it up on the shore, drinking a nice cool glass of Fuel. This piece is both incredibly charming and quite faithful to the game's style! 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1076637389

Next we have this lovely instructional video by Steam user Eok.Zero on how to properly use We Need To Go Deeper's Brig system - for griefing your friends. ːsteamhappyː

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=975346732

Next, this screenshot of an expertly synchronized team death by Steam user yuda0907 is oddly satisfying:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1082094487

... While Steam user Solger Barky-Sharky's snapshot of their crew's encounter with two giant boarding Boars is a pretty gnarly shot in its own right.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1080479651

Finally, we have a few highlights from the Steam Forums as well - with Steam user JJXDoge having recently put together an impressive Crevette submarine in Minecraft:

http://imgur.com/a/LWbu7

...and Steam users ADCrafter and Freemankiller at it with some more excellent collaborative fan fiction - this time with some additional classic literature influences thrown in for good measure!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/0/1456202492186289176/

------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what you think of the new update, and thanks for continuing to help us keep the WNTGD community strong and growing! We're 6 months out from when we first launched on Early Access now - and still going strong! In a large part thanks to all of y'all and your support! Keep helping us spread the word as always, and happy diving! :D

------------------------------------------------

Hotfixed changes since update:
-Fixed snail spawner type enemy producing way too many snails
-Fixed the cheat checker flagging catalog purchases as cheating (whoops!)
-Changed spawn distribution/number of enemies in caves to reduce "bald spots" where cave chunks contain nothing and prevent crazy overpopulated caves
-Fixed cave music not playing upon entering a cave
-Balanced EMP to no longer bias enemy spawning against the sub (fuel is the new cost)
-Fixed a painting in the Perle appearing behind a girder
-Slightly optimized cave spine destruction

ADcrafter has been one of our most active community members since they first jumped into the game, and have been a great help in keeping the spirit alive during this busy month for us, where we were unable to deliver either an in-game event or a Crate Update to help with the mid-month lulls. ADcrafter has, in the meantime, been collaborating with other users on fan works, giving constant feedback/suggestions in the forums, and has been helping others troubleshoot their problems, including walking folks through on how to send us output logs (a great deal of the logs we have gotten this month came through thanks to ADcrafter's help, and have helped illuminate some new issues some of our newer players are experiencing!) Between ADcrafter's persistence, kindness, and creativity, ADcrafter has done more than enough to deserve this month's Player of the Month award.

As usual, our Player of the Month ADcrafter will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for their efforts. 

[b]::: Community Content Highlight :::[/b]

There's been a lot of cool Deeper-related fan content this month, that I'm not even sure where to begin! 

First up is this freakin' awesome 3D model of WNTGD's Tesla Gun, posted in the Official Discord by Discord user Silver0034. Its accuracy is top-notch and I want a printed model of this thing for my desk like, yesterday.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/319482214222004234/336904435194134539/unknown.png

Next up, "Lazy Robo" - a fan art piece by Steam user Legend of Jordy, depicting a We Need To Go Deeper styled automoton resting it up on the shore, drinking a nice cool glass of Fuel. This piece is both incredibly charming and quite faithful to the game's style! 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1076637389

Next we have this lovely instructional video by Steam user Eok.Zero on how to properly use We Need To Go Deeper's Brig system - for griefing your friends. ːsteamhappyː

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=975346732

Next, this screenshot of an expertly synchronized team death by Steam user yuda0907 is oddly satisfying:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1082094487

... While Steam user Solger Barky-Sharky's snapshot of their crew's encounter with two giant boarding Boars is a pretty gnarly shot in its own right.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1080479651

Finally, we have a few highlights from the Steam Forums as well - with Steam user JJXDoge having recently put together an impressive Crevette submarine in Minecraft:

http://imgur.com/a/LWbu7

...and Steam users ADCrafter and Freemankiller at it with some more excellent collaborative fan fiction - this time with some additional classic literature influences thrown in for good measure!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/0/1456202492186289176/

------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what you think of the new update, and thanks for continuing to help us keep the WNTGD community strong and growing! We're 6 months out from when we first launched on Early Access now - and still going strong! In a large part thanks to all of y'all and your support! Keep helping us spread the word as always, and happy diving! :D

------------------------------------------------

Hotfixed changes since update:
-Fixed snail spawner type enemy producing way too many snails
-Fixed the cheat checker flagging catalog purchases as cheating (whoops!)
-Changed spawn distribution/number of enemies in caves to reduce "bald spots" where cave chunks contain nothing and prevent crazy overpopulated caves
-Fixed cave music not playing upon entering a cave
-Balanced EMP to no longer bias enemy spawning against the sub (fuel is the new cost)
-Fixed a painting in the Perle appearing behind a girder
-Slightly optimized cave spine destruction

notes.title: The Splurge & Surge Update (0.5.8) | New Sub, Voice Chat, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6499939d8372698148b82cb12e80229bf3e9b3f8.png[/img]

Fuel up for July's content update! This month we're bringing the JUICE. Whether that be of the boosting, vocal, or electric variety. Complete with a new electrically charged 2-crew vessel, integrated voice chat, and more. Read on to find out what's in store!

[h1]Content[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2b21644a4b4616ed3e7b021396245e6fde06fc79.png[/img]

[b]New Vessel: The Perle![/b] - This compact little fella puts everything you need in between one big ladder and a whole lotta power, making it perfectly suited for bite-sized crews. It may be small, but what it lacks in speed and armor it makes up for in electric boogaloo. The Perle comes equipped with upgraded shields and a harder-hitting EMP, making this a safe option for first-timers.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/17b9599ac7ee071254bf08e60802dd9af00b396a.png[/img]

[b]Native Voice Chat![/b] - Shout at your crew like never before with our newly integrated native voice chat! At the press of a button (V by default) you too can bark orders or tell sea shanties and whales of tales to your fellow sea dogs. For those who prefer peace and quiet, you can also mute those sailor mouths with the use of the Player Info Window (Tab by default)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1bb5e9629dea4241c9f2e51677ec17790ac69231.png[/img]

[b]Fuel![/b] - Introducing a new resource into the Deeper world - Fuel! The formerly electric vessels are now hybrids, with Fuel allowing you to cruise at your higher Engine speeds and powering your powerful EMP shots. Spend fuel wisely, though - if you run out you'll be operating on pure electric power, capping your max get-away speed, and EMP's will no longer be operable. 

Have no fear however, for you will be able to refill your tank and even upgrade its capacity with Fuel Canisters and Upgrades you can find in caves!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/966ff75524626ebdae8131fb60e9b452ea8ed56a.png[/img]

[b]A New Foe: The Purussaurus![/b] - The Prehistoric biome just got a lot toothier with this new ancient Crocodile entering its turf. This snappy fella is hungry for adventurer meat, and he'll bust straight through metal to fetch his meal... 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d6f5b28d85c1efd57d16da53935cc9de05008b01.png[/img]

[b]New Aquatic Life![/b] - A wide variety of new fish species have appeared in The Living Infinite's various biomes. They don't bite, but they sure do make the place look nicer. Note: Please do not tap on glass.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f9e715e3362a087a992fd7bad0062a8fe387990d.png[/img]

[b]New Special Cave Drop: The Battery![/b] - This strange-looking electric capsule doesn't behave like most Vessel Upgrades you're used to - this fella needs to be picked up and plugged into a Power Console! Once plugged in, The Battery will constantly provide an external source of power to the console it's attached to, until it runs out of juice! Free up your energy costs and plug in a battery!
Note: bring a friend to watch your back when you are hauling a battery; these fellas are heavy and will take both your arms to lift!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where the host player could only use machine gun functionality by holding space bar rather than tapping it
-Spamming 'E' to load torpedoes or put them back in the dispenser should no longer overload them when the connection to the host has high latency
-The "relative to my score" switch on the leaderboard should no longer stay stuck
-Cave enemy ragdolls' scale is now set based on the exact size of the enemy before death
-Fixed a bug causing caves not to spawn in the first layer
-Fixed a bug in music syncing which was causing networking backups and disconnects
-Fixed a bug in miniboss setup code which was causing networking backups and disconnects
-Blobfish should be able to vomit again (and yes, this was also causing networking backups and disconnects)
-Wrote a workaround for a rare Unity bug which appears to have come up when using Chinese characters in text
-Overhauled the backend for the brig to help resolve the problems where players could see outside it, get stuck in it, or teleport around relative to it. Permanent disarming after being brigged while holding a torpedo is still a known issue.
-Fixed a bug causing permanent curtains in the online menu for players trying to join

[h1]Balance[/h1]
-The EMP now does damage less frequently, and deals damage fewer total times before being destroyed
-The torpedo, like the battery, now takes both arms to load, disarming any player holding one until it is loaded or set back int he dispenser
-The EMP now uses a small amount of fuel and cannot be fired without enough fuel available
-Each biome is now guaranteed to have at least one cave and at most three caves.

[h1]Other[/h1]
-New tumbleweed sounds
-New sea monkey sounds
-New blobfish sounds
-New volcanic turtle sounds

[h1]Community Highlights[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

[b]::: Player of the Month :::[/b]

July's Player of the Month is... [b]Behemoth270![/b]

Behemoth270 is one of our most active and constructive forum posters, constantly leaving well-thought-out and interesting feedback, while maintaining and understanding that as a small team, we won't always have time or won't always agree to implement many of the suggested posts as-written. But, with the help of Behemoth270's brainstorming threads (along with those who participated, honorable mentions to Banisher, ADcrafter, PigeonMan and JJXDoge) we were able to get closer to what we felt was the best form of implementation for one of our newest mechanics (Fuel). 

Their feedback aside, Behemoth270 has also put a great deal of effort into welcoming and helping teach many of our new community members, even going so far as to write an extensive [url=https://weneedtogodeeper.gamepedia.com/Tutorial_%26_Strategy_Guide]Tutorial and Strategy Guide for the Official Wiki![/url] Behemoth270 has also shown an effort to be kind and diplomatic in his interactions with other community members, helping keep the WNTGD community a friendly place.

As usual, our Player of the Month Behemoth270 will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for their efforts. 

[b]::: Community Content Highlight :::[/b]

This month we also want to take some time to highlight a few of the community's creations, namely ones that have made us laugh or ones that simply deserve to be seen more.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=970317384
This first one is a speed-running video by Freemankiller, which is edited in a hilariously tongue-in-cheek fashion, documenting their crew's exploits to "piss off the devs" by speed-running the game with two people in The Requin. The video is surprisingly well-done, and is full of some pretty amusing moments between the comedy montage-style editing. Hats off to you guys and your crazy feats!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/0/1290691937731945311/

This second highlight is some long-form fan fiction by ADcrafter detailing the descent into madness of a certain doomed expedition crew on their journey into The Living Infinite. It's incredibly well-written and is worth a read if you've ever wanted a fairly in-depth look into what an average Deeper crew is going through as you plunge your little characters into the dark abyss.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=927415415
Finally, this fantastic screenshot/caption combo by Gringo Grifter perfectly encapsulates that moment where you realize you haven't been keeping up on barnacle scrubbing in the Infected Depths.

----------------------------------------------------------

Thanks as always for your ongoing feedback and support, everyone! Let us know what you think of the update as always - so we can continue to improve the game. Happy diving!

notes.title: 0.5.7 Beta is Live! Help Us Test the New Update!
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! So as most of you may know, every 8th we have our big content update complete with new features, bug fixes, etc. Very often however, that update releases with a handful of new problems due to the fact that our own internal testing can only take us so far. So! In the interest of releasing tomorrow's Update in as spit-shine a form as possible, we have pushed the nearly-complete version of the 0.5.7 update into the Beta branch for any interested folks to take a shot at. 

We're not gonna list the full features here for the sake of saving most of the proper announcement stuff for the actual update tomorrow, but here are a few things you can expect to find/we'd like to see tested:

[spoiler]- A New 2-player Vessel (Shield sprites have not been updated yet)
- Built-in Voice Chat button (V by default)
- Potential fixes for non-spawning cave bugs and a handful of brig bugs.
- Fuel System
[/spoiler]

There is of course more in store, but we'll save the laundry list of new features for tomorrow. For now, happy testing and we hope to hear feedback from y'all soon!

[b]How to opt into the beta branch:[/b]
1. Go to your Steam library
2. Right-click our game
3. Click "Properties"
4. Click on the "Betas" tab
5. Change from "default" to "beta"

[b]WARNING: Players who opt into the Beta will only be able to play with other Beta players.[/b]

EDIT: A hotfix was just pushed to address the JOIN loading screen bug affecting some beta users.

notes.title: Crate Update #3 | The Fiddly Crate (0.5.6) & Summer Event!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d1be1c7d23651c2ad2c5f1c745a6a0b0a95f3fb7.png[/img]

Crate shipment ahoy! This time, coming to y'all packed full of new usability features for fiddly fingers, balance tweaks, and much-needed bug fixes, along with long-requested features such as Steam Cloud Saving and Brigs! Along for the ride is the kickoff of our Summer Event, complete with new terrifying foes, treasure, and special cosmetics!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/708556a13856d382b2cc36fa56ca9b182b157742.png[/img]

[b]The Brig![/b] - For all the scallywags and troublemakers out there, prepare to do time for your traitorous crimes in The Brig! The Captain (Host) of the ship can now lock any troublesome crew member in The Brig for a short period of time to show them a lesson in teamwork by utilizing the Player Info Window (Tab). Repeat offenders will spend a longer time in The Brig each time they are sent there, so better learn to behave or rot for your crimes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6456c1c171292d3b697a27710e0e78734f7e0b34.png[/img]

[b]Cloud Saving![/b] - Now available is Steam Cloud Saving! This should now be enabled by default for all users, so you'll be able to take your character's stash of hats, knick knacks, items and depth records on the go! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/95b56be5f6816ccf8bc0c292677f9cb7d89b5ad1.png[/img]

[b]New Fiddly Options![/b] - New tweakable options are now available in the Main Menu, letting you optimize/customize your go-to settings for We Need To Go Deeper. Rebind your controls in full from the new Controls window, and adjust the Quality of your graphics from the Options window to better optimize Deeper for lower end machines or crank that anti-aliasing up a notch!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6bb1dfae9c1cecbb313f341fdcd736836c2a5c91.png[/img]

[b]The Wrath of the Sun God[/b] Summer Event is now live! 

Legends say every Summer Solstice, the mighty Sun God  awakens, and with Him the many Caskets of his followers rise from the darkest parts of the Earth! These Caskets are filled with many riches, and some will contain one of [b]4 pieces of beautiful and rare headwear[/b], given to the Sun God as tribute. But beware, for there's a price to pay for waking the dead.. and they don't easily part with their riches.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6cd9346d1b72da47928220a930f7299164cc4ff8.png[/img]

[b]The Sun God will resume His slumber on July 8th.[/b]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

- Large gold can now only be found in treasure chests/rubble piles.
- [spoiler]Eldritch Staff now has a unique Eldritch Spawn monster that is far weaker than the Abominations prior. Staff also received +10 damage boost.[/spoiler]
- Cannon mini-gun now creates a distinct path line for each shot to better indicate their aim/direction.
- EMP base damage decreased by 1.
- EMP damage is reduced against bosses when there are fewer players.
- Elixirs are now much more likely to show up in caves and have functionally distinct spawn conditions in the dynamic difficulty system.
-Total minimum cave treasure spawns increased by 2, balanced with slightly reduced likelihood of spawning the largest gold pile from regular chests

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- The in-game chat paper strips now appear over the loadout screen and game over screen so that players can discuss loadout choices and chat at all times.
- Player names now load and display in the Customization Menu properly, so names should no longer need to be re-entered.
- Grabbing a second item when fully equipped should no longer jarringly swap your active item twice.
- Main power console switch should now be usable in caves but shouldn't be able to fire an EMP.
- Fixed newer cosmetics being unlocked by default by some users.
- EMP and Mini-Gun shots should now be able to damage Tortoises.
- Wrote a failsafe for a very rare bug where a player disconnecting before confirming that they had loaded the submarine interior could prevent interactable submarine elements from being spawned (this is extremely rare so please report cases if you still find them on the forums - you guys are great about this)


[h1]Other[/h1]

- Treasure chests given a visual face-lift with new custom animations and assets! Treasure plundering should be much more satisfying.
- A Periscope visual inside the sub has been added for when players use the Periscope button to look outside (Q).
- The Requin now has a depth meter in the Navigation room.
- Loadout menu slot size increased to use entire space to set correct initial expectations.

-----------------------------------------

That's all she wrote! As always, leave us your feedback and let us know if you run across any new problems, and a big thanks to everyone for constantly helping us drive this game towards being the best it can be! We'll be keeping an eye out on the forums as always!

Happy diving!
