This time, coming to y'all packed full of new usability features for fiddly fingers, balance tweaks, and much-needed bug fixes, along with long-requested features such as Steam Cloud Saving and Brigs! Along for the ride is the kickoff of our Summer Event, complete with new terrifying foes, treasure, and special cosmetics!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/708556a13856d382b2cc36fa56ca9b182b157742.png[/img]

[b]The Brig![/b] - For all the scallywags and troublemakers out there, prepare to do time for your traitorous crimes in The Brig! The Captain (Host) of the ship can now lock any troublesome crew member in The Brig for a short period of time to show them a lesson in teamwork by utilizing the Player Info Window (Tab). Repeat offenders will spend a longer time in The Brig each time they are sent there, so better learn to behave or rot for your crimes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6456c1c171292d3b697a27710e0e78734f7e0b34.png[/img]

[b]Cloud Saving![/b] - Now available is Steam Cloud Saving! This should now be enabled by default for all users, so you'll be able to take your character's stash of hats, knick knacks, items and depth records on the go! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/95b56be5f6816ccf8bc0c292677f9cb7d89b5ad1.png[/img]

[b]New Fiddly Options![/b] - New tweakable options are now available in the Main Menu, letting you optimize/customize your go-to settings for We Need To Go Deeper. Rebind your controls in full from the new Controls window, and adjust the Quality of your graphics from the Options window to better optimize Deeper for lower end machines or crank that anti-aliasing up a notch!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6bb1dfae9c1cecbb313f341fdcd736836c2a5c91.png[/img]

[b]The Wrath of the Sun God[/b] Summer Event is now live! 

Legends say every Summer Solstice, the mighty Sun God  awakens, and with Him the many Caskets of his followers rise from the darkest parts of the Earth! These Caskets are filled with many riches, and some will contain one of [b]4 pieces of beautiful and rare headwear[/b], given to the Sun God as tribute. But beware, for there's a price to pay for waking the dead.. and they don't easily part with their riches.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6cd9346d1b72da47928220a930f7299164cc4ff8.png[/img]

[b]The Sun God will resume His slumber on July 8th.[/b]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

- Large gold can now only be found in treasure chests/rubble piles.
- [spoiler]Eldritch Staff now has a unique Eldritch Spawn monster that is far weaker than the Abominations prior. Staff also received +10 damage boost.[/spoiler]
- Cannon mini-gun now creates a distinct path line for each shot to better indicate their aim/direction.
- EMP base damage decreased by 1.
- EMP damage is reduced against bosses when there are fewer players.
- Elixirs are now much more likely to show up in caves and have functionally distinct spawn conditions in the dynamic difficulty system.
-Total minimum cave treasure spawns increased by 2, balanced with slightly reduced likelihood of spawning the largest gold pile from regular chests

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- The in-game chat paper strips now appear over the loadout screen and game over screen so that players can discuss loadout choices and chat at all times.
- Player names now load and display in the Customization Menu properly, so names should no longer need to be re-entered.
- Grabbing a second item when fully equipped should no longer jarringly swap your active item twice.
- Main power console switch should now be usable in caves but shouldn't be able to fire an EMP.
- Fixed newer cosmetics being unlocked by default by some users.
- EMP and Mini-Gun shots should now be able to damage Tortoises.
- Wrote a failsafe for a very rare bug where a player disconnecting before confirming that they had loaded the submarine interior could prevent interactable submarine elements from being spawned (this is extremely rare so please report cases if you still find them on the forums - you guys are great about this)


[h1]Other[/h1]

- Treasure chests given a visual face-lift with new custom animations and assets! Treasure plundering should be much more satisfying.
- A Periscope visual inside the sub has been added for when players use the Periscope button to look outside (Q).
- The Requin now has a depth meter in the Navigation room.
- Loadout menu slot size increased to use entire space to set correct initial expectations.

-----------------------------------------

That's all she wrote! As always, leave us your feedback and let us know if you run across any new problems, and a big thanks to everyone for constantly helping us drive this game towards being the best it can be! We'll be keeping an eye out on the forums as always!

Happy diving!

notes.title: The Handy Update (0.5.5) | New Items Galore!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a9d2133d19468aa7258b1268995cb266e17d8edc.png[/img]

All hands on deck for June's content update! This month is all about putting a variety of handy tools, weapons, and upgrades at your disposal, along with a host of fixes and changes! Let's hop to it!

[h1]Content[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c0333ee4bbc5069fb87dacc9532ed2f6e4caa0bc.png[/img]

Five new handy items have been added to the game, each with their own unique strengths and weaknesses! Let's go over each of them, shall we?...

[b]The Phonograph![/b] - This bulky fella will let you expose your crew mates to the joys and wonders of classical music! Your whole team will appreciate your supportive tunes backing the score to them fending for their lives!

[b]The Dynamite![/b] - These explosive, water-resistant wicks of destruction are now at your disposal! Toss and clear out whole groups of enemies in a single blow, or destroy massive armored crabs and clams with but a few well-placed sticks. WARNING: VERY DANGEROUS. USE WITH CAUTION.

[b]The Monkey Wrench![/b] - While its repair speed and damage are average, this monkey wrench lives up to its namesake and makes quite the acrobat out of its wielder! Leap higher and run faster with the agile Monkey Wrench!

[b]The Tesla Gun![/b] - Invented by the famous inventor Nikola himself, the Tesla Gun packs an electric charge that can really deal some damage. Charge up and release powerful clusters of electric energy at your foes!

[b]The Syringe![/b] - This medical marvel allows you to really Doctor it up and perform healing blood transfusions on teammates! Its sharp needle even allows it to be a versatile weapon! WARNING: 5% OF PATIENTS MAY EXPERIENCE SOME DISCOMFORT.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8091936d60faffbfaed8f4d454af2a35d90c1728.png[/img]

[b]A Mystery Weapon![/b] - In addition to the five new items above, a stranger item also lurks beneath the depths of The Living Infinite, waiting for its mysterious power to be unlocked by those willing to dig deep enough to find the key to its release...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d2bbae23ee91b1f25855a45df9c1b16f864f9352.png[/img]

[b]New Submarine Upgrades![/b] - Two new upgrades for your vessel can now be discovered in Crates! Bullet Fire Rate and EMP Damage Upgrades are here!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a2460abc54361a7033dea41fc7e6761c5534a145.png[/img]

[b]Smart Caves![/b] - Caves have received an intelligence overhaul, and will now spawn items, barrels, treasure and upgrades based on the needs (or lack thereof) of your crew! Crews in dire need of supplies are more likely to get what they need to get back on their feet, and crews who are doing well have a higher chance of finding treasure! 
 
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed a problem where subHealth updates coming in from SubStats were throwing cheat checker into cheating detected mode.
- Aiming visuals should now work over the network.
- Mini-bosses now spawn at correct sizes.
- Fixed a null reference in cave spines.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

- Submarine Upgrades now have limited spawn rates.
- Adjusted EMP's effects on AIDM rest time numbers. It still tells the AIDM that engines off doesn't count for spawn prevention, but it no longer divides the time in combat numbers so hard.
- Caves are no longer as random! Now you should be set to get 3 caves per level, with the exception of a few extra random factors.
- Gold values adjusted on med/small piles to be slightly less valuable.

[h1]Other[/h1]

- Monthly Leaderboards have been reset.
- Added new biome-specific placeholder bosses for the shallow biomes(!)
- The Rose now has a secondary use other than looking just lovely!
- Visual flair/Particle effects given to a variety of items.
- Skeletal Abomination enemies given new sound effects.
- Item switching now has a sound effect.
- Original Wrench has been given a visual makeover with a new sprite!

[h1]Player of the Month[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png[/img]

June's Player of the Month is... [b]Kimi Kitte[/b]!

Kimi Kitte has been an enormous and pivotal help to us devs in crushing some seriously difficult bugs! To date, she has sent us NINETEEN log files along with commentary to describe the events of play sessions. Many times she has sent us the log files of the same game from both a host and a client perspective (this is crazy useful for tracking down networking problems). 

Thanks to her painstaking documentation efforts, we have managed to solve at least five outlandishly devious, sneaky, frustrating bugs. We say at least five because we actually have 6 more logs to get through to catch up... COUGH... well we can't all be as thorough as Kimi Kitte! 

In addition to being an incredible volunteer troubleshooter, Kimi Kitte also streams our game regularly, for fun and to help spread the word! Once again, thanks Kimi Kitte! You earned the crap outta this one!

As usual, our Player of the Month Kimi Kitte will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for her efforts. 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thanks again everyone for all the feedback, kind words, and support you've been sending our way! Let us know what you think of the new update as usual! Happy diving! :)

notes.title: Hotfix #13 - Crate Update 2 Balance Party
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Fun fact: This is actually not the 13th hotfix thanks to a lot of "stealth" fixes we occasionally push after big updates, but today's Crate Update has inspired so many balance/bug reports thanks to its mechanical overhaul nature that we knew we had to make this one public to let you guys know we have been working on getting some of these balance changes in as fast as possible! Without further ado - here's the changelog:

- Altered Minigun's base fire-rate and range to make it more effective in combat, especially against multiple foes.
- Gold drops have slightly higher default values and are set to drop bigger piles more frequently.
- Torpedo Ammunition and Barrels both have been given a much higher chance of spawning.
- Tortoises' colliders fixed to be easier to damage with Minigun bullets.
- Arctic Ice should now be damageable by Minigun bullets.
- Smoldering Shell boss tweaked to be less aggressive.
- Exterior enemies' health code adjusted to allow them to receive damage more frequently. This may have contributed to the minigun's initial ineffectiveness.
- "Charger" enemy types (Swordfish, Narwhals, etc.) health values lowered to make them easier to handle with the new mechanics.
- Fixed bug causing Mini-bosses to not spawn at the correct size.
- Fixed bug causing one of the relics to be improperly tied to the wrong relic identity in the Relic Museum.

Hopefully this should address a good chunk of the feedback we've gotten today, but more balance/fixing work is underway! It's a job that never ends, really. Alas, thanks so much to those who left their feedback promptly today to help us get this stuff in order as quick as possible! Keep it coming guys! :D

notes.title: Crate Update #2 | The Booster Crate (0.5.4)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/28a8375e152b01bf183737e99694c3c4dc1f0882.png[/img]

It's time for another catch-all Crate Update shipment - and this time it's practically overflowing with a variety of new big balance changes, tweaks, drinks, and a whole lot of BOOSTERS. Let's unpack this crate to see what's in store, eh?

[h1]Features[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7b1894b97017ac4de8f08fe8b58990f6499f71aa.jpg[/img]

[b]The Power Lever![/b] - Power management just got a BOOST with this all new, state-of-the-art Power Lever, just waiting to be flipped at a moment's notice by your trusted engineers. 

Found at the central Power Console, this lever will allow you to BOOST the ship's power into overdrive, sending out a destructive EMP field outside of the ship, damaging anything in its wake. [b][i]Warning: EMP is unstable and will cause your ship's systems to be shut down after use. You will have to flip the lever back to its normal state to restore power. Use with caution.[/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/415402ba0c69f8d28d756baf92f405ecea27d03e.jpg[/img]

[b]Cannon Overhaul![/b] - The Cannon as you know it has received quite the design facelift this update, all designed to help balance the exciting yet unfortunately tedious task of torpedo loading with the itchy trigger fingers of your average Weapons Specialist. Let's break the changes down piece by piece, shall we?
[i]
1. Weapons Power now has only two states. Power Level 1 activates the ship's new built-in BULLET FIRING state; a turret-like state where the Weapons Specialist can rat-a-tat-tat enemies with an endless supply of low-damage bullets without needing to worry about reloading. 

2. Power Level 2 then activates all three Torpedo Tubes as you know them, allowing them to be loaded manually for those times you require maximum firepower. Knowing when to switch between these two states will be pertinent to your team's diving success.

3. Torpedoes are no longer infinite. A counter on top of your local Torpedo Dispenser shows you how many torpedoes you have left. But not to worry, for you can now find new bundles of torpedo ammunition in caves inside of...
[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2385f5a9760f4ef490320f6053fddce47b071924.jpg[/img]

[b]Barrels![/b] - A new kind of cave drop has been added in the form of these mysteriously labeled barrels! Inside, you can find Torpedo Ammunition, or more rarely, you may find a variety of strange drinks called...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8f07f8742bb8fabaa936226a6d751575868f483d.jpg[/img]

[b]Elixirs![/b] - These 5 varieties of bottled up liquid miracles each have a unique BOOSTING effect on adventurers who dare drink them. From repair boosts, breath boosts, damage boosts and health boosts, there are a variety of ways you can improve your state-of-being! [i][b]Warning: Side Effects May Include Unpredictable Downgrades.[/b][/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3ed667dec78c6436d5ecf4e99fd7bc70e38c5629.jpg[/img]

[b]New Secret Unlockable Cosmetics![/b] - 5 new special cosmetics have been added as secret unlockables via the Code Entry box in the Extras section on the Main Menu. All of these are inspired by various content creators - and you can have them too if you can guess their codes! Here's our hints:

[i]This man is haunted by chants of ire and salt, his violet 'stache is yours if you know who's at fault![/i]

[i]This fellow's name quite literally means "man" - though going by his hair you'd think he's a crayon![/i]

[i]His own head is curly and his fans' are bobbles, this mystery often gets into squabbles![/i]

[i]Often the target of pokes and jeers, this royal bearded 'tuber has Styrofoam fears.[/i]

[i]A collector of pogs and rubbery toys, thank god for him and his status as #1 boy.[/i]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
- Relics are now slightly more rare
- All of those lovely features above!
- 3 new types of Gold Piles have been added to the game (small, medium, huge) that are worth different values and spawn at different rates.
- Small gold piles are now droppable by several in-game enemies.
- All exterior enemies' health values changed/balanced to accomodate new Bullet state for weapons console.
- Treasure chests no longer spawn health or poison elixirs.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Added a second failsafe check to remove the invisible walls that have been keeping players who load the game slowly trapped in the corners of submarines
- Fixed a problem where some volcanic vents wouldn't make their smoke or bubble particles correctly
- Fixed the bug where the submarine can blow up on one player's screen but not another, causing game-breaking desync. 
- Skeletons of disconnected players should now delete, and will no longer count toward the total dead player count for game over conditions
- Torpedoes of disconnected players now delete
- Found and fixed an index out of bounds exception when spawning the game loop-related monster which caused enemy spawning code to exit early and not return. This should finally solve the problem where enemies stop spawning after the game loops.
- Ghost explosions in caves should not be able to run their damage code twice on the same player anymore
- Fixed a bug where level resets after boss fights could cause players to lose periscope functionality
- Patched a very rare problem where a swimming exterior enemy may be spawned while inside a cave
- Added more exception handling and reference checking for enemy projectile-related code which appeared to be causing large packet buffer buildups (special thanks to Kimi Kitte for the logs showing this!)
- Fixed a series of bugs related to proper scaling and synchronized setup of cave enemies
- Placed invoke cancelations on a multitude of objects which may not have been properly cleaned up by the garbage collector due to invokes still running
- Fixed a bug where a player could request to load a torpedo multiple times with only a single torpedo
- Treasure chests should no longer continue to highlight after being opened.
- Gold pickup sound should no longer be delayed.

[h1]Cosmetic Changes[/h1]
- Submarine propellers animate now!
- Several biomes have had a color overlay overhaul to improve their overall look!
- The lights on the inside of the sub now flicker and swing around when the submarine is hit! They also turn red when the submarine is almost fully breached, turn extra bright during an EMP, and turn off altogether when the Power Lever is in the bottom position.
- New Gold pickup particle effect added.
- Gold piles now glow.
- Newspaper headline image changed to be submarine neutral.
- Health and Poison Elixirs' look has been overhauled to match the new visual style for elixirs.

[h1]Extras[/h1]
- Mid-game ESCAPE menu reworked and given added Options functionality! Now you can finally change volume options mid-game!

Let's break the changes down piece by piece, shall we?
[i]
1. Weapons Power now has only two states. Power Level 1 activates the ship's new built-in BULLET FIRING state; a turret-like state where the Weapons Specialist can rat-a-tat-tat enemies with an endless supply of low-damage bullets without needing to worry about reloading. 

2. Power Level 2 then activates all three Torpedo Tubes as you know them, allowing them to be loaded manually for those times you require maximum firepower. Knowing when to switch between these two states will be pertinent to your team's diving success.

3. Torpedoes are no longer infinite. A counter on top of your local Torpedo Dispenser shows you how many torpedoes you have left. But not to worry, for you can now find new bundles of torpedo ammunition in caves inside of...
[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2385f5a9760f4ef490320f6053fddce47b071924.jpg[/img]

[b]Barrels![/b] - A new kind of cave drop has been added in the form of these mysteriously labeled barrels! Inside, you can find Torpedo Ammunition, or more rarely, you may find a variety of strange drinks called...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8f07f8742bb8fabaa936226a6d751575868f483d.jpg[/img]

[b]Elixirs![/b] - These 5 varieties of bottled up liquid miracles each have a unique BOOSTING effect on adventurers who dare drink them. From repair boosts, breath boosts, damage boosts and health boosts, there are a variety of ways you can improve your state-of-being! [i][b]Warning: Side Effects May Include Unpredictable Downgrades.[/b][/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3ed667dec78c6436d5ecf4e99fd7bc70e38c5629.jpg[/img]

[b]New Secret Unlockable Cosmetics![/b] - 5 new special cosmetics have been added as secret unlockables via the Code Entry box in the Extras section on the Main Menu. All of these are inspired by various content creators - and you can have them too if you can guess their codes! Here's our hints:

[i]This man is haunted by chants of ire and salt, his violet 'stache is yours if you know who's at fault![/i]

[i]This fellow's name quite literally means "man" - though going by his hair you'd think he's a crayon![/i]

[i]His own head is curly and his fans' are bobbles, this mystery often gets into squabbles![/i]

[i]Often the target of pokes and jeers, this royal bearded 'tuber has Styrofoam fears.[/i]

[i]A collector of pogs and rubbery toys, thank god for him and his status as #1 boy.[/i]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
- Relics are now slightly more rare
- All of those lovely features above!
- 3 new types of Gold Piles have been added to the game (small, medium, huge) that are worth different values and spawn at different rates.
- Small gold piles are now droppable by several in-game enemies.
- All exterior enemies' health values changed/balanced to accomodate new Bullet state for weapons console.
- Treasure chests no longer spawn health or poison elixirs.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Added a second failsafe check to remove the invisible walls that have been keeping players who load the game slowly trapped in the corners of submarines
- Fixed a problem where some volcanic vents wouldn't make their smoke or bubble particles correctly
- Fixed the bug where the submarine can blow up on one player's screen but not another, causing game-breaking desync. 
- Skeletons of disconnected players should now delete, and will no longer count toward the total dead player count for game over conditions
- Torpedoes of disconnected players now delete
- Found and fixed an index out of bounds exception when spawning the game loop-related monster which caused enemy spawning code to exit early and not return. This should finally solve the problem where enemies stop spawning after the game loops.
- Ghost explosions in caves should not be able to run their damage code twice on the same player anymore
- Fixed a bug where level resets after boss fights could cause players to lose periscope functionality
- Patched a very rare problem where a swimming exterior enemy may be spawned while inside a cave
- Added more exception handling and reference checking for enemy projectile-related code which appeared to be causing large packet buffer buildups (special thanks to Kimi Kitte for the logs showing this!)
- Fixed a series of bugs related to proper scaling and synchronized setup of cave enemies
- Placed invoke cancelations on a multitude of objects which may not have been properly cleaned up by the garbage collector due to invokes still running
- Fixed a bug where a player could request to load a torpedo multiple times with only a single torpedo
- Treasure chests should no longer continue to highlight after being opened.
- Gold pickup sound should no longer be delayed.

[h1]Cosmetic Changes[/h1]
- Submarine propellers animate now!
- Several biomes have had a color overlay overhaul to improve their overall look!
- The lights on the inside of the sub now flicker and swing around when the submarine is hit! They also turn red when the submarine is almost fully breached, turn extra bright during an EMP, and turn off altogether when the Power Lever is in the bottom position.
- New Gold pickup particle effect added.
- Gold piles now glow.
- Newspaper headline image changed to be submarine neutral.
- Health and Poison Elixirs' look has been overhauled to match the new visual style for elixirs.

[h1]Extras[/h1]
- Mid-game ESCAPE menu reworked and given added Options functionality! Now you can finally change volume options mid-game!

notes.title: The Nook and Cranny Update (0.5.3) | Relics, Leaderboards, and Fixes Galore!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b7ba7e7b8c32e3cc2b235bfa243d94a8d74c900b.png[/img]

Put your explorer's cap on for May's official content update! It's here, and we've littered it with all sorts of hidden goodies. Hidden being the key word here, as some of the most beneficial stuff coming with this update is under the hood. They may not be the flashiest, but they are integral to ensuring your future Deeper experiences go as smoothly as possible. 

We tried to patch as many nooks, and cram as much content in all the crannies, that we could find. Without further ado - let's go over the changes:

[h1]Content[/h1]

[b]Relics![/b]

Lore! Lore up the cranny!

The mysterious hidden Relics are finally here for you to seek and collect throughout The Living Infinite's various cave systems; These Relics range from ancient idols, to petrified creatures, to undiscovered messages in bottles and more, each with their own story to tell about themselves and the world of The Living Infinite! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/63536d7375a2776a4ebc1e2129df12f51f5c7ccd.png[/img]

But what are Relics without a museum to display them? Once discovered, you can view all of your collected undersea artifacts in the ever-expanding Relic Museum - now accessible from the Play Menu!

[b]Leaderboards![/b]

Ever want to prove to your peers that your expeditions are truly the deepest? Well now you can, with Steam Leaderboard support!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fdd01858905c9442122da1a22c5c4840c5ffcd74.png[/img]

[i]It's not much to look at now, though we hope to see you guys fill it in no time![/i]

Each vessel will be judged on their own merits, so submarines each have their own leaderboards to keep those rank-chasers on their toes! Additionally, given our frequent balance changes, we'll be resetting these boards every month so the top dogs will have to fight to keep their places as lords of the ocean, and everyone else should always have a decent fighting chance at placing on the board! Crews will have identical scores at the end of their sessions, so no one has to worry about glory hogs.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/333577b1b952042d3113b4d7283fdaa5973accaa.png[/img]

Ahh the unsung heroes. We dedicated a LOT more time to these this month because these babies were really starting to pile up, so a little bit of Spring Cleaning was necessary. Check out these bad boys:

-Fixed a huge bug which was causing save files to stop working when new items were added.
-Fixed the issue where the two cannons on the Requin appear in the wrong place.
-Fixed a bug where the Requin weapons consoles could control the wrong cannon.
-Fixed two more sources of invisible leaks/dents. Gone forever?? Only time will tell!
-Default names in chat are now your steam name, rather than "Nameless."
-Fixed the local rotation of your player's arm being set wrong after dying.
-Fixed messages being sent in-game when there was no text.
-Fixed one source of a bug causing the depth meter text to not appear.
-Made an extra check to ensure that gold is only permanently removed if saving a purchase was successful.
-Made an extra check to ensure that catalog buttons only disappear if their purchase is saved successfully.
-Fixed a rare issue where two network interfaces can have their IPs broadcasted simultaneously when hosting online.
-Made a new non-buffering position syncing component for players and interior enemies, freeing TONS of network buffer space and reducing TONS of traffic.
-Changed the primary networking channel from being reliable ordered to reliable fragmented - should help players rebound after a lag spike.
-Added a series of points which help the submarines detect being trapped inside rocks (caused by a level chunk spawned after a lag spike) and teleport out - doesn't catch all cases but significantly reduces the problem [b]EDIT: [/b] This fix caused more problems than it solved. This will be patched out until we get a better solution

[h1]Balance[/h1]

-Number of volcanic sea monkeys invading the submarine reduced 25%
-Sea monkey health reduced by 40%
-Boar invader health reduced 10%
-Sea monkey and boar exterior shrub objects are twice as large
-Ghost pirate health reduced by 50%
-Miscellanous difficulty segmenting changes in the AIDM for better spawn rates in the volcanic area
-Changed first-layer water type probabilities. There is now a 50% chance to get Atlantic, 30% chance to get Stormy, and 20% chance to get Arctic.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's it, happy relic hunting - and be sure to let us know what ya'll think in the comments, forums, etc. as usual! Thanks everyone! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: May Content Update Temporarily Delayed - Player of the Month Announced!
notes.notes:
[b]EDIT: These problems have been resolved thanks in big part to the awesome developers of the connection tool we use! Expect the update shortly! [/b]

Hey guys! Okay, we know how bad this looks coming in late again after having showed up late to the party with the Fully Loaded update. Actually the circumstances are kind of different this time. We built out the content update in time (as far as we felt could safely be done in the time given) and then.... okay this is gonna get slightly technical.

[h1]Let's Get Technical[/h1]

The connection tool we use to get you fine folks hooked into one another had an update released which had some unexpected problems. The connection success rate with the update among our team dropped noticeably. While this is unfortunate, we don't fault the good folks developing the tool - their team is about the same size as ours, and we know that testing can be limited when you're small. In fact, we're not without fault here by any means. I personally (this is Jordan here) failed to set up my firewall correctly on my new work computer and dramatically increased the time required for testing, contributing greatly to the holdup and failures - talk about a taste of your own medicine, eh?

So, the question we would expect here is: [i]why can't you go back? Can't you just use the old version of the connection tool?[/i] Yes! And no! Okay, so Unity's asset store works in a funny (but not 'ha-ha' funny) kind of way. Once you update an asset from the store, there is no going back to a previous version (including reverting from your git or DVCS version control software). So in order to revert, we have to have a previous version built and sent to us from the creators of the connection tool. Once we have that in place, we can finally connect to one another well enough to test all the cool new content and network-related fixes we've been adding! Finally, we will be able to release the update we built!
[b]EDIT AGAIN: that build got sent to us! Thanks again! [/b]

[h1]Player of the Month[/h1]

But, like last time our update didn't come out in time, we still want to announce our [b]Player of the Month! [/b]

After much deliberating, we've picked [b]JJxDoge![/b]
[b]JJxDoge[/b] has been an avid player since just after launch, and has done a fantastic job of keeping the forums a lively place for discussion. He is always promoting participation in the Deeper community, in addition to helping us nail down Mac compatibility! Whether JJxDoge is posting feedback in the forums, detailing bug reports, contributing to the Wiki, or showing up our livestreams to feed us a steady stream of topics and questions to bounce off of, JJxDoge is always there. He is one of our most active and lighthearted community members, and for that, we think he deserves to be May's Player of the Month.

As usual, JJxDoge will be recieving 4 free copies of We Need To Go Deeper to distribute at his will, and will be displayed on the Main Menu until next month's update!

Thanks once again JJxDoge, and thanks to everyone for helping us keep the game chugging along! The We Need To Go Deeper community is ever-growing thanks to all of you folks helping us spread the word, and we couldn't be more grateful! ːsteamhappyː

[i]Note: because of our inability to produce any Steam builds unti the connection tool problem had been fixed, the main menu didn't reflect JJxDoge's top-dog status as player of the month until we got it fixed. Super sorry about that bud![/i]

notes.title: The Egg Hunt of Dr. Moreau | Weeklong Event!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/179209d941eb8f911f21f15aee1b1f6ea54da3f6.png[/img]

Greetings, specimens; it is I, the ingenious and most handsome of physiologists, Dr. Moreau. I'm writing to you swathes of salty spelunkers this day to inform you all of some uh... [b]problems[/b] that have been created. Problems that I may or may not have anything to do with.

You see, some brilliant mind has recently been experimenting with creating the [i]Most Ultimate Hopping Creature Ever Known to Man[/i] - an uncanny hybrid of Frog and Rabbit - a [b]Frobbit[/b], if you will. This experiment was so incredibly successful that it managed to hop its way out of the facility and off my- er - off SOMEONE'S Secret Island and into The Living Infinite's depths themselves.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/08377f43765512b93826f056ba8ceb3d7160be43.png[/img]

This creature lives to breed, and as such it has left countless of its spawn in its wake - in the form of large [b]EGGS[/b] containing its young. If not stopped, this creature will undoubtedly overrun the undersea eco-system with its many Hopping Hatchlings in a matter of weeks.

I propose then, that since you are all down there ANYWAY, that your many bands of submarine dwellers may track down as many of these Eggs as you can, and put a stop to this creature's breeding habits once and for all.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a8e6398b9a53fa4cdab4a9d35ac280f2458c7753.png[/img]

Additionally! This Frobbit may or may not have also made off with [b]FOUR RARE EXPERIMENTS[/b] in creating the [i]Ultimate Festive Spring Headwear,[/i] courtesy of some genius with a PhD. Due to some extremely sophisticated bio-science, these experimental fashion statements may be discovered within the Eggs themselves; If you happen upon any of these, feel free to keep them as compensation for your extinction efforts.

I wish the best of luck to you all! Those of you who suffer a Frobbit-toothed fate in the process, I salute you. The lifespan of the Frobbit is short, so as long as the threat is contained it and its Eggs should [b]expire within the week.[/b]

Sincerely,

~ Dr. Moreau, PhD

notes.title: The Fully Loaded Update (0.5.0) | New Submarine, Biome Overhaul, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9d09b719b46d0ae188e92aefec3fb44606a3f25c.png[/img]

This was a tough one to deliver, but April's official content update is finally here, and it's FULLY LOADED. "The Requin" Vessel has arrived, along with a complete overhaul for one of our biomes and a small helping of new cosmetics and bug-fixes! See for yourself on the full changelog below:

[h1] Content [/h1]

[b] A Brand New Vessel: [i]The Requin![/i][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b5ec13973eb7f0a42f6a1f303347a4a3c0f8bb24.png[/img]

The bigger, bulkier, and well-armed Requin is now available for you to crew for your future expeditions! The Requin is a militaristic submarine meant for those with larger 3-4-man crews; armed with TWO cannons from the start, but without the shielding capabilities of The Crevette. Being bigger comes with its advantages of course, since The Requin also comes with two beds and more breathing space for when things get hectic.


[b]Cursed Waters Biome Overhaul![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d9ece768d0b99200d81d7c9ff85ca27fafccb39f.png[/img]

The Cursed Water Biome has, for a while, been considered by many of our playerbase to be the ugliest and most tedious biome to start out with. After seeing how the biome was being recieved, we decided to take it upon ourselves to overhaul the whole biome from scratch! The Cursed Waters is no longer the colorless, empty-looking, ghost-filled biome you knew before, but has now taken on a whole new vibrantly spooky look, complete with several new enemy types and mechanic changes! 

Here is a summary of some of the new changes to the Cursed Waters Biome:[i]

- [b]No longer does every enemy leave behind a ghost upon death[/b], but only "Cursed" enemies distinguished by their decayed look. We recommend if you see a Cursed enemy to leave it be, because...

- [b]Ghosts are no longer killable![/b] That's right, your weapons cannot harm things that are not from the physical realm. When a ghost spawns, it will seek vengeance by heading towards its' former killer and exploding itself into a ghostly ether of rage.

- Mysterious and wicked [b]Bone Shrines[/b] now litter the caves and walls of the Cursed Waters; we advise you leave them alone, for disturbing these shrines will cause dangerous [b]Skeletal Abominations[/b] to form from the bones of their resting place!

- [b]Cursed Shipwrecks[/b] of pirate voyages long passed still sail these seas, seeking victims to board and plunder with their crews of mold-encrusted pirates.

- A strange [b]Mold[/b] will now grow inside your vessel when taking on water, and it has a mind of its own..
[/i]

[b]New Submarine Tilesets![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/ea2afd960f4d66ad9398691892e08b92c59de06c.png[/img]

Up until now, the submarine floors, backgrounds, and interior decoration has all been done via a single large hand-drawn file that made up the entirety of all decor in the sub. In other words, it's all been hard baked in until now.

 I'll be the first to say this was a stupid idea, and since we plan to have many new submarines in the future, a more modular tileset strategy was required, but it also gave opportunity to design a new cooler look for everything! Now all floors are made up of these cutaway view tiles with all the innerworkings and pipework on display, and all decor, pictures, etc. can be hand placed by designers! This will allow for easier creation of subs by our team and may even open up possibilities for sub "skins" in the future!

[b]New Cosmetics![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1321c3b3eddd9b178b20aff12f31da552ab41768.png[/img]

Four new potential looks for your adventurers have been added to the Catalog, half of which were fan suggestions! Whether you want to showcase your childish side with the Spin Cap, your wicked side with the Voodoo Stovepipe, your sailor side with the Rain Gear, or your pigeon side with the Pigeon Suit, we've gotcha covered!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

-Our networking system now tries to choose the best possible network adapter to host on when hosting online games by ignoring network adapters designed for VPNs or virtual machines
-Player names can no longer get covered by hair
-Doors no longer produce gore when hit
-Long games and multiple time devourer appearances no longer stops enemies from spawning
-Updated connection tool *should* prevent 5-player games (let us know if it doesn't)
-Minibosses should now show their names and effects properly between host and clients
-Curtains no longer pop open for a moment before closing again when reaching the loadout menu

[h1]Balance[/h1]

-The pump now bails 50% more water per pump
-Siren has been toughened up quite a bit (faster, stronger, attacks more often, hits a lot harder) to make her a more serious threat to be avoided
-Every aformentioned change to the Cursed Waters biome
-Time devourer moves 10% faster to engage the submarine

[h1]Regressions[/h1]

-The "Loading Aventure..." message stops showing for a moment during loading, then comes back

[h1]Inside Look: What Goes Into An Update?[/h1]

Since this update took nearly a whole extra week to get a stable version out to you guys, we thought it might be pertinent to share a little peek into what goes into a content update for We Need To Go Deeper. The following images are of every one of our Source Control pushes (Source Control being a system that allows us to share files,scripts, etc. with one-another as we work remotely), from when we began working on the update to when we finished it. This is not even counting the work that happens outside of these pushes, such as the creation of new sounds, assets, etc. (Though I blacked out spoilers for pushes which involved work for an upcoming update):

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4f9b1141b8cbda87bf30bc2930d42bfd22c87ef8.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f3c7c37dc9e9f7b85b118e21551631ba9a3c2e2e.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fbbe99f023ddea7f257ada2b3f4e8502899916e3.png[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks again to everyone for all of your continous feedback and support! Let us know what you'd like to see next as always, and of course keep us updated in the forums regarding any new bugs that may prop up. We're gonna need y'all testing this particular update extra thoroughly, as adding a new submarine has proven to be one of the biggest undertakings, and many, MANY systems had to be reworked to support it, so we fully expect there to be a few things out of place. Let us know what those things are as soon as possible, so we can patch 'em up quick!

notes.title: Open 0.5.0 Beta is Live! | Player of the Month Announced!
notes.notes:
After a great deal more work, we think that the new submarine is working well enough to be tested! However, as mentioned in the last announcement post, this required changes in essentially every aspect of our game. We definitely anticipate bugs and have caught/fixed LOADS already. If you want to give all of the new update's content a test, opt into the beta on Steam! 

So what in all is new? Well, we would actually like for you guys to discover a lot of that for yourselves before we post the full update text! Needless to say there is quite a bit of cool new stuff to check out!

[b]How to opt into the beta branch:[/b]
1. Go to your Steam library
2. Right-click our game
3. Click "Properties"
4. Click on the "Betas" tab
5. Change from "default" to "beta"

We [b]really really[/b] appreciate our community's help in reporting bugs and balance feedback in the past. If you try the beta, please help us out by going into the comments section below the announcement and reporting your findings on:


- Bugs in the new submarine
- Bugs in the old submarine
- Balance with the new submarine
- Late-game balance (do enemies still fail to spawn after going through the full game loop?)


For the technically savvy folks, here are some additional things which we have changed but need help testing:

- Connection success rates when more than one network adapter is active on your computer (i.e. having your WiFi adapter AND Hamachi on at the same time)
- Cheating (yes, there are cheating programs out there and we have tried to build a rudimentary little system to detect usage of cheat software)

[h1]Player of the Month[/h1]

As always, choosing a single player to highlight as our Player of the Month was a challenge; with our community growing larger each day, we get the opportunity to encounter more incredible feedback, more support, and more passion for helping the community's continued growth! This month's player has contributed to each of those lovely pillars, having gone quite the extra mile over the past month in their support/assistance for helping make Deeper's official [url=https://discord.gg/JUmsdD8]Discord Channel[/url] more organized and more useful for players looking for new crews to join up with. Our Player of the Month is [b]Wrzlprnft![/b]

Wrzlprnft has been incredibly patient and helpful with us over the past while as he's back-and-forthed about antivirus problems on the forums, created his own workarounds for certain problems (like the current lack of cloud saving) and sharing his findings with others, and offering his help as an Admin on the We Need To Go Deeper Discord to help organize the channels better, weed out the spammers, rude dudes, and general trolls over there, helping make the Discord the cool place to chill and chat that it is today. 

That's not to mention of course, the entire Discord Bot that Wrzlprnft took it upon himself to program from scratch to help out the Crew Recruitment shenanigans going on in the Discord! (Of which he made a while back but that we only recently got a chance to implement properly, sorry about that y'all!) The bot is called Crew Bot, and he hooks people up to voice channels via simple commands to help streamline the crew searching process!

I'll take this moment to remind everyone that they should go and JOIN the official Discord. Don't be shy, click this big shiny link right here: https://discord.gg/JUmsdD8

Anyway, Wrzlprnft will of course, be gifted 4 free copies of We Need To Go Deeper to give to friends and family as reward for his support and efforts to help the community.

notes.title: April's Content Update Has Been Delayed :(
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/cfe342a31cfd3e1f4b3dde88481be53f459c74e8.png[/img]

Wyell...

It was only a matter of time that we bit off more than we could chew for a month-long update, and that time has arrived. While most of the other features that we planned for the next update are in place and working, the biggest, most requested feature - the new submarine - is still not complete.

We Need to Go Deeper was built over the course of 4 years or so (with an engine change in the middle) with a single, reliable, ever-present submarine. When we listened to the overwhelming consensus from our players that it was time for a new submarine, we thought we could accomplish that in a month. As it turns out, when you build essentially the whole game in such a way that the submarine is always there, UN-doing that means rewriting parts in nearly all aspects of the game. In fact, rather than listing which parts of our game we had to change, here's the list of things in our game which DIDN'T have to change to accommodate a new submarine:

1. Cave generation
2. Exterior level generation
3. Interior enemy AI
4. Exterior enemy AI
5. Main menu
6. Play menu
7. Customization menu
8. Player handling (controls, weapons, position).

Everything else has either been changed or is going to be. In fact, it's possible that some very small changes will still need to be performed on a few items in that list which we haven't found yet.

Which is why... 
[b]We need beta testers![/b]

So much in the game has changed to accommodate the new submarine that essentially everything needs testing once again! Whether or not it's totally 100% stable and working, we will release the entirety of everything we have for this update to the Beta branch [b]as soon as possible[/b]. How do you get into the beta? Simply right click our game in your Steam library, go to "Properties", and select "Beta" as your branch from the "Betas" tab!

We're really sorry that we couldn't meet our deadline this month, but every additional submarine from here on will be easier. In software engineering terms, we're paying off lots of our "technical debt." Bear with us for a little longer here and have fun testing the new features early if you like!

Thanks everybody!

notes.title: Crate Update #1 | The Pumped Crate (0.4.6)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/87eec9a0f686bab5cc2496c71b8600657d9acea6.png[/img]

This week we're introducing our very first "Crate Update" - a new subset of smaller scale content updates that we hope to roll out around the middle of every month when we can (no guarantees), to supplement the time between our larger and bulkier content updates that we schedule for the 8th of every month. They're "Crate" updates because unlike our larger content updates, these are more of a mess of random tiny features or items that we're bundling together in a cute little crate to ship your way! 

Without further ado, let's get into this month's Crate Update -

This particular Crate Update is all about [b]PUMPING.[/b] Here's what the PUMPED CRATE has in store for y'all:

[b]PUMPED Interior Combat![/b] - We've added a ton of new feedback from juicy blood-spurts to giving enemies a good visual shake-down/jitter when damaged;  all to make interior combat that much more satisfying and pumped up! 

[b]PUMPED Interior Mini-Bosses![/b] - To help [strike]spice[/strike] pump up cave and interior enemy encounters further, any given interior foe now has a small chance of spawning as one of several Mini-Boss variants! You'll recognize these Mini-Bosses by their distinct colors and equally colorful names. Approach with caution however, as Mini-Bosses come with several varieties of stat boosts - from bulkier armor to faster feet to sharper pincers... these colorful critters are not to be trifled with.

[b]The PUMP Item![/b] - Perhaps the pumpiest of all the new features is our brand new Water Pump Item! This bulky fella will allow you to manually pump flood-water out of your ship and into the ether! Help your fellow crewmates stave off drowning by clearing their rooms of water in a pinch! A persistent pumper can even help slow the flow in a hectic situation, and buy their crew more time to save themselves from imminent destruction!

notes.title: Hotfix #12 (0.4.5f2) - Better VPN Support, Customization Fixes and More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Fix notes:

- Fixed the "Stewart Standard" bug where entering the customization room twice would cause your costume to not load.

- Rivet Gun has recieved more balancing tweaks: Rivet gun now has a slightly longer reload time to put a greater emphasis on precision and fixes dents much slower. (It still fixes leaks in one shot however)

- Added encryption to certain pieces of lobby data. This should prevent pirates with incompatible versions of the game from joining your game. No longer should you see Stewart Standards popping into your game and causing massive packet buildup and lag (incompatible versions are unable to interpret several packets and will request those same packets over and over and over again). 

- [b]Added a new option when creating a LAN game to pick the network interface to host on![/b] This is a tad bit confusing, but should make your LAN success rates extremely high, especially with VPN services like Hamachi. As an example, say that you want to create a game on your Hamachi VPN with a friend. You name your LAN lobby as usual, but now you pick Hamachi out of the next interface rather than your standard WiFi or ethernet adapter. Now, rather than using your normal home LAN, the game is actually broadcasting the correct information over Hamachi to be joined properly. Internally, this fixed Hamachi compatibility for us.

Alternatively, if you are hosting on your real LAN, simply ensuring that you're hosting through the network adapter connected to that LAN will ensure people on your network can join.

[b]***As a side note, if you are using Hamachi or another VPN, ONLY LAN games will work for you. We tested joining online games with Hamachi enabled, and it universally fails. Please make sure to turn off VPNs before joining online games. ***[/b]

notes.title: The Hot and Heavy Update (0.4.5) | New Biome, Enemies, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/19b5461476100eb82b2e8b6136bfcdd4524e057c.png[/img]

Things are getting steamy with March's official Content Update! This is our first big content update and although most of our time this past month has been utilized to fix bugs and push some big patches, we think you guys will be happy with just how much we managed to stuff into this hot plate. Take a look!

[h1]Content[/h1]

[b]The Volcanic Depths Biome! [/b] - The hot, dangerous, and jungle-like Volcanic Depths are now here for your crew to explore! A variety of new dangers await in this new dark third layer - from Gigantic Armored Tortoises to Nefarious Sea Monkeys, to Gaseous Vents that litter the walls and the very water itself which will boil you alive if you let too much of it in your vessel. This new biome will show your crew the meaning of pain.

[b]New Universal Enemies![/b] - These are enemies that will catch you off guard no matter what biome you may be in, in order to keep some of the more experienced crews on their toes. From Ensaring Bubbles to Sneaky Hermit Crabs, players navigating any area should be at the ready.

[b]The Rivet Gun![/b] - An all-new tool has been added to the roster in the form of this state-of-the-art Rivet Gun: An Engineer's Best Friend! This bulky fella can repair leaks and dents from a distance, and a good one at that - though it's not advised for use in combat - the rivets it fires are known to mostly annoy enemies more than it harms them.

[b]A [spoiler]Loop-Exclusive[/spoiler] Enemy![/b] - For those skilled enough to [spoiler]make it to the Time Portal,[/spoiler] a nasty surprise awaits you and your crew in the form of a monstrous new enemy type...

[b]New Customization Items![/b] - A variety of new hats and costumes have been added to the game; many of which have been fan requests! Including a new hat type: Masks! From Tiki masks to Dramatic Theatre masks to technological marvels like the Gas Mask, now you can finally hide your shameful face from the world!

[b]Bubbles![/b] - Last but not least, our underwater game now finally features bubbles! Bubbles everywhere! We've got bubbles to liven up the outside world, bubbles for boiling, bubbles for propellers, bubbles for DAYS.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed a bug which was causing gore to be continuously activated and deactivated over and over offscreen, causing increasing performance slowdowns over time. This fix has caused big framerate increases, especially late in the game!

- Added more redundancy to reduce the chance of hazards spawning on top of one another. 

- Freed up hazard spawn points whose hazard has been destroyed for reuse (very useful for giant bubbles).

- Fixed one source of unfixable leaks caused by scaling problems.

- Fixed those dumb little graphical artifact dots on the submarine's lights.

- Fixed bug which could cause massive packet buffering if traffic was preventing the music manager from sending over the next music change command.

- Fixed a problem where floating enemies which had spawned from inside chests were unable to be un-spawned over the network after leaving a cave.

- Fixed a similar graphical glitch to the "blue overlay" glitch found by some users in the catalog scene.

- Fixed that annoying bug which allowed torpedoes to explode when hitting teeny tiny rock particles.

- Fixed several costume pivots to stop underwear from showing around edges of an outfit.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

- The submarine is now 20% heavier (we didn't call it hot and HEAVY for nothin'!) and has 50% less linear drag. Driving is a much more engaged job and crashing is easier!

- The submarine's max speed before upgrades is now 2.8 times base speed rather than 3.

- The effects of adding power to the cannon are much more pronounced. 
 Each power added above 1 increases the cannon rotation speed by 25% (a 3-powered cannon spins at 150% of base speed).

- The submarine's shields recharge faster when more power is added, 12.5% per power unit above 1.

- The submarine's base shield recharge rate has been decreased to accommodate the previous balance.

- The Barnacle Harvester is now a "Stopper" type hazard. Rather than punching the sub over and over, it now grabs the sub and hangs onto it until being killed with torpedoes. 

- Water effects now take into account player number. The time between spawning ghost fish, placing ice on doors, etc. is now significantly more influenced by players, as is the total number of water effects spawnable.

-The rate at which enemy spawning decisions is calculated is now better tied to player number.

- The total number of spawnable enemies is better tied to player number.

- Hull upgrade adds 5 hull integrity rather than 10.

- Engine upgrade increases speed 5% rather than 7.5%

- Shield upgrades increase shield recharge rate 5% rather than 7.5%

- Cannon rotation upgrades increase cannon rotation speed 5% rather than 7.5%

- Many enemies' sight distances and speeds have been changed in response to the new driving.

[h1]Player Of The Month[/h1]

This was a particularly tough choice for us, as so many of you have been so helpful and contributed to the forum discussions in many ways over the course of our first month of release! Seriously, the community has been astounding and we couldn't be happier to have you guys. It eventually came down to those of you who have been helping us in even more tangible ways - aka helping us answer repeated bug reports, helping direct people to places where they can find help, and even creating a thread for said help! And with that, our Player of the Month for March is none other than [b]Ketrai![/b]

Ketrai has contributed in bulk in this short first month we've been released - having set up a very helpful FAQ Thread on the Steam Forums, Constantly adding content and managing edits to the [url=http://weneedtogodeeper.gamepedia.com/We_Need_To_Go_Deeper_Wiki]Official Wiki[/url] for the game, having become an admin over at the Wiki recently! He is also ever-present on the forums, answering the questions of other users or clarifying misunderstandings whenever he can. He's also contributed a ton of feedback in the feedback section, a lot of which led us to many of the balance changes in this very update! Ketrai will be recieving 4 copies of We Need to Go Deeper for his efforts; Thanks for helping us out!

With that said, we want to throw out an additional Special Mention to Steam user [b]THEE_PIANO_MAN[/b] - who has served as our first ever Forum Moderator, and has similarly helped us out a TON with repeat bug reports and issues, and has helped spread his friendly and helpful attitude among the forums as a whole! THEE_PIANO_MAN will be recieving 2 extra copies of the game as well to celebrate his contributions!

Thanks again to all of you, and we hope you like the update! Let us know in the comments and forums as usual, and help us keep improving We Need to Go Deeper!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e27c63542e7db03af97202510660034429ae92fc.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.4.3 is Out of Beta!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d34bd28973b82c11979f21dea8a96c7493c87e25.png[/img]

Thanks to everybody who helped us test this thing out! We will be reaching out to you individually to get you your in-game reward: the Beta Tester Blobfish Hat! Folks, if you see anybody who looks like this: 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e70c94613545431f956bbc6020c31c29d4ee37f8.png[/img]

Give them thanks for ensuring that this version was the most stable it could be. Conversely, make sure you direct any and all problems to people who look like this, and keep them informed of their beta testing negligence when bugs show up. We devs will be sitting in our ivory tower watching the blood sport, tapping our fingers together most evilly.

Release notes!

- Massive lobby overhaul: a huge increase in connection success rates, significantly decreased wait times to get into a lobby, and better relay integration to pick up connections.

- Big bandwidth reductions: most state update-type messages have been moved to a new networking channel which specifically discards anything but the most recent packet. This means that you won't be rapidly buffering up position, physics information, puddle heights, etc. everytime your network encounters a hiccup. Sweet!

- Light balance changes: it is now easier to damage the submarine than before

- Steam data getting/setting: fixes on the backend to reduce the number of times "Failed to write Steam lobby data" and related errors occur.

notes.title: Lobby Overhaul in Beta! Testers Needed! In-Game Rewards! (0.4.3)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8cbd3386622fc3f9c7c4a7ae65c5fecd272c8d9a.png[/img]

We have just done a massive overhaul on the lobby system under the hood, which we think you are all going to really like! From our internal testing, it has resulted in a [b]MASSIVE INCREASE IN CONNECTION SUCCESS RATES[/b]. With that said, as a 4-man team, we can only test so many different computers and architectures for stability with the changes. So this is a call for beta testers! If you would like to experience the great lobby overhaul first-hand, you can now switch over to the beta branch and dig in! To do so, right click on our game in your Steam library, click "Properties", go to the "Betas" tab, and opt in to the available beta!

To further sweeten the deal, we are planning to provide in-game incentives to people who post on the community forums about the lobby overhaul, good or bad. We really want this system working reliably before it goes to the main branch for everybody.

Oh! One thing you will notice - [b]folks on the beta branch will not be able to play with folks on the main branch.[/b] The two versions are incompatible and their lobbies won't cross-list. So if you are testing with friends, make sure you all opt into the beta. Thanks so much everybody!

From our internal testing, it has resulted in a [b]MASSIVE INCREASE IN CONNECTION SUCCESS RATES[/b]. With that said, as a 4-man team, we can only test so many different computers and architectures for stability with the changes. So this is a call for beta testers! If you would like to experience the great lobby overhaul first-hand, you can now switch over to the beta branch and dig in! To do so, right click on our game in your Steam library, click "Properties", go to the "Betas" tab, and opt in to the available beta!

To further sweeten the deal, we are planning to provide in-game incentives to people who post on the community forums about the lobby overhaul, good or bad. We really want this system working reliably before it goes to the main branch for everybody.

Oh! One thing you will notice - [b]folks on the beta branch will not be able to play with folks on the main branch.[/b] The two versions are incompatible and their lobbies won't cross-list. So if you are testing with friends, make sure you all opt into the beta. Thanks so much everybody!

notes.title: Hotfix #10 (0.4.2f4) - Even More Connection Success Rate Work!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Who needs an introduction? We've got new stuff to help success rates across the board, so take a look at these hot details:

- New faster methods for gathering public IP address. You should wait less time for the primary IP source. Let us know if this needs adjusting.

- Fixed a problem with Steam lobby data being incompletely written after the host loaded the lobby scene. This should mean much fewer "Failed to Get Steam Lobby Data" messages.

- Ensured that only lobbies where the host has actually loaded the game are listed in the online browser. Helps ensure that the host is ready to listen for punchthrough.

- Upped the disconnect and ping timeouts. This means you will see "Failed to Connect" after "Success! Loading adventure..." less frequently, but it WILL take longer for disconnected players to be deleted from the game. We hope to bring this back down when we have our more permanent solution built in for keeping the line active during loading.

- Fixed one of the most common ways for getting console desync. Players should see each other floating around less and consoles should be locked out significantly less. Some more console locking problems still exist and are being worked on actively.

- Forced Steam lobby member limit to 4 to ensure that lobbies don't accidentally overfill due to several players attempting to join too quickly. Should overall reduce overfill probabilities and competition problems for lobby slots.

- Better logging for players who send output_log or Player.log to us devs!

- Increased the "f" number on our version to 4! Feature of the year?

[b]NOTE: This WILL cause a "CRC Mismatch" between versions. This means that people who have not yet updated to the latest hotfix will be unable to successfully connect to those who [i]have[/i] updated to the latest hotfix. Please be patient with players who have not quit and updated yet. This generally resolves within a few hours.[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix #7 - Connection Success Rate Boost!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Congratulations! Connection success rates are getting a very big boost! 

Here's what's new:

- Ensured that dual-stack routers are getting their IPv4 address returned (currently only works if you can reach ipv4.icanhazip.com  but we will upgrade our secondary IP checker to do the same soon). That IPv4 address is now what other players will use to connect to.

- Reduced loading times on getting to the game scene, moved some object creation slightly forward in time. This will help reduce the number of perceived connection failures which are solely caused by loading the scene for too long without pinging the server. A more robust fix is underway to decrease these unnecessary disconnects further.

- Removed the IPv6 warning for users with dual-stack routers which manage to get their public IPv4 address.

- CAREFULLY re-integrated relay connections. The matchmaking backend is tested before online games can be created or joined, and relay use is turned off if the Unity matchmaking services are unresponsive. We are still looking at a more long-term solution to the problem of matches only being listed for a short time (this does not affect Steam matches, which is what you see in the "Join" browser). If the correct Unity match is not found, you will still connect to the game, just without using the relays.

- Better exception handling on the game's internal restart.

- Reduced the amount of redundant metadata written to Steam lobbies.

notes.title: Hotfix #4 - Blank screen fix and more!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Today's patch has been a long time brewing; but we finally think we got things sorted out with this "blank/bluescreen" graphical error that some of you with heavier duty custom built PC's have been running into! Along with this, we've managed to fix a bunch of other nagging bugs that y'all have been helping us find in the forums! Take a look at the full list of fixes:

[b]WARNING: This patch will create a CRC mismatch between versions, which means you won't be able to join anyone without this patch. Please allow time for others to download the patch themselves.[/b]

- Blank/Blue-screen menu bug should be fixed for most if not all of those having the problem! 

- The Hammerhead shark and the Goblin shark should be able to deal damage again, and all other similar enemy types should be behaving a little more consistently!

- (Hopefully) fixed the problems people are having with desync on who's using the console (causing people to appear to be jumping around and others unable to use that console).

- Fixed the costume unlocking bug for clients! Now clients should be able to unlock costumes properly without having to host their own game. NOTE: May require players delete their data to work properly (From the main menu select Extras > Delete Save).

- Loading times should be slightly less lengthy; particle initialization now occurs AFTER connection. Should help slightly with connection success rates.

- Butcher Knife should be able to make Meat Chunks again!

- Fixed enemy sounds not playing for clients.

- Some difficulty balancing across all water types! Things should be ever so slightly tougher for early areas.

- Fixed Barnacle Biter and Barnacle Maw from spinning like crazy.

- Double clicking on a lobby will now automatically join the lobby.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, keep us up to date on any problems you run into!

notes.title: Hotfix #3 - Information Highway
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Today's hotfix continues our mission to get networking stable/working as much as possible for everyone. We're not all the way there yet, so the secondary purpose of this hotfix is to help us gather more specific information from those experiencing troubles.

[b]WARNING: This patch will create a CRC mismatch between versions, which means you won't be able to join anyone without this patch. Please allow time for others to download the patch themselves.[/b]

Here's the gist of what we have packaged up in this patch:

- Better error reporting to replace 'waiting for online components to initialize' with more specific information.

- Fixed infinite spawning barnacles/algae/interior enemies bug.

- Added message to help identify hosts who will have more trouble getting players to join.

- Added "Bug Report" button to main menu to streamline reporting.

- Modified AIDM to have harsher difficulty ramping upon looping.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ADDITIONALLY! 

While we are working on repairing things on our end, we may have found a workaround option so that some of you having troubles hosting have something to try if you don't want to wait for an official fix:

[b]Forwarding port 7777 should help improve hosting success rates.[/b]

Again, so sorry about the technical issues everyone, but rest assured we are all working on figuring out fixes constantly. These new error reports should help us nail down quicker which issues folks are running into, so hopefully this will help speed up the process.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Thanks to the quick python work of our NASA software engineer Ryan (no, really, he actually is), we were able to get an alternate public IP address system up and running in less than 24 hours from launch! People who have gotten stuck in the menus waiting for 'Online components to initialize' should no longer have that problem!

This should be a better solution for people who were spending too much time waiting for the first public IP address system to succeed (the source of that problem). Coupled with the first hotfix, we think this should make a pretty marked improvement on establishing and maintaining good network connections.

However, we are still aware of a few more tricky connection initiation problems, and those are being looked at next.

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - Network Stability Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png[/img]

Thanks so much for your patience with us as we've tried to seek out and address some of the common problems most of you have been running into on launch day. The Deli team has been scrambling to get some of these issues ironed out! 

[b]Here are today's Hotfixes:[/b]

- Reduced random disconnects after big game events like changing water layers.

- Increased connection success rates among players who have to try several times before they successfully connect to the same person.

- Fixed a rare bug which caused barnacles to grow indefinitely on certain client machines.

- Reduced unnecessary packets in the atlantic waters.

-----------------------------

Hopefully this will help some of you have an easier time connecting! There are a few more stickler issues we're working on fixes for, we'll try and push these as soon as they are ready! 

[b]Additionally: Please note that you may still have network problems if you do not meet our minimum system requirements. [/b]

Thanks again to all of you for making this a stellar launch day! We are amazed by how patient and kind most of you have been about these issues as they've propped up. We're trying our best to make sure you all have a functional product! ːsteamhappyː
